articles.content: 随着芯片间硅光子学因其带宽和能效优势而逐渐受到关注，其电路交换的特性对集体通信提出了一个根本性问题：何时以及如何重新配置互连以实现这些优势？建立直接的光路可以减少拥塞和传播延迟，但每次重新配置都会带来不可忽视的开销，使得每一步都重新配置的做法不切实际。我们提出了Harvest，一种系统化的方法，用于合成拓扑重新配置计划，以最小化光子互连中的集体完成时间。给定一个集体通信算法及其固定的通信计划，Harvest确定互连在整个集体通信过程中应如何演变，明确地在重新配置延迟与拥塞和传播延迟之间进行权衡。我们将合成问题简化为一个动态规划问题，其中包含一个底层的拓扑优化子问题，并展示了该方法适用于任意的集体通信算法。此外，我们利用一个著名的AllReduce算法（递归加倍）的算法结构，合成最优的重新配置计划，而无需使用任何优化器。通过使用重新配置延迟对公式进行参数化，Harvest自然地适应各种光子技术。通过分组级别和流级别评估，以及在商用GPU上的硬件仿真，我们展示了Harvest合成的计划相比静态互连和每一步都重新配置的基准，在多种集体算法中显著减少了集体完成时间。

articles.title: LCLs Beyond Bounded Degrees
articles.author: Gustav Schmid
articles.summary: The study of Locally Checkable Labelings (LCLs) has led to a remarkably precise characterization of the distributed time complexities that can occur on bounded-degree trees. A central feature of this complexity landscape is the existence of gap results, which rule out large ranges of intermediate complexities. While it was initially hoped that these gaps might extend to more general graph classes, this has turned out not to be the case. In this work, we investigate a different direction: we remain in the class of trees, but allow arbitrarily large degrees. We focus on the \emph{polynomial regime} ($\Theta(n^{1/k} \mid k \in \mathbb{N})$) and show that whether polynomial gap results persist in the unbounded-degree setting depends on how LCLs are generalized beyond bounded degrees. There already exists a complex construction that shows that the polynomial gaps also vanish for LCLs on unbounded degree trees. Rather than stopping at this negative result, we give a much simpler set of problems that already contradicts the existence of any polynomial gaps. The insight obtained from this cleaner construction is that for gap results to exist, we cannot allow problems to distinguish infinitely many cases. This guides us to a natural class of problems for which polynomial gap results can still be recovered. We introduce \emph{Locally Finite Labelings} (LFLs), which formalize the intuition that \emph{every node must fall into one of finitely many local cases}. Our main result shows that this restriction is sufficient to restore the polynomial gaps: for any LFL $\Pi$ on trees with unbounded degrees, the deterministic LOCAL complexity of $\Pi$ is either - $\Theta(n^{1/k})$ for some integer $k \geq 1$, or - $O(\log n)$. Moreover, which case applies, and the corresponding value of $k$, can be determined solely from the description of $\Pi$.
articles.content: 对局部可检查标签（Locally Checkable Labelings，LCLs）的研究，已经对有界度树上可能出现的分布式时间复杂度给出了非常精确的刻画。这一复杂度景观的一个核心特征是存在“间隙结果”（gap results），这些结果排除了大量中间复杂度的可能。起初人们希望这些间隙结果可能也适用于更一般的图类，但事实证明并非如此。在本项研究中，我们探索了另一个方向：我们仍然关注树类，但允许树的度数任意大。我们聚焦于“多项式区间”（$\Theta(n^{1/k} \mid k \in \mathbb{N})$），并表明在无界度设置中，多项式间隙结果是否仍然存在，取决于LCLs在有界度之外是如何被推广的。目前已存在一个复杂的构造，表明在无界度树上的LCLs中，多项式间隙也会消失。我们并未止步于这一负面结果，而是给出了一个更简单的任务集合，这些任务已经反驳了任何多项式间隙的存在。从这一更清晰的构造中获得的洞察是：为了使间隙结果存在，我们不能允许问题区分无限多个情况。这引导我们找到了一类自然的问题，对于这些问题，仍然可以恢复多项式间隙结果。我们引入了“局部有限标签”（Locally Finite Labelings，LFLs），其形式化了这样一个直觉：每个节点必须属于有限多个局部情况之一。我们的主要结果表明，这一限制足以恢复多项式间隙：对于任何无界度树上的LFL $\Pi$，$\Pi$ 的确定性 LOCAL 复杂度要么是 - $\Theta(n^{1/k})$（其中 $k \geq 1$ 是某个整数），要么是 - $O(\log n)$。此外，适用哪种情况以及对应的 $k$ 值，都可以仅从 $\Pi$ 的描述中确定。

articles.title: TriCloudEdge: A multi-layer Cloud Continuum
articles.author: George Violettas, Lefteris Mamatas
articles.summary: TriCloudEdge is a scalable three-tier cloud continuum that integrates far-edge devices, intermediate edge nodes, and central cloud services, working in parallel as a unified solution. At the far edge, ultra-low-cost microcontrollers can handle lightweight AI tasks, while intermediate edge devices provide local intelligence, and the cloud tier offers large-scale analytics, federated learning, model adaptation, and global identity management. The proposed architecture enables multi-protocols and technologies (WebSocket, MQTT, HTTP) compared to a versatile protocol (Zenoh) to transfer diverse bidirectional data across the tiers, offering a balance between computational challenges and latency requirements. Comparative implementations between these two architectures demonstrate the trade-offs between resource utilization and communication efficiency. The results show that TriCloudEdge can distribute computational challenges to address latency and privacy concerns. The work also presents tests of AI model adaptation on the far edge and the computational effort challenges under the prism of parallelism. This work offers a perspective on the practical continuum challenges of implementation aligned with recent research advances addressing challenges across the different cloud levels.
articles.content: TriCloudEdge 是一个可扩展的三层云连续体，整合了远端边缘设备、中间边缘节点和中心云服务，作为统一解决方案并行运行。在远端边缘，超低成本的微控制器可以处理轻量级人工智能任务，而中间边缘设备提供本地智能，云层则提供大规模分析、联邦学习、模型适应和全局身份管理。所提出的架构相比多功能协议（Zenoh）支持多种协议和技术（WebSocket、MQTT、HTTP），用于在各层级之间传输多样化的双向数据，从而在计算挑战和延迟需求之间取得平衡。这两种架构之间的比较实现展示了资源利用和通信效率之间的权衡。结果表明，TriCloudEdge 可以将计算挑战分布，以解决延迟和隐私问题。该工作还展示了在远端边缘进行人工智能模型适应的测试，以及在并行性视角下的计算努力挑战。这项工作为实施实践连续体挑战提供了视角，与近期研究进展相一致，这些研究进展解决了不同云层级之间的各种挑战。

articles.title: Learning Decentralized LLM Collaboration with Multi-Agent Actor Critic
articles.author: Shuo Liu, Tianle Chen, Ryan Amiri, Christopher Amato
articles.summary: Recent work has explored optimizing LLM collaboration through Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL). However, most MARL fine-tuning approaches rely on predefined execution protocols, which often require centralized execution. Decentralized LLM collaboration is more appealing in practice, as agents can run inference in parallel with flexible deployments. Also, current approaches use Monte Carlo methods for fine-tuning, which suffer from high variance and thus require more samples to train effectively. Actor-critic methods are prevalent in MARL for dealing with these issues, so we developed Multi-Agent Actor-Critic (MAAC) methods to optimize decentralized LLM collaboration. In this paper, we analyze when and why these MAAC methods are beneficial. We propose 2 MAAC approaches, \textbf{CoLLM-CC} with a \textbf{C}entralized \textbf{C}ritic and \textbf{CoLLM-DC} with \textbf{D}ecentralized \textbf{C}ritics. Our experiments across writing, coding, and game-playing domains show that Monte Carlo methods and CoLLM-DC can achieve performance comparable to CoLLM-CC in short-horizon and dense-reward settings. However, they both underperform CoLLM-CC on long-horizon or sparse-reward tasks, where Monte Carlo methods require substantially more samples and CoLLM-DC struggles to converge. Our code is available at https://github.com/OpenMLRL/CoMLRL/releases/tag/v1.3.6.
articles.content: 最近的研究探索了通过多智能体强化学习（MARL）优化大语言模型（LLM）协作的方法。然而，大多数MARL微调方法依赖于预定义的执行协议，这通常需要集中式执行。在实践中，去中心化的LLM协作更具吸引力，因为智能体可以并行进行推理，并具有灵活的部署方式。此外，当前的方法使用蒙特卡洛方法进行微调，这会导致高方差，因此需要更多的样本才能有效训练。由于Actor-critic方法在MARL中广泛用于处理这些问题，我们开发了多智能体Actor-critic（MAAC）方法来优化去中心化的LLM协作。在本文中，我们分析了这些MAAC方法在何时以及为何是有益的。我们提出了两种MAAC方法：\textbf{CoLLM-CC}，采用\textbf{C}entralized \textbf{C}ritic（集中式评论家）；以及\textbf{CoLLM-DC}，采用\textbf{D}ecentralized \textbf{C}ritics（去中心化评论家）。我们在写作、编程和游戏领域进行的实验表明，在短期和密集奖励设置中，蒙特卡洛方法和CoLLM-DC可以达到与CoLLM-CC相当的性能。然而，在长期或稀疏奖励任务中，它们的表现均不如CoLLM-CC，其中蒙特卡洛方法需要大量样本，而CoLLM-DC则难以收敛。我们的代码可在https://github.com/OpenMLRL/CoMLRL/releases/tag/v1.3.6获取。

articles.title: Evidential Trust-Aware Model Personalization in Decentralized Federated Learning for Wearable IoT
articles.author: Murtaza Rangwala, Richard O. Sinnott, Rajkumar Buyya
articles.summary: Decentralized federated learning (DFL) enables collaborative model training across edge devices without centralized coordination, offering resilience against single points of failure. However, statistical heterogeneity arising from non-identically distributed local data creates a fundamental challenge: nodes must learn personalized models adapted to their local distributions while selectively collaborating with compatible peers. Existing approaches either enforce a single global model that fits no one well, or rely on heuristic peer selection mechanisms that cannot distinguish between peers with genuinely incompatible data distributions and those with valuable complementary knowledge. We present Murmura, a framework that leverages evidential deep learning to enable trust-aware model personalization in DFL. Our key insight is that epistemic uncertainty from Dirichlet-based evidential models directly indicates peer compatibility: high epistemic uncertainty when a peer's model evaluates local data reveals distributional mismatch, enabling nodes to exclude incompatible influence while maintaining personalized models through selective collaboration. Murmura introduces a trust-aware aggregation mechanism that computes peer compatibility scores through cross-evaluation on local validation samples and personalizes model aggregation based on evidential trust with adaptive thresholds. Evaluation on three wearable IoT datasets (UCI HAR, PAMAP2, PPG-DaLiA) demonstrates that Murmura reduces performance degradation from IID to non-IID conditions compared to baseline (0.9% vs. 19.3%), achieves 7.4$\times$ faster convergence, and maintains stable accuracy across hyperparameter choices. These results establish evidential uncertainty as a principled foundation for compatibility-aware personalization in decentralized heterogeneous environments.
articles.content: 去中心化联邦学习（DFL）使边缘设备能够在无需集中协调的情况下进行协作模型训练，从而具备抵御单点故障的能力。然而，由于本地数据非同分布所导致的统计异质性带来了根本性挑战：节点必须学习适应本地分布的个性化模型，同时选择性地与兼容的对等节点协作。现有方法要么强制使用一个无法适应任何节点的单一全局模型，要么依赖于无法区分数据分布真正不兼容与具有有价值互补知识的对等节点的启发式对等节点选择机制。我们提出了Murmura，一个利用证据深度学习实现信任感知模型个性化的框架。我们的关键见解是，基于狄利克雷的证据模型所获得的认识不确定性直接表明了对等节点的兼容性：当对等节点的模型在本地数据上评估时表现出高认识不确定性，表明存在分布不匹配，从而使得节点能够排除不兼容的影响，同时通过选择性协作保持个性化模型。Murmura引入了一种信任感知聚合机制，通过在本地验证样本上进行交叉评估计算对等节点兼容性评分，并基于证据信任和自适应阈值对模型聚合进行个性化。在三个可穿戴物联网数据集（UCI HAR、PAMAP2、PPG-DaLiA）上的评估表明，与基线相比，Murmura在从独立同分布（IID）到非独立同分布（non-IID）条件下的性能退化减少了（0.9% vs. 19.3%），收敛速度提高了7.4倍，并且在超参数选择上保持了稳定的准确性。这些结果确立了证据不确定性作为去中心化异构环境中兼容性感知个性化的原理性基础。

articles.title: Asymptotic behaviour of galactic small-scale dynamos at modest magnetic Prandtl number
articles.author: Frederick A. Gent, Mordecai-Mark Mac Low, Maarit J. Korpi-Lagg, Touko Puro, Matthias Reinhardt
articles.summary: Magnetic fields are critical at many scales to galactic dynamics and structure, including multiphase pressure balance, dust processing, and star formation. Dynamo action determines their dynamical structure and strength. Simulations of combined large- and small-scale dynamos have successfully developed mean fields with strength and topology consistent with observations but with turbulent fields much weaker than observed, while simulations of small-scale dynamos with parameters relevant to the interstellar medium yield turbulent fields an order of magnitude below the values observed or expected theoretically. We use the Pencil Code accelerated on GPUs with Astaroth to perform high-resolution simulations of a supernova-driven galactic dynamo including heating and cooling in a periodic domain. Our models show that the strength of the turbulent field produced by the small-scale dynamo approaches an asymptote at only modest magnetic Prandtl numbers. This allows us to use these models to suggest the essential characteristics of this constituent of the magnetic field for inclusion in global galactic models. The asymptotic limit occurs already at magnetic Prandtl number of only a few hundred, many orders of magnitude below physical values in the the interstellar medium and consistent with previous findings for isothermal compressible flows.
articles.content: 磁场在银河系动力学和结构的多个尺度上都至关重要，包括多相压力平衡、尘埃处理和恒星形成。发电机效应决定了磁场的动力学结构和强度。结合大尺度和小尺度发电机的模拟成功地生成了与观测结果在强度和拓扑结构上一致的平均磁场，但湍流磁场的强度远低于观测值。而针对星际介质参数的小尺度发电机模拟则生成的湍流磁场强度比观测或理论预期值低了一个数量级。我们使用基于GPU加速的Astaroth的Pencil Code，在周期性区域内进行高分辨率的超新星驱动银河系发电机模拟，包括加热和冷却过程。我们的模型表明，小尺度发电机产生的湍流磁场强度在磁普朗特数仅适中时就趋于一个渐近值。这使我们能够利用这些模型，提出该磁场成分的基本特征，以便纳入全球银河模型中。这一渐近极限在磁普朗特数仅为几百时就已经出现，远低于星际介质中的物理值，且与等温可压缩流的先前研究结果一致。

articles.title: SlimEdge: Performance and Device Aware Distributed DNN Deployment on Resource-Constrained Edge Hardware
articles.author: Mahadev Sunil Kumar, Arnab Raha, Debayan Das, Gopakumar G, Rounak Chatterjee, Amitava Mukherjee
articles.summary: Distributed deep neural networks (DNNs) have become central to modern computer vision, yet their deployment on resource-constrained edge devices remains hindered by substantial parameter counts, computational demands, and the probability of device failure. Here, we present an approach to the efficient deployment of distributed DNNs that jointly respect hardware limitations, preserve task performance, and remain robust to partial system failures. Our method integrates structured model pruning with a multi-objective optimization framework to tailor network capacity for heterogeneous device constraints, while explicitly accounting for device availability and failure probability during deployment. We demonstrate this framework using Multi-View Convolutional Neural Networks (MVCNN), a state-of-the-art architecture for 3D object recognition, by quantifying the contribution of individual views to classification accuracy and allocating pruning budgets accordingly. Experimental results show that the resulting models satisfy user-specified bounds on accuracy and memory footprint, even under multiple simultaneous device failures. The inference time is reduced by factors up to 4.7x across diverse simulated device configurations. These findings suggest that performance-aware, view-adaptive, and failure-resilient compression provides a viable pathway for deploying complex vision models in distributed edge environments.
articles.content: 分布式深度神经网络（DNN）已成为现代计算机视觉的核心，然而，由于参数数量庞大、计算需求高以及设备故障的可能性，它们在资源受限的边缘设备上的部署仍然面临挑战。在这里，我们提出了一种高效部署分布式DNN的方法，该方法同时尊重硬件限制、保持任务性能，并对部分系统故障具有鲁棒性。我们的方法将结构化模型剪枝与多目标优化框架相结合，以根据异构设备的约束条件定制网络容量，同时在部署过程中明确考虑设备可用性和故障概率。我们使用多视图卷积神经网络（MVCNN）来演示这一框架，这是一种用于三维物体识别的最先进架构，通过量化单个视图对分类准确性的贡献，并据此分配剪枝预算。实验结果表明，即使在多个设备同时发生故障的情况下，所得到的模型也能满足用户对准确性和内存占用的指定限制。在各种模拟设备配置中，推理时间减少了高达4.7倍。这些发现表明，性能感知、视图自适应和故障恢复的压缩方法为在分布式边缘环境中部署复杂的视觉模型提供了一条可行的途径。

articles.title: Leader Election via Unique Sink Orientation
articles.author: Jérémie Chalopin, Maria Kokkou
articles.summary: A Locally Checkable Labeling (LCL) is a specification describing a set of labels that are valid with respect to a set of conditions that characterize a local part of a solution to a global problem. Conditions can only refer to nodes and labels within a constant radius neighborhood of each node. This work studies local labeling schemes whose global consistency implies solutions to two classical problems: leader election and spanning tree construction. For each problem, we present a local labeling scheme using one bit per edge or equivalently $O(\Delta)$ bits per node (where $\Delta$ is the maximum degree in the graph), with conditions checkable within the graph induced by the one neighborhood of each node. For leader election, we show that global satisfaction of the conditions implies the existence of a unique sink in the graph, which we define to be a leader, while in the spanning tree setting it implies that a specific subset of edges induces a spanning tree rooted at a given node. We show those implications for $K_4$-free dismantlable and chordal graphs in the former case and for dismantlable graphs in the latter, assuming a root is given. For chordal graphs, the labeling implying a unique sink additionally induces an acyclic orientation. This property is not generally locally verifiable with constant-size labels in arbitrary graphs. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first local labeling results tailored to ($K_4$-free) dismantlable graphs, potentially highlighting structural properties useful for designing LCLs for additional problems. Finally, we present a generic transformation that converts any local labeling scheme into a silent self-stabilizing algorithm by adding only one extra state, assuming a Gouda fair scheduler. This transformation may be of independent interest.
articles.content: 局部可检查标签（LCL）是一种规范，用于描述一组标签，这些标签相对于一组条件是有效的，这些条件表征了全局问题解决方案的一个局部部分。条件只能涉及每个节点的常数半径邻域内的节点和标签。本研究探讨了局部标签方案，其全局一致性可以推导出两个经典问题的解决方案：领导选举和生成树构造。对于每个问题，我们提出了一种局部标签方案，每条边使用一个比特，或者等效地每个节点使用 $O(\Delta)$ 比特（其中 $\Delta$ 是图中的最大度数），并且条件可以在每个节点的邻域所诱导的图中进行检查。在领导选举中，我们证明了全局满足条件意味着图中存在一个唯一的汇点，我们将其定义为领导；而在生成树构造中，它意味着特定的边子集诱导出以给定节点为根的生成树。我们展示了这些推论在前一种情况下适用于 $K_4$-free 可拆解图和弦图，在后一种情况下适用于可拆解图，假设给定一个根节点。对于弦图，推导出唯一汇点的标签方案还诱导出一个无环定向。这一属性在任意图中通常无法通过常数大小的标签进行局部验证。据我们所知，这些是首次针对（$K_4$-free）可拆解图量身定制的局部标签结果，可能突显出对设计其他问题的LCL有用的结构特性。最后，我们提出了一种通用的转换方法，可以在假设Gouda公平调度器的情况下，通过仅添加一个额外状态，将任何局部标签方案转换为一个静默自稳定算法。这种转换可能具有独立的兴趣价值。

articles.title: Non-Convex Over-the-Air Heterogeneous Federated Learning: A Bias-Variance Trade-off
articles.author: Muhammad Faraz Ul Abrar, Nicolò Michelusi
articles.summary: Over-the-air (OTA) federated learning (FL) has been well recognized as a scalable paradigm that exploits the waveform superposition of the wireless multiple-access channel to aggregate model updates in a single use. Existing OTA-FL designs largely enforce zero-bias model updates by either assuming \emph{homogeneous} wireless conditions (equal path loss across devices) or forcing zero-bias updates to guarantee convergence. Under \emph{heterogeneous} wireless scenarios, however, such designs are constrained by the weakest device and inflate the update variance. Moreover, prior analyses of biased OTA-FL largely address convex objectives, while most modern AI models are highly non-convex. Motivated by these gaps, we study OTA-FL with stochastic gradient descent (SGD) for general smooth non-convex objectives under wireless heterogeneity. We develop novel OTA-FL SGD updates that allow a structured, time-invariant model bias while facilitating reduced variance updates. We derive a finite-time stationarity bound (expected time average squared gradient norm) that explicitly reveals a bias-variance trade-off. To optimize this trade-off, we pose a non-convex joint OTA power-control design and develop an efficient successive convex approximation (SCA) algorithm that requires only statistical CSI at the base station. Experiments on a non-convex image classification task validate the approach: the SCA-based design accelerates convergence via an optimized bias and improves generalization over prior OTA-FL baselines.
articles.content: 通过空中（OTA）联邦学习（FL）已被广泛认可为一种可扩展的范式，该范式利用无线多址信道的波形叠加特性，在单次使用中聚合模型更新。现有的OTA-FL设计大多通过假设\emph{同质}无线条件（设备间路径损耗相等）或强制零偏差更新以保证收敛，来强制实现零偏差模型更新。然而，在\emph{异质}无线场景下，这些设计受到最弱设备的限制，并增加了更新的方差。此外，先前对有偏差OTA-FL的分析主要针对凸目标函数，而大多数现代AI模型高度非凸。受这些差距的启发，我们研究了在无线异质性下使用随机梯度下降（SGD）的OTA-FL，用于一般的平滑非凸目标函数。我们开发了新的OTA-FL SGD更新方法，允许结构化、时不变的模型偏差，同时促进方差降低的更新。我们推导了一个有限时间平稳性界（预期时间平均平方梯度范数），明确揭示了偏差-方差权衡。为了优化这一权衡，我们提出了一个非凸联合OTA功率控制设计，并开发了一种高效的连续凸近似（SCA）算法，该算法在基站处仅需要统计CSI。在非凸图像分类任务上的实验验证了该方法：基于SCA的设计通过优化偏差加速了收敛，并在先前OTA-FL基线方法上提高了泛化能力。

articles.title: VibeCodeHPC: An Agent-Based Iterative Prompting Auto-Tuner for HPC Code Generation Using LLMs
articles.author: Shun-ichiro Hayashi, Koki Morita, Daichi Mukunoki, Tetsuya Hoshino, Takahiro Katagiri
articles.summary: In this study, we propose VibeCodeHPC, a multi-agent system based on large language models (LLMs) for the automatic tuning of high-performance computing (HPC) programs on supercomputers. VibeCodeHPC adopts Claude Code as its backend and provides an integrated environment that facilitates program development in supercomputer settings. The system not only brings the Vibe Coding paradigm -- program development through natural language interaction with users -- to HPC programming, but also enables autonomous performance optimization with minimal user intervention through a sophisticated multi-agent design. To achieve these objectives, VibeCodeHPC implements three core functionalities: (1) configuration capabilities tailored to the unique development environments of supercomputers, (2) collaborative operation among multiple LLM agents with distinct roles -- Project Manager (PM), System Engineer (SE), Programmer (PG), and Continuous Deliverer (CD), and (3) long-term autonomous operation through agent activity monitoring and dynamic deployment mechanisms. This paper highlights one of the most powerful features of VibeCodeHPC: fully automated code optimization through autonomous operation without user intervention. Specifically, it demonstrates the performance optimization of CPU-based codes on GPU-equipped systems for matrix multiplication and a Poisson equation solver using Jacobi's iterative method. The results show that the multi-agent configuration employed in VibeCodeHPC enables faster and more reliable development of higher-performance code compared to a single-agent setup.
articles.content: 在本研究中，我们提出了VibeCodeHPC，这是一个基于大语言模型（LLMs）的多智能体系统，用于在超级计算机上对高性能计算（HPC）程序进行自动调优。VibeCodeHPC采用Claude Code作为其后端，并提供一个集成环境，便于在超级计算机环境下进行程序开发。该系统不仅将Vibe Coding范式——通过与用户的自然语言交互进行程序开发——引入到HPC编程中，还通过复杂的多智能体设计，实现了在用户干预最小的情况下自主进行性能优化。为了实现这些目标，VibeCodeHPC实现了三个核心功能：（1）针对超级计算机独特开发环境定制的配置能力；（2）具有不同角色的多个LLM智能体之间的协作操作——项目经理（PM）、系统工程师（SE）、程序员（PG）和持续交付者（CD）；（3）通过智能体活动监控和动态部署机制实现长期自主运行。本文突出了VibeCodeHPC最强大的功能之一：通过自主运行实现完全自动化的代码优化。具体而言，它展示了在配备GPU的系统上对基于CPU的代码进行性能优化，用于矩阵乘法和使用雅可比迭代法的泊松方程求解器。结果表明，VibeCodeHPC中采用的多智能体配置相比单智能体设置，能够更快、更可靠地开发出性能更高的代码。

articles.title: Pareto-optimal Trade-offs Between Communication and Computation with Flexible Gradient Tracking
articles.author: Yan Huang, Jinming Xu, Li Chai, Jiming Chen, Karl H. Johansson
articles.summary: This paper addresses distributed stochastic optimization problems under non-i.i.d. data, focusing on the inherent trade-offs between communication and computational efficiency. To this end, we propose FlexGT, a flexible snapshot gradient tracking method that enables tunable numbers of local updates and neighbor communications per round, thereby adapting efficiently to diverse system resource conditions. Leveraging a unified convergence analysis framework, we derive tight communication and computational complexity for FlexGT with explicit dependence on objective properties and certain tunable parameters. Moreover, we introduce an accelerated variant, termed Acc-FlexGT, and prove that, with prior knowledge of the graph, it achieves Pareto-optimal trade-offs between communication and computation. Particularly, in the nonconvex case, Acc-FlexGT achieves the optimal iteration complexity of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}\left( \left( L\sigma ^2 \right) /\left( n\epsilon ^2 \right) +L/\left( \epsilon \sqrt{1-\sqrt{\rho _W}} \right) \right) $ and optimal communication complexity of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}\left( L/\left( \epsilon \sqrt{1-\sqrt{\rho _W}} \right) \right)$ for appropriately chosen numbers of local updates, matching existing lower bounds up to logarithmic factors. And, it improves the existing results for the strongly convex case by a factor of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}} \left( 1/\sqrt{\epsilon} \right)$, where $\epsilon$ is the targeted accuracy, $n$ the number of nodes, $L$ the Lipschitz constant, $\rho_W$ the connectivity of the graph, and $\sigma$ the stochastic gradient variance. Numerical experiments corroborate the theoretical results and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods.
articles.content: 本文研究了在非独立同分布数据下的分布式随机优化问题，重点探讨通信效率与计算效率之间的内在权衡。为此，我们提出了FlexGT，一种灵活的快照梯度跟踪方法，该方法允许每轮进行可调节的本地更新次数和邻居通信次数，从而能够高效适应各种系统资源条件。借助统一的收敛性分析框架，我们推导了FlexGT的通信和计算复杂度，其复杂度明确依赖于目标函数的性质和某些可调节参数。此外，我们引入了一个加速变体，称为Acc-FlexGT，并证明在已知图结构的情况下，它能够在通信和计算之间实现帕累托最优的权衡。特别地，在非凸情况下，Acc-FlexGT在适当选择本地更新次数时，实现了最优的迭代复杂度$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}\left( \left( L\sigma ^2 \right) /\left( n\epsilon ^2 \right) +L/\left( \epsilon \sqrt{1-\sqrt{\rho _W}} \right) \right)$和最优的通信复杂度$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}\left( L/\left( \epsilon \sqrt{1-\sqrt{\rho _W}} \right) \right)$，其结果与现有下界在对数因子范围内一致。此外，在强凸情况下，Acc-FlexGT相比现有结果提升了$\tilde{\mathcal{O}} \left( 1/\sqrt{\epsilon} \right)$的因子，其中$\epsilon$为目标精度，$n$为节点数量，$L$为Lipschitz常数，$\rho_W$为图的连通性，$\sigma$为随机梯度方差。数值实验验证了理论结果，并展示了所提方法的有效性。

articles.title: Optimizing Task Scheduling in Fog Computing with Deadline Awareness
articles.author: Mohammad Sadegh Sirjani, Mohammad Ahmad, Amir Mousavi, Erfan Nourbakhsh, Khoa Nguyen
articles.summary: The rise of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has led to the development of numerous time-sensitive applications that require quick responses and low latency. Fog computing has emerged as a solution for processing these IoT applications, but it faces challenges such as resource allocation and job scheduling. Therefore, it is crucial to determine how to assign and schedule tasks on Fog nodes. This work aims to schedule tasks in IoT while minimizing the total energy consumption of nodes and enhancing the Quality of Service (QoS) requirements of IoT tasks, taking into account task deadlines. This paper classifies Fog nodes into two categories based on their traffic level: low and high. It schedules short-deadline tasks on low-traffic nodes using an Improved Golden Eagle Optimization (IGEO) algorithm, an enhancement that utilizes genetic operators for discretization. Long-deadline tasks are processed on high-traffic nodes using reinforcement learning (RL). This combined approach is called the Reinforcement Improved Golden Eagle Optimization (RIGEO) algorithm. Experimental results demonstrate that RIGEO achieves up to a 29% reduction in energy consumption, up to an 86% improvement in response time, and up to a 19% reduction in deadline violations compared to state-of-the-art algorithms.
articles.content: 物联网（IoT）设备的兴起催生了许多对响应速度和低延迟要求较高的实时应用。雾计算作为处理这些物联网应用的一种解决方案应运而生，但面临着资源分配和任务调度等挑战。因此，如何在雾节点上分配和调度任务变得至关重要。本研究旨在在物联网中调度任务，同时最小化节点的总能耗并提升物联网任务的服务质量（QoS）要求，同时考虑任务的截止期限。本文根据雾节点的流量水平将其分为两类：低流量和高流量。使用改进的秃鹰优化（IGEO）算法，在低流量节点上调度短期限任务，该算法利用遗传算子进行离散化处理。使用强化学习（RL）在高流量节点上处理长期限任务。这种结合方法被称为强化改进的秃鹰优化（RIGEO）算法。实验结果表明，与最先进的算法相比，RIGEO算法可将能耗降低高达29%，响应时间提高高达86%，截止期限违反情况减少高达19%。

articles.title: Bridging Generalization Gap of Heterogeneous Federated Clients Using Generative Models
articles.author: Ziru Niu, Hai Dong, A. K. Qin
articles.summary: Federated Learning (FL) is a privacy-preserving machine learning framework facilitating collaborative training across distributed clients. However, its performance is often compromised by data heterogeneity among participants, which can result in local models with limited generalization capability. Traditional model-homogeneous approaches address this issue primarily by regularizing local training procedures or dynamically adjusting client weights during aggregation. Nevertheless, these methods become unsuitable in scenarios involving clients with heterogeneous model architectures. In this paper, we propose a model-heterogeneous FL framework that enhances clients' generalization performance on unseen data without relying on parameter aggregation. Instead of model parameters, clients share feature distribution statistics (mean and covariance) with the server. Then each client trains a variational transposed convolutional neural network using Gaussian latent variables sampled from these distributions, and use it to generate synthetic data. By fine-tuning local models with the synthetic data, clients achieve significant improvement of generalization ability. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach not only attains higher generalization accuracy compared to existing model-heterogeneous FL frameworks, but also reduces communication costs and memory consumption.
articles.content: 联邦学习（FL）是一种隐私保护的机器学习框架，它促进了分布式客户端之间的协作训练。然而，其性能常常受到参与者之间数据异质性的影响，这可能导致本地模型泛化能力有限。传统的模型同构方法主要通过正则化本地训练过程或在聚合过程中动态调整客户端权重来解决这一问题。然而，这些方法在涉及具有异构模型架构的客户端的场景中变得不适用。在本文中，我们提出了一种模型异构的FL框架，它在不依赖参数聚合的情况下，增强了客户端在未见数据上的泛化性能。与共享模型参数不同，客户端与服务器共享特征分布统计信息（均值和协方差）。然后，每个客户端使用从这些分布中采样的高斯潜在变量，训练一个变分转置卷积神经网络，并用它生成合成数据。通过使用合成数据对本地模型进行微调，客户端显著提升了泛化能力。实验结果表明，与现有的模型异构FL框架相比，我们的方法不仅获得了更高的泛化准确率，还减少了通信成本和内存消耗。

articles.title: Optimal Parallel Algorithms for Convex Hulls in 2D and 3D under Noisy Primitive Operations
articles.author: Michael T. Goodrich, Vinesh Sridhar
articles.summary: In the noisy primitives model, each primitive comparison performed by an algorithm, e.g., testing whether one value is greater than another, returns the incorrect answer with random, independent probability p < 1/2 and otherwise returns a correct answer. This model was first applied in the context of sorting and searching, and recent work by Eppstein, Goodrich, and Sridhar extends this model to sequential algorithms involving geometric primitives such as orientation and sidedness tests. However, their approaches appear to be inherently sequential; hence, in this paper, we study parallel computational geometry algorithms for 2D and 3D convex hulls in the noisy primitives model. We give the first optimal parallel algorithms in the noisy primitives model for 2D and 3D convex hulls in the CREW PRAM model. The main technical contribution of our work concerns our ability to detect and fix errors during intermediate steps of our algorithm using a generalization of the failure sweeping technique.
articles.content: 在噪声原始模型中，算法执行的每个原始比较操作（例如，测试一个值是否大于另一个值）以随机且独立的概率 p < 1/2 返回错误答案，否则返回正确答案。该模型最初应用于排序和搜索的背景下，Eppstein、Goodrich 和 Sridhar 最近的工作将该模型扩展到涉及几何原始操作（如方向和边侧测试）的顺序算法。然而，他们的方法似乎本质上是顺序的；因此，在本文中，我们研究了在噪声原始模型下用于二维和三维凸包的并行计算几何算法。我们在 CREW PRAM 模型下给出了第一个在噪声原始模型中针对二维和三维凸包的最优并行算法。我们工作的主要技术贡献在于，我们能够通过失败扫除技术的推广，在算法中间步骤中检测并修复错误。

articles.title: KVCache Cache in the Wild: Characterizing and Optimizing KVCache Cache at a Large Cloud Provider
articles.author: Jiahao Wang, Jinbo Han, Xingda Wei, Sijie Shen, Dingyan Zhang, Chenguang Fang, Rong Chen, Wenyuan Yu, Haibo Chen
articles.summary: Serving large language models (LLMs) is important for cloud providers, and caching intermediate results (KV\$) after processing each request substantially improves serving throughput and latency. However, there is limited understanding of how LLM serving benefits from KV\$ caching, where system design decisions like cache eviction policies are highly workload-dependent. In this paper, we present the first systematic characterization of the KV\$ workload patterns from one of the leading LLM service providers. We draw observations that were not covered by previous studies focusing on synthetic workloads, including: KV\$ reuses are skewed across requests, where reuses between single-turn requests are equally important as multi-turn requests; the reuse time and probability are diverse considering all requests, but for a specific request category, the pattern tends to be predictable; and the overall cache size required for an ideal cache hit ratio is moderate. Based on the characterization, we further propose a workload-aware cache eviction policy that improves the serving performance under real-world traces, especially with limited cache capacity.
articles.content: 为大型语言模型（LLM）提供服务对云服务提供商来说非常重要，而在处理每个请求后缓存中间结果（KV\$）可以显著提高服务吞吐量和延迟。然而，目前对KV\$缓存如何提升LLM服务性能的理解还很有限，系统设计决策（如缓存淘汰策略）高度依赖于工作负载。在本文中，我们首次系统地对来自一家领先的LLM服务提供商的KV\$工作负载模式进行了特征分析。我们得出了一些之前研究（主要关注合成工作负载）未涉及的观察结果，包括：KV\$的重用在请求之间是高度偏斜的，单轮请求之间的重用与多轮请求之间的重用同样重要；考虑所有请求时，重用时间和概率是多样的，但对于特定请求类别，其模式往往具有可预测性；实现理想缓存命中率所需的总体缓存大小是适中的。基于这些特征分析，我们进一步提出了一种针对工作负载的缓存淘汰策略，该策略在真实世界的数据追踪下，特别是在缓存容量有限的情况下，能够有效提升服务性能。

articles.title: A Generalized Hierarchical Federated Learning Framework with Theoretical Guarantees
articles.author: Seyed Mohammad Azimi-Abarghouyi, Carlo Fischione
articles.summary: Almost all existing hierarchical federated learning (FL) models are limited to two aggregation layers, restricting scalability and flexibility in complex, large-scale networks. In this work, we propose a Multi-Layer Hierarchical Federated Learning framework (QMLHFL), which appears to be the first study that generalizes hierarchical FL to arbitrary numbers of layers and network architectures through nested aggregation, while employing a layer-specific quantization scheme to meet communication constraints. We develop a comprehensive convergence analysis for QMLHFL and derive a general convergence condition and rate that reveal the effects of key factors, including quantization parameters, hierarchical architecture, and intra-layer iteration counts. Furthermore, we determine the optimal number of intra-layer iterations to maximize the convergence rate while meeting a deadline constraint that accounts for both communication and computation times. Our results show that QMLHFL consistently achieves high learning accuracy, even under high data heterogeneity, and delivers notably improved performance when optimized, compared to using randomly selected values.
articles.content: 几乎所有现有的分层联邦学习（FL）模型都仅限于两个聚合层，这限制了在复杂大规模网络中的可扩展性和灵活性。在本研究中，我们提出了一种多层分层联邦学习框架（QMLHFL），似乎是首个通过嵌套聚合将分层FL推广到任意层数和网络架构的研究，同时采用特定于层的量化方案以满足通信约束。我们为QMLHFL开发了全面的收敛性分析，推导出一个通用的收敛条件和收敛速率，揭示了量化参数、分层架构和层内迭代次数等关键因素的影响。此外，我们确定了在满足同时考虑通信和计算时间的截止时间约束条件下，使收敛速率最大化的最优层内迭代次数。我们的结果表明，即使在数据高度异构的情况下，QMLHFL始终能够实现较高的学习精度，并且在优化后相比使用随机选择的值，其性能显著提升。

articles.title: PlanetServe: A Decentralized, Scalable, and Privacy-Preserving Overlay for Democratizing Large Language Model Serving
articles.author: Fei Fang, Yifan Hua, Shengze Wang, Ruilin Zhou, Yi Liu, Chen Qian, Xiaoxue Zhang
articles.summary: While significant progress has been made in research and development on open-source and cost-efficient large-language models (LLMs), serving scalability remains a critical challenge, particularly for small organizations and individuals seeking to deploy and test their LLM innovations. Inspired by peer-to-peer networks that leverage decentralized overlay nodes to increase throughput and availability, we propose GenTorrent, an LLM serving overlay that harnesses computing resources from decentralized contributors. We identify four key research problems inherent to enabling such a decentralized infrastructure: 1) overlay network organization; 2) LLM communication privacy; 3) overlay forwarding for resource efficiency; and 4) verification of serving quality. This work presents the first systematic study of these fundamental problems in the context of decentralized LLM serving. Evaluation results from a prototype implemented on a set of decentralized nodes demonstrate that GenTorrent achieves a latency reduction of over 50% compared to the baseline design without overlay forwarding. Furthermore, the security features introduce minimal overhead to serving latency and throughput. We believe this work pioneers a new direction for democratizing and scaling future AI serving capabilities.
articles.content: 尽管在开源和低成本大型语言模型（LLM）的研究和开发方面取得了显著进展，但服务可扩展性仍然是一个关键挑战，特别是对于希望部署和测试其LLM创新的小型组织和个人而言。受利用去中心化覆盖节点以提高吞吐量和可用性的对等网络的启发，我们提出了GenTorrent，这是一种利用去中心化贡献者计算资源的LLM服务覆盖网络。我们确定了实现这种去中心化基础设施所固有的四个关键研究问题：1）覆盖网络组织；2）LLM通信隐私；3）资源效率的覆盖转发；以及4）服务质量的验证。本研究首次系统地探讨了这些基本问题在去中心化LLM服务中的情况。在一组去中心化节点上实现的原型评估结果表明，与没有覆盖转发的基线设计相比，GenTorrent实现了超过50%的延迟降低。此外，安全功能对服务延迟和吞吐量的额外开销极小。我们认为这项工作为未来AI服务能力的民主化和扩展开辟了新的方向。

articles.title: Right Reward Right Time for Federated Learning
articles.author: Thanh Linh Nguyen, Dinh Thai Hoang, Diep N. Nguyen, Quoc-Viet Pham
articles.summary: Critical learning periods (CLPs) in federated learning (FL) refer to early stages during which low-quality contributions (e.g., sparse training data availability) can permanently impair the performance of the global model owned by the cloud server. However, existing incentive mechanisms typically assume temporal homogeneity, treating all training rounds as equally important, thereby failing to prioritize and attract high-quality contributions during CLPs. This inefficiency is compounded by information asymmetry due to privacy regulations, where the cloud lacks knowledge of client training capabilities, leading to adverse selection and moral hazard. Thus, in this article, we propose a time-aware contract-theoretic incentive framework, named Right Reward Right Time (R3T), to encourage client involvement, especially during CLPs, to maximize the utility of the cloud server. We formulate a cloud utility function that captures the trade-off between the achieved model performance and rewards allocated for clients' contributions, explicitly accounting for client heterogeneity in time and system capabilities, effort, and joining time. Then, we devise a CLP-aware incentive mechanism deriving an optimal contract design that satisfies individual rationality, incentive compatibility, and budget feasibility constraints, motivating rational clients to participate early and contribute efforts. By providing the right reward at the right time, our approach can attract the highest-quality contributions during CLPs. Simulation and proof-of-concept studies show that R3T mitigates information asymmetry, increases cloud utility, and yields superior economic efficiency compared to conventional incentive mechanisms. Our proof-of-concept results demonstrate up to a 47.6% reduction in the total number of clients and up to a 300% improvement in convergence time while achieving competitive test accuracy.
articles.content: 联邦学习（FL）中的关键学习阶段（CLPs）指的是早期阶段，在此阶段中，低质量的贡献（例如训练数据的稀疏性）可能会永久损害云服务器拥有的全局模型的性能。然而，现有的激励机制通常假设时间上的同质性，将所有训练轮次视为同等重要，因此无法在CLPs期间优先吸引高质量的贡献。这种低效率因隐私法规导致的信息不对称而加剧，云服务器缺乏对客户端训练能力的了解，从而导致逆向选择和道德风险。因此，在本文中，我们提出了一种时间感知的契约理论激励框架，命名为Right Reward Right Time（R3T），以鼓励客户端参与，特别是在CLPs期间，以最大化云服务器的效用。我们构建了一个云效用函数，该函数捕捉了所实现的模型性能与分配给客户端贡献的奖励之间的权衡，明确考虑了客户端在时间、系统能力、努力程度和加入时间方面的异质性。然后，我们设计了一种CLP感知的激励机制，推导出一个满足个人理性、激励相容性和预算可行性约束的最优契约设计，以激励理性客户端尽早参与并做出贡献。通过在正确的时间提供正确的奖励，我们的方法可以在CLPs期间吸引最高质量的贡献。仿真和概念验证研究表明，与传统激励机制相比，R3T减轻了信息不对称，提高了云效用，并实现了更优越的经济效率。我们的概念验证结果表明，在实现具有竞争力的测试准确率的同时，R3T可将总客户端数量减少多达47.6%，并将收敛时间提高多达300%。

articles.title: Understanding GPU Resource Interference One Level Deeper
articles.author: Paul Elvinger, Foteini Strati, Natalie Enright Jerger, Ana Klimovic
articles.summary: GPUs are vastly underutilized, even when running resource-intensive AI applications, as GPU kernels within each job have diverse resource profiles that may saturate some parts of a device while often leaving other parts idle. Colocating applications is known to improve GPU utilization, but is not common practice as it becomes difficult to provide predictable performance due to workload interference. Providing predictable performance guarantees requires a deep understanding of how applications contend for shared GPU resources such as block schedulers, compute units, L1/L2 caches, and memory bandwidth. We study the key types of GPU resource interference and develop a methodology to quantify the sensitivity of a workload to each type. We discuss how this methodology can serve as the foundation for GPU schedulers that enforce strict performance guarantees and how application developers can design GPU kernels with colocation in mind to improve efficiency.
articles.content: 即使在运行资源密集型AI应用时，GPU的利用率也非常低，因为每个作业中的GPU内核具有多样化的资源需求，可能会使设备的某些部分达到饱和，而其他部分却处于空闲状态。将应用程序共置可以提高GPU利用率，但由于工作负载干扰导致难以提供可预测的性能，因此并不常见。提供可预测的性能保证需要深入理解应用程序如何争夺共享的GPU资源，如块调度器、计算单元、L1/L2缓存和内存带宽。我们研究了关键类型的GPU资源干扰，并开发了一种量化工作负载对每种类型干扰敏感性的方法。我们讨论了这种方法如何作为实现严格性能保证的GPU调度器的基础，以及应用程序开发人员如何在设计GPU内核时考虑共置以提高效率。

articles.title: Lynx: Enabling Efficient MoE Inference through Dynamic Batch-Aware Expert Selection
articles.author: Vima Gupta, Jae Hyung Ju, Kartik Sinha, Ada Gavrilovska, Anand Padmanabha Iyer
articles.summary: Selective parameter activation provided by Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) models have made them a popular choice in modern foundational models. However, MoEs face a fundamental tension when employed for serving. Batching, critical for performance in serving, forces the activation of all experts, thereby negating MoEs' benefits and exacerbating memory bandwidth bottlenecks. Existing work on efficient MoE inference are unable to resolve this tension even with extensive workload-specific tuning. We present LYNX, a system that enables efficient MoE inference in a workload-agnostic fashion. Exploiting several key observations that we uncover in this work, LYNX provides a light-weight run-time dynamic expert remapping technique that depends only on information already available in the models. Our evaluation of LYNX on four state-of-the-art model families across nine benchmarks shows that it achieves up to 1.23x improvement in throughput while simultaneously improving accuracy by up to 4% in the majority of the tasks, and incurs only a negligible accuracy loss of less than 1% points in significantly hard tasks. Further, LYNX is complementary to existing techniques where it additionally boosts their performance by up to 1.38x.
articles.content: Mixture-of-Expert（MoE）模型所提供的选择性参数激活功能，使其成为现代基础模型中的热门选择。然而，当用于服务时，MoE面临着根本性的矛盾。批处理对于服务性能至关重要，但会强制激活所有专家，从而抵消MoE的优势，并加剧内存带宽瓶颈。现有的高效MoE推理工作，即使进行了大量针对特定工作负载的调优，也无法解决这一矛盾。我们提出了LYNX，一个能够在不依赖特定工作负载的情况下实现高效MoE推理的系统。利用我们在本工作中发现的几个关键观察，LYNX提供了一种轻量级的运行时动态专家重新映射技术，该技术仅依赖模型中已有的信息。我们在九个基准测试中对四个最先进的模型家族进行了LYNX的评估，结果显示，它在吞吐量方面最高可提升1.23倍，同时在大多数任务中准确率提高了多达4%，在显著困难的任务中仅造成不到1%的准确率损失。此外，LYNX与现有技术相辅相成，还能进一步将它们的性能提升最高达1.38倍。

articles.title: Emergent Peer-to-Peer Multi-Hub Topology
articles.author: Mohamed Amine Legheraba, Maria Potop-Butucaru, Sébastien Tixeuil, Serge Fdida
articles.summary: In this paper we propose and evaluate an innovative algorithm that enables the creation of Peer-to-Peer network overlays characterized by emergent multi-hubs. This approach generates overlays that balance between the randomness of a graph and the structure of a star network, resulting in networks that not only feature prominent hubs but also exhibit strong resilience to failures. By leveraging principles of preferential attachment and random attachment, our method allows hubs to form spontaneously, offering a decentralized and fault-tolerant solution ideal for applications requiring both low network diameter and high robustness. The protocol is entirely decentralized, operates asynchronously, and depends exclusively on local information. Nodes organically evolve into hubs and remain indistinguishable from other nodes (except in terms of the number of incoming links). The quantity of hubs that emerge can be predetermined by the application as a network parameter.
articles.content: 在本文中，我们提出并评估了一种创新算法，该算法能够创建具有涌现多中心节点的对等网络覆盖层。这种方法生成的网络覆盖层在图的随机性和星型网络的结构之间取得平衡，不仅具有显著的中心节点，还表现出对故障的强韧性。通过利用优先连接和随机连接的原理，我们的方法使中心节点能够自发形成，提供了一种去中心化且容错的解决方案，非常适合需要低网络直径和高鲁棒性的应用。该协议完全去中心化，异步运行，并且仅依赖于本地信息。节点有机地演变为中心节点，并且与其他节点无法区分（除了入链数量的不同）。出现的中心节点数量可以由应用程序作为网络参数预先确定。

articles.title: Staging Blocked Evaluation over Structured Sparse Matrices
articles.author: Pratyush Das, Amirhossein Basareh, Adhitha Dias, Artem Pelenitsyn, Kirshanthan Sundararajah, Milind Kulkarni, Ben Delaware
articles.summary: The matrices used in many computational settings are naturally sparse, holding a small percentage of nonzero elements. Storing such matrices in specialized sparse formats enables algorithms that avoid wasting computation on zeros, significantly accelerating common matrix computations like sparse matrix-vector multiplication (SpMV) and sparse matrix-matrix multiplication (SpMM). In many real-world sparse matrices, however, nonzero elements are densely clustered in subregions of the matrix. For matrices that feature this sort of structured sparsity, hybrid formats can further improve performance by representing these subregions as dense blocks. Existing hybrid formats either fix the dimensions of dense blocks, padding irregular regions with zeros and wasting computation, or incur run-time overhead when iterating over variable-sized blocks. This paper presents SABLE, a framework for accelerating structured sparse matrix computations by using staging to achieve the best of both of these approaches. Ahead of execution, SABLE inspects the matrix to identify variable-sized dense subregions, which it stores using a new hybrid format. It then eliminates the overhead typically associated with variable-sized blocks by using staging to generate specialized code that is amenable to vectorization. We evaluate SABLE on SpMV and SpMM kernels using matrices from the popular SuiteSparse data set. SABLE outperforms the best available SpMV baseline by ${\sim}$10\% on average, and SpMM baselines by ${\sim}$20\%. When parallelized, SABLE achieves further speedups of up to ${\sim}7\times$ on SpMV and SpMM over the best fully-sparse baseline when using 8 threads.
articles.content: 在许多计算环境中使用的矩阵天然具有稀疏性，其中只有少量元素是非零的。将此类矩阵存储在专门的稀疏格式中，可以使得算法避免对零元素进行不必要的计算，从而显著加速常见的矩阵计算，如稀疏矩阵-向量乘法（SpMV）和稀疏矩阵-矩阵乘法（SpMM）。然而，在许多现实世界的稀疏矩阵中，非零元素在矩阵的某些子区域中密集地聚集。对于具有这种结构化稀疏性的矩阵，混合格式可以通过将这些子区域表示为密集块来进一步提高性能。现有的混合格式要么固定密集块的维度，用零填充不规则区域并浪费计算资源，要么在遍历可变大小块时产生运行时开销。本文提出了SABLE，一个通过分阶段处理来实现这两种方法优势的框架，从而加速结构化稀疏矩阵计算。在执行之前，SABLE检查矩阵以识别可变大小的密集子区域，并使用一种新的混合格式存储这些区域。然后，它通过分阶段生成适合向量化处理的专用代码，消除了与可变大小块通常相关的开销。我们使用来自流行SuiteSparse数据集的矩阵对SABLE在SpMV和SpMM内核上的性能进行了评估。在SpMV基准测试中，SABLE平均比最佳可用基准快约10%，在SpMM基准测试中快约20%。当并行化时，使用8个线程时，SABLE在SpMV和SpMM上比最佳全稀疏基准快达约7倍。

articles.title: Online Locality Meets Distributed Quantum Computing
articles.author: Amirreza Akbari, Xavier Coiteux-Roy, Francesco d'Amore, François Le Gall, Henrik Lievonen, Darya Melnyk, Augusto Modanese, Shreyas Pai, Marc-Olivier Renou, Václav Rozhoň, Jukka Suomela
articles.summary: We connect three distinct lines of research that have recently explored extensions of the classical LOCAL model of distributed computing: A. distributed quantum computing and non-signaling distributions [e.g. STOC 2024], B. finitely-dependent processes [e.g. Forum Math. Pi 2016], and C. locality in online graph algorithms and dynamic graph algorithms [e.g. ICALP 2023]. We prove new results on the capabilities and limitations of all of these models of computing, for locally checkable labeling problems (LCLs). We show that all these settings can be sandwiched between the classical LOCAL model and what we call the randomized online-LOCAL model. Our work implies limitations on the quantum advantage in the distributed setting, and we also exhibit a new barrier for proving tighter bounds. Our main technical results are these: 1. All LCL problems solvable with locality $O(\log^\star n)$ in the classical deterministic LOCAL model admit a finitely-dependent distribution with locality $O(1)$. This answers an open question by Holroyd [2024], and also presents a new barrier for proving bounds on distributed quantum advantage using causality-based arguments. 2. In rooted trees, if we can solve an LCL problem with locality $o(\log \log \log n)$ in the randomized online-LOCAL model (or any of the weaker models, such as quantum-LOCAL), we can solve it with locality $O(\log^\star n)$ in the classical deterministic LOCAL model. One of many implications is that in rooted trees, $O(\log^\star n)$ locality in quantum-LOCAL is not stronger than $O(\log^\star n)$ locality in classical LOCAL.
articles.content: 我们连接了三个近期研究扩展经典 LOCAL 分布式计算模型的不同研究方向：A. 分布式量子计算和非信号分布 [例如 STOC 2024]，B. 有限依赖过程 [例如 Forum Math. Pi 2016]，以及 C. 在线图算法和动态图算法中的局部性 [例如 ICALP 2023]。我们证明了这些计算模型在局部可检查标签问题（LCLs）上的能力和限制的新结果。我们表明，所有这些设置都可以夹在经典 LOCAL 模型和我们称之为随机在线-LOCAL 模型之间。我们的工作暗示了分布式环境中量子优势的限制，并且我们还展示了一个用于证明更紧界的新障碍。我们的主要技术结果如下：1. 所有在经典确定性 LOCAL 模型中以局部性 $O(\log^\star n)$ 可解的 LCL 问题，都存在一个局部性 $O(1)$ 的有限依赖分布。这回答了 Holroyd [2024] 提出的一个开放问题，并且也提出了一个用于通过基于因果性的论证证明分布式量子优势界的新障碍。2. 在有根树中，如果我们可以在随机在线-LOCAL 模型（或任何较弱模型，如量子-LOCAL）中以局部性 $o(\log \log \log n)$ 解决一个 LCL 问题，那么我们也可以在经典确定性 LOCAL 模型中以局部性 $O(\log^\star n)$ 解决它。其中一个推论是，在有根树中，量子-LOCAL 中的 $O(\log^\star n)$ 局部性并不比经典 LOCAL 中的 $O(\log^\star n)$ 局部性更强。

articles.title: uBFT: Microsecond-scale BFT using Disaggregated Memory [Extended Version]
articles.author: Marcos K. Aguilera, Naama Ben-David, Rachid Guerraoui, Antoine Murat, Athanasios Xygkis, Igor Zablotchi
articles.summary: We propose uBFT, the first State-Machine Replication (SMR) system to achieve microsecond-scale latency in data centers, while using only $2f{+}1$ replicas to tolerate $f$ Byzantine failures. The Byzantine Fault Tolerance (BFT) provided by uBFT is essential as pure crashes appear to be a mere illusion with real-life systems reportedly failing in many unexpected ways. uBFT relies on a small non-tailored trusted computing base -- disaggregated memory -- and consumes a practically bounded amount of memory (both local and disaggregated). uBFT is based on a novel abstraction called Consistent Tail Broadcast, which we use to prevent equivocation while bounding memory. We implement uBFT using RDMA-based disaggregated memory and obtain an end-to-end latency of as little as 10us. This is at least 50$\times$ faster than MinBFT , a state of the art $2f{+}1$ BFT SMR based on Intel's SGX. We use uBFT to replicate two key-value stores (Memcached and Redis), as well as a financial order matching engine (Liquibook). These applications have low latency (up to 20us) and become Byzantine tolerant with as little as 10us more. The price for uBFT is a small amount of reliable disaggregated memory (less than 1 MiB), which in our prototype consists of a small number of memory servers connected through RDMA and replicated for fault tolerance.
articles.content: 我们提出uBFT，这是首个在数据中心实现微秒级延迟的、基于状态机复制（SMR）的系统，同时仅使用$2f{+}1$个副本即可容忍$f$个拜占庭故障。uBFT提供的拜占庭容错（BFT）至关重要，因为纯崩溃在现实系统中似乎只是幻象，实际系统据报道以许多意想不到的方式发生故障。uBFT依赖于一个小型且未专门定制的可信计算基础——解耦内存，并消耗实际有限的内存（包括本地和解耦内存）。uBFT基于一种称为“一致尾广播”的新抽象，我们利用它来防止矛盾行为，同时限制内存使用。我们使用基于RDMA的解耦内存实现uBFT，获得端到端延迟低至10微秒。这至少比基于Intel SGX的最先进的$2f{+}1$ BFT SMR系统MinBFT快50倍。我们使用uBFT复制两个键值存储（Memcached和Redis），以及一个金融订单匹配引擎（Liquibook）。这些应用具有低延迟（最高20微秒），并且只需增加10微秒即可实现拜占庭容错。uBFT的代价是少量的可靠解耦内存（少于1 MiB），在我们的原型中，它由通过RDMA连接的少量内存服务器组成，并通过复制实现容错。

articles.title: Near-Optimal Sample Complexity for Online Constrained MDPs
articles.author: Chang Liu, Yunfan Li, Lin F. Yang
articles.summary: Safety is a fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning (RL), particularly in real-world applications such as autonomous driving, robotics, and healthcare. To address this, Constrained Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs) are commonly used to enforce safety constraints while optimizing performance. However, existing methods often suffer from significant safety violations or require a high sample complexity to generate near-optimal policies. We address two settings: relaxed feasibility, where small violations are allowed, and strict feasibility, where no violation is allowed. We propose a model-based primal-dual algorithm that balances regret and bounded constraint violations, drawing on techniques from online RL and constrained optimization. For relaxed feasibility, we prove that our algorithm returns an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy with $\varepsilon$-bounded violation with arbitrarily high probability, requiring $\tilde{O}\left(\frac{SAH^3}{\varepsilon^2}\right)$ learning episodes, matching the lower bound for unconstrained MDPs. For strict feasibility, we prove that our algorithm returns an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy with zero violation with arbitrarily high probability, requiring $\tilde{O}\left(\frac{SAH^5}{\varepsilon^2ζ^2}\right)$ learning episodes, where $ζ$ is the problem-dependent Slater constant characterizing the size of the feasible region. This result matches the lower bound for learning CMDPs with access to a generative model. Our results demonstrate that learning CMDPs in an online setting is as easy as learning with a generative model and is no more challenging than learning unconstrained MDPs when small violations are allowed.
articles.content: 在强化学习（RL）中，安全性是一个基本挑战，尤其是在自动驾驶、机器人和医疗等现实世界应用中。为了解决这个问题，通常使用约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDPs）来在优化性能的同时强制执行安全性约束。然而，现有方法常常会遭受显著的安全违规，或者需要较高的样本复杂度才能生成近似最优策略。我们处理两种情况：宽松可行性，允许小规模违规；以及严格可行性，不允许任何违规。我们提出了一种基于模型的原-对偶算法，该算法在遗憾和约束违规之间取得平衡，借鉴了在线RL和约束优化的技术。对于宽松可行性，我们证明我们的算法以任意高的概率返回一个ε-最优策略，其违规程度被限制在ε以内，所需的学习回合数为$\tilde{O}\left(\frac{SAH^3}{\varepsilon^2}\right)$，与无约束MDPs的下界相匹配。对于严格可行性，我们证明我们的算法以任意高的概率返回一个ε-最优策略，且无任何违规，所需的学习回合数为$\tilde{O}\left(\frac{SAH^5}{\varepsilon^2ζ^2}\right)$，其中ζ是问题相关的Slater常数，用于表征可行区域的大小。这一结果与具有生成模型访问权限的CMDPs学习的下界相匹配。我们的结果表明，在在线设置中学习CMDPs与使用生成模型学习一样容易，并且当允许小规模违规时，学习CMDPs的难度不会超过学习无约束MDPs的难度。

articles.title: Hybrid Feature Learning with Time Series Embeddings for Equipment Anomaly Prediction
articles.author: Takato Yasuno
articles.summary: In predictive maintenance of equipment, deep learning-based time series anomaly detection has garnered significant attention; however, pure deep learning approaches often fail to achieve sufficient accuracy on real-world data. This study proposes a hybrid approach that integrates 64-dimensional time series embeddings from Granite TinyTimeMixer with 28-dimensional statistical features based on domain knowledge for HVAC equipment anomaly prediction tasks. Specifically, we combine time series embeddings extracted from a Granite TinyTimeMixer encoder fine-tuned with LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) and 28 types of statistical features including trend, volatility, and drawdown indicators, which are then learned using a LightGBM gradient boosting classifier. In experiments using 64 equipment units and 51,564 samples, we achieved Precision of 91--95\% and ROC-AUC of 0.995 for anomaly prediction at 30-day, 60-day, and 90-day horizons. Furthermore, we achieved production-ready performance with a false positive rate of 1.1\% or less and a detection rate of 88--94\%, demonstrating the effectiveness of the system for predictive maintenance applications. This work demonstrates that practical anomaly detection systems can be realized by leveraging the complementary strengths between deep learning's representation learning capabilities and statistical feature engineering.
articles.content: 在设备预测性维护中，基于深度学习的时间序列异常检测引起了广泛关注；然而，纯深度学习方法在真实世界数据上往往难以达到足够的准确性。本研究提出了一种混合方法，将Granite TinyTimeMixer提取的64维时间序列嵌入与基于领域知识的28维统计特征相结合，用于HVAC设备的异常预测任务。具体而言，我们结合了通过LoRA（低秩适应）微调的Granite TinyTimeMixer编码器提取的时间序列嵌入，以及包括趋势、波动性和回撤指标在内的28种统计特征，然后使用LightGBM梯度提升分类器进行学习。在使用64个设备单元和51,564个样本的实验中，我们在30天、60天和90天的预测时间范围内实现了91-95%的精确率和0.995的ROC-AUC。此外，我们实现了生产就绪的性能，误报率低于1.1%，检测率为88-94%，证明了该系统在预测性维护应用中的有效性。本工作表明，通过利用深度学习的表示学习能力和统计特征工程的互补优势，可以实现实用的异常检测系统。

articles.title: PolyNODE: Variable-dimension Neural ODEs on M-polyfolds
articles.author: Per Åhag, Alexander Friedrich, Fredrik Ohlsson, Viktor Vigren Näslund
articles.summary: Neural ordinary differential equations (NODEs) are geometric deep learning models based on dynamical systems and flows generated by vector fields on manifolds. Despite numerous successful applications, particularly within the flow matching paradigm, all existing NODE models are fundamentally constrained to fixed-dimensional dynamics by the intrinsic nature of the manifold's dimension. In this paper, we extend NODEs to M-polyfolds (spaces that can simultaneously accommodate varying dimensions and a notion of differentiability) and introduce PolyNODEs, the first variable-dimensional flow-based model in geometric deep learning. As an example application, we construct explicit M-polyfolds featuring dimensional bottlenecks and PolyNODE autoencoders based on parametrised vector fields that traverse these bottlenecks. We demonstrate experimentally that our PolyNODE models can be trained to solve reconstruction tasks in these spaces, and that latent representations of the input can be extracted and used to solve downstream classification tasks. The code used in our experiments is publicly available at https://github.com/turbotage/PolyNODE .
articles.content: 神经常微分方程（NODEs）是一种基于流形上向量场生成的动态系统和流的几何深度学习模型。尽管在流匹配范式中取得了许多成功应用，但所有现有的NODE模型由于流形维度的内在性质，本质上都受限于固定维度的动力学。在本文中，我们将NODEs扩展到M-多折空间（能够同时容纳变化维度和可微性概念的空间），并引入了PolyNODEs，这是几何深度学习中首个可变维度的基于流的模型。作为应用示例，我们构建了具有维度瓶颈的显式M-多折空间，并基于参数化向量场构建了穿越这些瓶颈的PolyNODE自编码器。我们通过实验表明，我们的PolyNODE模型可以被训练用于解决这些空间中的重构任务，并且可以提取输入的潜在表示，用于解决下游分类任务。我们在实验中使用的代码可在https://github.com/turbotage/PolyNODE上公开获取。

articles.title: Learning Representations from Incomplete EHR Data with Dual-Masked Autoencoding
articles.author: Xiao Xiang, David Restrepo, Hyewon Jeong, Yugang Jia, Leo Anthony Celi
articles.summary: Learning from electronic health records (EHRs) time series is challenging due to irregular sam- pling, heterogeneous missingness, and the resulting sparsity of observations. Prior self-supervised meth- ods either impute before learning, represent missingness through a dedicated input signal, or optimize solely for imputation, reducing their capacity to efficiently learn representations that support clinical downstream tasks. We propose the Augmented-Intrinsic Dual-Masked Autoencoder (AID-MAE), which learns directly from incomplete time series by applying an intrinsic missing mask to represent naturally missing values and an augmented mask that hides a subset of observed values for reconstruction during training. AID-MAE processes only the unmasked subset of tokens and consistently outperforms strong baselines, including XGBoost and DuETT, across multiple clinical tasks on two datasets. In addition, the learned embeddings naturally stratify patient cohorts in the representation space.
articles.content: 由于不规则采样、异构缺失性和由此导致的观测数据稀疏性，从电子健康记录（EHRs）时间序列中学习具有挑战性。先前的自监督方法要么在学习之前进行填补，要么通过专门的输入信号表示缺失性，或者仅优化填补任务，这限制了它们高效学习支持临床下游任务的表示能力。我们提出了增强内在双掩码自编码器（AID-MAE），该方法通过应用内在缺失掩码来自然表示缺失值，并应用增强掩码在训练过程中隐藏一部分观测值以进行重建，从而直接从不完整的时间序列中学习。AID-MAE仅处理未被掩码的标记子集，并在两个数据集的多个临床任务中始终优于XGBoost和DuETT等强基线模型。此外，学习到的嵌入在表示空间中自然地对患者群体进行了分层。

articles.title: Seeing to Generalize: How Visual Data Corrects Binding Shortcuts
articles.author: Nicolas Buzeta, Felipe del Rio, Cristian Hinostroza, Denis Parra, Hans Lobel, Rodrigo Toro Icarte
articles.summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are designed to extend Large Language Models (LLMs) with visual capabilities, yet in this work we observe a surprising phenomenon: VLMs can outperform their underlying LLMs on purely text-only tasks, particularly in long-context information retrieval. To investigate this effect, we build a controlled synthetic retrieval task and find that a transformer trained only on text achieves perfect in-distribution accuracy but fails to generalize out of distribution, while subsequent training on an image-tokenized version of the same task nearly doubles text-only OOD performance. Mechanistic interpretability reveals that visual training changes the model's internal binding strategy: text-only training encourages positional shortcuts, whereas image-based training disrupts them through spatial translation invariance, forcing the model to adopt a more robust symbolic binding mechanism that persists even after text-only examples are reintroduced. We further characterize how binding strategies vary across training regimes, visual encoders, and initializations, and show that analogous shifts occur during pretrained LLM-to-VLM transitions. Our findings suggest that cross-modal training can enhance reasoning and generalization even for tasks grounded in a single modality.
articles.content: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）旨在通过视觉能力扩展大型语言模型（LLMs），然而在本研究中我们观察到一个令人惊讶的现象：VLMs在纯文本任务上可以优于其底层的LLMs，尤其是在长上下文信息检索方面。为了研究这一现象，我们构建了一个受控的合成检索任务，并发现仅在文本上训练的Transformer模型在分布内任务中可以达到完美的准确率，但在分布外任务中却无法泛化，而随后在相同任务的图像标记版本上进行训练几乎使纯文本的分布外性能翻倍。机制可解释性分析揭示了视觉训练改变了模型的内部绑定策略：仅文本训练鼓励位置捷径，而基于图像的训练通过空间平移不变性破坏了这些捷径，迫使模型采用一种更稳健的符号绑定机制，即使在重新引入纯文本示例后，这种机制仍然存在。我们进一步描述了绑定策略在不同训练方式、视觉编码器和初始化之间的变化，并展示了类似的变化也发生在预训练LLM到VLM的过渡过程中。我们的研究结果表明，跨模态训练可以增强即使是单一模态任务的推理和泛化能力。

articles.title: Learning Data-Efficient and Generalizable Neural Operators via Fundamental Physics Knowledge
articles.author: Siying Ma, Mehrdad M. Zadeh, Mauricio Soroco, Wuyang Chen, Jiguo Cao, Vijay Ganesh
articles.summary: Recent advances in scientific machine learning (SciML) have enabled neural operators (NOs) to serve as powerful surrogates for modeling the dynamic evolution of physical systems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs). While existing approaches focus primarily on learning simulations from the target PDE, they often overlook more fundamental physical principles underlying these equations. Inspired by how numerical solvers are compatible with simulations of different settings of PDEs, we propose a multiphysics training framework that jointly learns from both the original PDEs and their simplified basic forms. Our framework enhances data efficiency, reduces predictive errors, and improves out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, particularly in scenarios involving shifts of physical parameters and synthetic-to-real transfer. Our method is architecture-agnostic and demonstrates consistent improvements in normalized root mean square error (nRMSE) across a wide range of 1D/2D/3D PDE problems. Through extensive experiments, we show that explicit incorporation of fundamental physics knowledge significantly strengthens the generalization ability of neural operators. We will release models and codes at https://sites.google.com/view/sciml-fundemental-pde.
articles.content: 科学机器学习（SciML）的最新进展使神经算子（NOs）能够作为强大的代理模型，用于模拟由偏微分方程（PDEs）支配的物理系统的动态演化。尽管现有方法主要关注从目标PDE学习模拟，但它们常常忽视这些方程背后更基本的物理原理。受数值求解器与不同设置的PDE模拟兼容性的启发，我们提出了一种多物理训练框架，该框架同时从原始PDE及其简化的基础形式中进行学习。我们的框架提高了数据效率，减少了预测误差，并增强了分布外（OOD）的泛化能力，特别是在涉及物理参数变化和从合成到真实数据迁移的场景中。我们的方法与架构无关，并在广泛的1D/2D/3D PDE问题中展示了归一化均方根误差（nRMSE）的一致改进。通过大量实验，我们证明了显式纳入基本物理知识显著增强了神经算子的泛化能力。我们将在https://sites.google.com/view/sciml-fundemental-pde上发布模型和代码。

articles.title: COMPOT: Calibration-Optimized Matrix Procrustes Orthogonalization for Transformers Compression
articles.author: Denis Makhov, Dmitriy Shopkhoev, Magauiya Zhussip, Ammar Ali, Baher Mohammad, Stamatios Lefkimmiatis
articles.summary: Post-training compression of Transformer models commonly relies on truncated singular value decomposition (SVD). However, enforcing a single shared subspace can degrade accuracy even at moderate compression. Sparse dictionary learning provides a more flexible union-of-subspaces representation, but existing approaches often suffer from iterative dictionary and coefficient updates. We propose COMPOT (Calibration-Optimized Matrix Procrustes Orthogonalization for Transformers), a training-free compression framework that uses a small calibration dataset to estimate a sparse weight factorization. COMPOT employs orthogonal dictionaries that enable closed-form Procrustes updates for the dictionary and analytical single-step sparse coding for the coefficients, eliminating iterative optimization. To handle heterogeneous layer sensitivity under a global compression budget, COMPOT further introduces a one-shot dynamic allocation strategy that adaptively redistributes layer-wise compression rates. Extensive experiments across diverse architectures and tasks show that COMPOT consistently delivers a superior quality-compression trade-off over strong low-rank and sparse baselines, while remaining fully compatible with post-training quantization for extreme compression. Code is available $\href{https://github.com/mts-ai/COMPOT}{here}$.
articles.content: Transformer模型的后训练压缩通常依赖于截断奇异值分解（SVD）。然而，强制使用单一共享子空间即使在中等压缩率下也可能降低准确性。稀疏字典学习提供了一种更灵活的子空间联合表示，但现有方法通常受到迭代字典和系数更新的困扰。我们提出了COMPOT（用于Transformer的校准优化矩阵Procrustes正交化），这是一种无需训练的压缩框架，它使用一个小的校准数据集来估计稀疏权重分解。COMPOT采用正交字典，使得字典的闭式Procrustes更新和系数的解析单步稀疏编码成为可能，从而消除了迭代优化。为了在全局压缩预算下处理不同层的敏感性，COMPOT进一步引入了一种一次性动态分配策略，能够自适应地重新分配各层的压缩率。在多种架构和任务上的大量实验表明，COMPOT在强低秩和稀疏基线之上始终能提供更优的质量-压缩权衡，同时仍能与后训练量化完全兼容，以实现极端压缩。代码可在$\href{https://github.com/mts-ai/COMPOT}{这里}$获取。

articles.title: MAVRL: Learning Reward Functions from Multiple Feedback Types with Amortized Variational Inference
articles.author: Raphaël Baur, Yannick Metz, Maria Gkoulta, Mennatallah El-Assady, Giorgia Ramponi, Thomas Kleine Buening
articles.summary: Reward learning typically relies on a single feedback type or combines multiple feedback types using manually weighted loss terms. Currently, it remains unclear how to jointly learn reward functions from heterogeneous feedback types such as demonstrations, comparisons, ratings, and stops that provide qualitatively different signals. We address this challenge by formulating reward learning from multiple feedback types as Bayesian inference over a shared latent reward function, where each feedback type contributes information through an explicit likelihood. We introduce a scalable amortized variational inference approach that learns a shared reward encoder and feedback-specific likelihood decoders and is trained by optimizing a single evidence lower bound. Our approach avoids reducing feedback to a common intermediate representation and eliminates the need for manual loss balancing. Across discrete and continuous-control benchmarks, we show that jointly inferred reward posteriors outperform single-type baselines, exploit complementary information across feedback types, and yield policies that are more robust to environment perturbations. The inferred reward uncertainty further provides interpretable signals for analyzing model confidence and consistency across feedback types.
articles.content: 奖励学习通常依赖于单一的反馈类型，或通过手动加权的损失项结合多种反馈类型。目前，如何从提供定性不同信号的异构反馈类型（如演示、比较、评分和停止）中联合学习奖励函数仍不清楚。我们通过将多种反馈类型的奖励学习公式化为对共享潜在奖励函数的贝叶斯推断来解决这一挑战，其中每种反馈类型通过显式的似然性提供信息。我们引入了一种可扩展的 amortized 变分推断方法，该方法学习共享的奖励编码器和特定反馈类型的似然解码器，并通过优化单一的证据下界进行训练。我们的方法避免将反馈简化为共同的中间表示，并消除了手动损失平衡的需要。在离散和连续控制的基准测试中，我们证明联合推断的奖励后验优于单一类型的基线，能够利用不同反馈类型之间的互补信息，并产生对环境扰动更具鲁棒性的策略。推断出的奖励不确定性进一步提供了可解释的信号，用于分析模型在不同反馈类型下的置信度和一致性。

articles.title: Automatically Finding Reward Model Biases
articles.author: Atticus Wang, Iván Arcuschin, Arthur Conmy
articles.summary: Reward models are central to large language model (LLM) post-training. However, past work has shown that they can reward spurious or undesirable attributes such as length, format, hallucinations, and sycophancy. In this work, we introduce and study the research problem of automatically finding reward model biases in natural language. We offer a simple approach of using an LLM to iteratively propose and refine candidate biases. Our method can recover known biases and surface novel ones: for example, we found that Skywork-V2-8B, a leading open-weight reward model, often mistakenly favors responses with redundant spacing and responses with hallucinated content. In addition, we show evidence that evolutionary iteration outperforms flat best-of-N search, and we validate the recall of our pipeline using synthetically injected biases. We hope our work contributes to further research on improving RMs through automated interpretability methods.
articles.content: 奖励模型是大型语言模型（LLM）后训练的核心。然而，过去的研究表明，它们可能会奖励一些虚假或不期望的属性，如长度、格式、幻觉和谄媚行为。在本研究中，我们引入并研究了自动发现自然语言中奖励模型偏见的研究问题。我们提出了一种简单的方法，使用LLM迭代地提出和优化候选偏见。我们的方法可以恢复已知的偏见并揭示新的偏见：例如，我们发现Skywork-V2-8B，一个领先的开源权重奖励模型，经常错误地倾向于具有冗余空格和包含幻觉内容的响应。此外，我们展示了进化迭代优于平铺的最佳N搜索的证据，并通过合成注入的偏见验证了我们流程的召回率。我们希望我们的工作能促进通过自动化可解释性方法进一步改进奖励模型的研究。

articles.title: BindCLIP: A Unified Contrastive-Generative Representation Learning Framework for Virtual Screening
articles.author: Anjie Qiao, Zhen Wang, Yaliang Li, Jiahua Rao, Yuedong Yang
articles.summary: Virtual screening aims to efficiently identify active ligands from massive chemical libraries for a given target pocket. Recent CLIP-style models such as DrugCLIP enable scalable virtual screening by embedding pockets and ligands into a shared space. However, our analyses indicate that such representations can be insensitive to fine-grained binding interactions and may rely on shortcut correlations in training data, limiting their ability to rank ligands by true binding compatibility. To address these issues, we propose BindCLIP, a unified contrastive-generative representation learning framework for virtual screening. BindCLIP jointly trains pocket and ligand encoders using CLIP-style contrastive learning together with a pocket-conditioned diffusion objective for binding pose generation, so that pose-level supervision directly shapes the retrieval embedding space toward interaction-relevant features. To further mitigate shortcut reliance, we introduce hard-negative augmentation and a ligand-ligand anchoring regularizer that prevents representation collapse. Experiments on two public benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines. BindCLIP achieves substantial gains on challenging out-of-distribution virtual screening and improves ligand-analogue ranking on the FEP+ benchmark. Together, these results indicate that integrating generative, pose-level supervision with contrastive learning yields more interaction-aware embeddings and improves generalization in realistic screening settings, bringing virtual screening closer to real-world applicability.
articles.content: 虚拟筛选旨在从大量化学库中高效识别针对特定靶标口袋的活性配体。近期的CLIP风格模型如DrugCLIP通过将口袋和配体嵌入到共享空间中，实现了可扩展的虚拟筛选。然而，我们的分析表明，此类表示可能对精细的结合相互作用不敏感，并可能依赖于训练数据中的捷径相关性，限制了它们根据真实结合兼容性对配体进行排序的能力。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了BindCLIP，一个用于虚拟筛选的统一的对比生成表示学习框架。BindCLIP通过CLIP风格的对比学习与一个以口袋为条件的扩散目标联合训练口袋和配体编码器，用于生成结合构象，从而使构象级别的监督直接塑造检索嵌入空间，使其朝向与相互作用相关的特征。为了进一步缓解对捷径的依赖，我们引入了硬负样本增强和一种配体-配体锚定正则化器，以防止表示崩溃。在两个公开基准上的实验表明，BindCLIP在强基线方法上表现一致的改进。BindCLIP在具有挑战性的分布外虚拟筛选任务中取得了显著的提升，并在FEP+基准上改善了配体类似物的排序。综上所述，这些结果表明，将生成的、构象级别的监督与对比学习相结合，可以产生更关注相互作用的嵌入表示，并在实际筛选设置中提高泛化能力，使虚拟筛选更接近实际应用。

articles.title: Size Transferability of Graph Transformers with Convolutional Positional Encodings
articles.author: Javier Porras-Valenzuela, Zhiyang Wang, Alejandro Ribeiro
articles.summary: Transformers have achieved remarkable success across domains, motivating the rise of Graph Transformers (GTs) as attention-based architectures for graph-structured data. A key design choice in GTs is the use of Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based positional encodings to incorporate structural information. In this work, we study GTs through the lens of manifold limit models for graph sequences and establish a theoretical connection between GTs with GNN positional encodings and Manifold Neural Networks (MNNs). Building on transferability results for GNNs under manifold convergence, we show that GTs inherit transferability guarantees from their positional encodings. In particular, GTs trained on small graphs provably generalize to larger graphs under mild assumptions. We complement our theory with extensive experiments on standard graph benchmarks, demonstrating that GTs exhibit scalable behavior on par with GNNs. To further show the efficiency in a real-world scenario, we implement GTs for shortest path distance estimation over terrains to better illustrate the efficiency of the transferable GTs. Our results provide new insights into the understanding of GTs and suggest practical directions for efficient training of GTs in large-scale settings.
articles.content: Transformer在各个领域都取得了显著的成功，这促使了图Transformer（GTs）的兴起，作为基于注意力机制的图结构数据架构。GTs的一个关键设计选择是使用基于图神经网络（GNN）的位置编码来融入结构信息。在本研究中，我们通过图序列的流形极限模型来研究GTs，并建立了带有GNN位置编码的GTs与流形神经网络（MNNs）之间的理论联系。基于GNN在流形收敛下的可迁移性结果，我们证明GTs继承了其位置编码的可迁移性保证。特别是，在温和的假设下，训练在小图上的GTs可以证明其能够泛化到更大的图上。我们通过在标准图基准数据集上的大量实验来补充我们的理论，证明GTs在可扩展性方面与GNNs相当。为了进一步展示在现实场景中的效率，我们实现了GTs用于地形上的最短路径距离估计，以更好地说明可迁移GTs的效率。我们的结果为理解GTs提供了新的见解，并为在大规模场景中高效训练GTs提供了实际的方向。

articles.title: Scaling Laws for Masked-Reconstruction Transformers on Single-Cell Transcriptomics
articles.author: Ihor Kendiukhov
articles.summary: Neural scaling laws -- power-law relationships between loss, model size, and data -- have been extensively documented for language and vision transformers, yet their existence in single-cell genomics remains largely unexplored. We present the first systematic study of scaling behaviour for masked-reconstruction transformers trained on single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data. Using expression profiles from the CELLxGENE Census, we construct two experimental regimes: a data-rich regime (512 highly variable genes, 200,000 cells) and a data-limited regime (1,024 genes, 10,000 cells). Across seven model sizes spanning three orders of magnitude in parameter count (533 to 3.4 x 10^8 parameters), we fit the parametric scaling law to validation mean squared error (MSE). The data-rich regime exhibits clear power-law scaling with an irreducible loss floor of c ~ 1.44, while the data-limited regime shows negligible scaling, indicating that model capacity is not the binding constraint when data are scarce. These results establish that scaling laws analogous to those observed in natural language processing do emerge in single-cell transcriptomics when sufficient data are available, and they identify the data-to-parameter ratio as a critical determinant of scaling behaviour. A preliminary conversion of the data-rich asymptotic floor to information-theoretic units yields an estimate of approximately 2.30 bits of entropy per masked gene position. We discuss implications for the design of single-cell foundation models and outline the additional measurements needed to refine this entropy estimate.
articles.content: 神经网络扩展定律——损失、模型规模和数据之间的幂律关系——在语言和视觉Transformer中已被广泛研究，但在单细胞基因组学中仍鲜有探索。我们首次系统研究了在单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据上训练的掩码重建Transformer的扩展行为。利用CELLxGENE Census中的表达谱，我们构建了两种实验场景：数据丰富的场景（512个高度可变基因，20万个细胞）和数据有限的场景（1024个基因，1万个细胞）。在跨越三个数量级参数数量（533到3.4×10^8个参数）的七种模型规模上，我们将参数扩展定律拟合到验证均方误差（MSE）上。数据丰富的场景表现出明显的幂律扩展，不可约损失底限为c≈1.44，而数据有限的场景则显示出可忽略的扩展，表明当数据稀缺时，模型容量并非限制因素。这些结果表明，当数据充足时，类似于自然语言处理中观察到的扩展定律在单细胞转录组学中确实存在，并且确定了数据与参数的比例是扩展行为的关键决定因素。初步将数据丰富的渐近底限转换为信息论单位，得出每个被掩码基因位置的熵估计约为2.30比特。我们讨论了这些结果对单细胞基础模型设计的启示，并概述了进一步测量以完善这一熵估计所需的额外测量。

articles.title: Fast and Effective On-policy Distillation from Reasoning Prefixes
articles.author: Dongxu Zhang, Zhichao Yang, Sepehr Janghorbani, Jun Han, Andrew Ressler, Qian Qian, Gregory D. Lyng, Sanjit Singh Batra, Robert E. Tillman
articles.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD), which samples trajectories from the student model and supervises them with a teacher at the token level, avoids relying solely on verifiable terminal rewards and can yield better generalization than off-policy distillation. However, OPD requires expensive on-the-fly sampling of the student policy during training, which substantially increases training cost, especially for long responses. Our initial analysis shows that, during OPD, training signals are often concentrated in the prefix of each output, and that even a short teacher-generated prefix can significantly help the student produce the correct answer. Motivated by these observations, we propose a simple yet effective modification of OPD: we apply the distillation objective only to prefixes of student-generated outputs and terminate each sampling early during distillation. Experiments on a suite of AI-for-Math and out-of-domain benchmarks show that on-policy prefix distillation matches the performance of full OPD while reducing training FLOP by 2x-47x.
articles.content: 基于策略的知识蒸馏（OPD）通过从学生模型中采样轨迹，并在标记级别上由教师模型进行监督，避免了仅依赖可验证的终端奖励，相比离线策略蒸馏可以实现更好的泛化能力。然而，OPD在训练过程中需要对学生的策略进行昂贵的实时采样，这大大增加了训练成本，尤其是在生成长响应时。我们的初步分析表明，在OPD过程中，训练信号通常集中在每个输出的前缀部分，即使是一个简短的教师生成的前缀也能显著帮助学生生成正确答案。受这些观察的启发，我们提出了一种对OPD的简单而有效的改进方法：我们仅将蒸馏目标应用于学生生成输出的前缀部分，并在蒸馏过程中提前终止每次采样。在一系列数学AI和领域外基准测试中的实验表明，基于策略的前缀蒸馏在性能上与完整的OPD相当，同时将训练FLOP减少了2到47倍。

articles.title: Complex-Valued Unitary Representations as Classification Heads for Improved Uncertainty Quantification in Deep Neural Networks
articles.author: Akbar Anbar Jafari, Cagri Ozcinar, Gholamreza Anbarjafari
articles.summary: Modern deep neural networks achieve high predictive accuracy but remain poorly calibrated: their confidence scores do not reliably reflect the true probability of correctness. We propose a quantum-inspired classification head architecture that projects backbone features into a complex-valued Hilbert space and evolves them under a learned unitary transformation parameterised via the Cayley map. Through a controlled hybrid experimental design - training a single shared backbone and comparing lightweight interchangeable heads - we isolate the effect of complex-valued unitary representations on calibration. Our ablation study on CIFAR-10 reveals that the unitary magnitude head (complex features evolved under a Cayley unitary, read out via magnitude and softmax) achieves an Expected Calibration Error (ECE) of 0.0146, representing a 2.4x improvement over a standard softmax head (0.0355) and a 3.5x improvement over temperature scaling (0.0510). Surprisingly, replacing the softmax readout with a Born rule measurement layer - the quantum-mechanically motivated approach - degrades calibration to an ECE of 0.0819. On the CIFAR-10H human-uncertainty benchmark, the wave function head achieves the lowest KL-divergence (0.336) to human soft labels among all compared methods, indicating that complex-valued representations better capture the structure of human perceptual ambiguity. We provide theoretical analysis connecting norm-preserving unitary dynamics to calibration through feature-space geometry, report negative results on out-of-distribution detection and sentiment analysis to delineate the method's scope, and discuss practical implications for safety-critical applications. Code is publicly available.
articles.content: 现代深度神经网络虽然能够实现高预测准确性，但其校准效果较差：它们的置信度评分并不能可靠地反映正确性的真正概率。我们提出了一种受量子启发的分类头架构，该架构将主干特征投影到复值希尔伯特空间，并在通过凯莱映射参数化的学习酉变换下进行演化。通过一种受控的混合实验设计——训练一个共享的主干并比较轻量级可互换的头部——我们隔离了复值酉表示对校准的影响。我们在CIFAR-10上的消融研究显示，酉幅度头部（在凯莱酉变换下演化复值特征，通过幅度和softmax进行读出）实现了预期校准误差（ECE）为0.0146，相比标准softmax头部（0.0355）提高了2.4倍，相比温度缩放（0.0510）提高了3.5倍。令人惊讶的是，将softmax读出替换为Born规则测量层——一种受量子力学启发的方法——使校准性能下降到ECE为0.0819。在CIFAR-10H人类不确定性基准测试中，波函数头部在所有比较方法中实现了最低的KL散度（0.336）到人类软标签，表明复值表示更好地捕捉了人类感知模糊的结构。我们提供了将保持范数的酉动力学与校准通过特征空间几何联系起来的理论分析，报告了在分布外检测和情感分析中的负面结果以界定该方法的适用范围，并讨论了对安全关键应用的实践影响。代码已公开。

articles.title: The Information Geometry of Softmax: Probing and Steering
articles.author: Kiho Park, Todd Nief, Yo Joong Choe, Victor Veitch
articles.summary: This paper concerns the question of how AI systems encode semantic structure into the geometric structure of their representation spaces. The motivating observation of this paper is that the natural geometry of these representation spaces should reflect the way models use representations to produce behavior. We focus on the important special case of representations that define softmax distributions. In this case, we argue that the natural geometry is information geometry. Our focus is on the role of information geometry on semantic encoding and the linear representation hypothesis. As an illustrative application, we develop "dual steering", a method for robustly steering representations to exhibit a particular concept using linear probes. We prove that dual steering optimally modifies the target concept while minimizing changes to off-target concepts. Empirically, we find that dual steering enhances the controllability and stability of concept manipulation.
articles.content: 本文关注人工智能系统如何将语义结构编码到其表示空间的几何结构中。本文的出发点是，这些表示空间的自然几何结构应该反映出模型使用表示来产生行为的方式。我们重点关注表示定义softmax分布这一重要特殊情况。在这种情况下，我们认为自然几何结构是信息几何。我们的重点是信息几何在语义编码和线性表示假设中的作用。作为一项示例应用，我们开发了“双引导”方法，这是一种使用线性探针稳健地引导表示以表现出特定概念的方法。我们证明，双引导方法在最小化对非目标概念的影响的同时，能够最优地修改目标概念。实证研究表明，双引导方法增强了概念操控的可控性和稳定性。

articles.title: Hybrid Federated and Split Learning for Privacy Preserving Clinical Prediction and Treatment Optimization
articles.author: Farzana Akter, Rakib Hossain, Deb Kanna Roy Toushi, Mahmood Menon Khan, Sultana Amin, Lisan Al Amin
articles.summary: Collaborative clinical decision support is often constrained by governance and privacy rules that prevent pooling patient-level records across institutions. We present a hybrid privacy-preserving framework that combines Federated Learning (FL) and Split Learning (SL) to support decision-oriented healthcare modeling without raw-data sharing. The approach keeps feature-extraction trunks on clients while hosting prediction heads on a coordinating server, enabling shared representation learning and exposing an explicit collaboration boundary where privacy controls can be applied. Rather than assuming distributed training is inherently private, we audit leakage empirically using membership inference on cut-layer representations and study lightweight defenses based on activation clipping and additive Gaussian noise. We evaluate across three public clinical datasets under non-IID client partitions using a unified pipeline and assess performance jointly along four deployment-relevant axes: factual predictive utility, uplift-based ranking under capacity constraints, audited privacy leakage, and communication overhead. Results show that hybrid FL-SL variants achieve competitive predictive performance and decision-facing prioritization behavior relative to standalone FL or SL, while providing a tunable privacy-utility trade-off that can reduce audited leakage without requiring raw-data sharing.
