In this case study, we use the unifying framework of approximate Bayesian inference combined with empirical tests on carefully created synthetic classification datasets to investigate qualitative properties of six different probabilistic machine learning algorithms for class probability and uncertainty estimation: (i) a neural network ensemble, (ii) neural network ensemble with conflictual loss, (iii) evidential deep learning, (iv) a single neural network with Monte Carlo Dropout, (v) Gaussian process classification and (vi) a Dirichlet process mixture model. We check if the algorithms produce uncertainty estimates which reflect commonly desired properties, such as being well calibrated and exhibiting an increase in uncertainty for out-of-distribution data points. Our results indicate that all algorithms show reasonably good calibration performance on our synthetic test sets, but none of the deep learning based algorithms provide uncertainties that consistently reflect lack of experimental evidence for out-of-distribution data points. We hope our study may serve as a clarifying example for researchers that are using or developing methods of uncertainty estimation for scientific data-driven modeling and analysis.
articles.content: 严谨的统计方法，包括带有相应不确定性的参数估计，是科学发现有效性的基础，尤其是在自然科学领域。随着深度学习等日益复杂的数据模型的出现，不确定性量化变得极为困难，因此提出了大量相关技术。在本案例研究中，我们采用近似贝叶斯推断的统一框架，结合对精心构建的合成分类数据集进行实证测试，研究六种不同的概率机器学习算法在类别概率和不确定性估计方面的定性特性：（i）神经网络集成，（ii）带有冲突损失的神经网络集成，（iii）证据深度学习，（iv）带有蒙特卡洛Dropout的单个神经网络，（v）高斯过程分类，（vi）狄利克雷过程混合模型。我们检查这些算法是否产生符合常见期望特性的不确定性估计，例如校准良好，并在分布外数据点上表现出不确定性增加。我们的结果表明，所有算法在我们的合成测试集上都表现出合理的校准性能，但基于深度学习的算法均未能一致地反映出分布外数据点缺乏实验证据的不确定性。我们希望本研究能为那些使用或开发用于科学数据驱动建模和分析的不确定性估计方法的研究人员提供一个明确的示例。

articles.title: A XAI-based Framework for Frequency Subband Characterization of Cough Spectrograms in Chronic Respiratory Disease
articles.author: Patricia Amado-Caballero, Luis M. San-José-Revuelta, Xinheng Wang, José Ramón Garmendia-Leiza, Carlos Alberola-López, Pablo Casaseca-de-la-Higuera
articles.summary: This paper presents an explainable artificial intelligence (XAI)-based framework for the spectral analysis of cough sounds associated with chronic respiratory diseases, with a particular focus on Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD). A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is trained on time-frequency representations of cough signals, and occlusion maps are used to identify diagnostically relevant regions within the spectrograms. These highlighted areas are subsequently decomposed into five frequency subbands, enabling targeted spectral feature extraction and analysis. The results reveal that spectral patterns differ across subbands and disease groups, uncovering complementary and compensatory trends across the frequency spectrum. Noteworthy, the approach distinguishes COPD from other respiratory conditions, and chronic from non-chronic patient groups, based on interpretable spectral markers. These findings provide insight into the underlying pathophysiological characteristics of cough acoustics and demonstrate the value of frequency-resolved, XAI-enhanced analysis for biomedical signal interpretation and translational respiratory disease diagnostics.
articles.content: 本文提出了一种基于可解释人工智能（XAI）的框架，用于分析与慢性呼吸系统疾病（特别是慢性阻塞性肺病，COPD）相关的咳嗽声音的光谱特征。该框架使用卷积神经网络（CNN）对咳嗽信号的时间-频率表示进行训练，并利用遮挡图来识别光谱图中具有诊断意义的区域。这些突出显示的区域随后被分解为五个频率子带，从而实现有针对性的光谱特征提取和分析。结果表明，不同子带和疾病组之间的光谱模式存在差异，揭示了在整个频率谱中互补和补偿的趋势。值得注意的是，该方法基于可解释的光谱标记，能够区分COPD与其他呼吸系统疾病，以及慢性与非慢性患者群体。这些发现为咳嗽声学的潜在病理生理特征提供了见解，并展示了频率解析、XAI增强分析在生物医学信号解释和转化呼吸系统疾病诊断中的价值。

articles.title: Out of Distribution Detection for Efficient Continual Learning in Quality Prediction for Arc Welding
articles.author: Yannik Hahn, Jan Voets, Antonin Koenigsfeld, Hasan Tercan, Tobias Meisen
articles.summary: Modern manufacturing relies heavily on fusion welding processes, including gas metal arc welding (GMAW). Despite significant advances in machine learning-based quality prediction, current models exhibit critical limitations when confronted with the inherent distribution shifts that occur in dynamic manufacturing environments. In this work, we extend the VQ-VAE Transformer architecture - previously demonstrating state-of-the-art performance in weld quality prediction - by leveraging its autoregressive loss as a reliable out-of-distribution (OOD) detection mechanism. Our approach exhibits superior performance compared to conventional reconstruction methods, embedding error-based techniques, and other established baselines. By integrating OOD detection with continual learning strategies, we optimize model adaptation, triggering updates only when necessary and thereby minimizing costly labeling requirements. We introduce a novel quantitative metric that simultaneously evaluates OOD detection capability while interpreting in-distribution performance. Experimental validation in real-world welding scenarios demonstrates that our framework effectively maintains robust quality prediction capabilities across significant distribution shifts, addressing critical challenges in dynamic manufacturing environments where process parameters frequently change. This research makes a substantial contribution to applied artificial intelligence by providing an explainable and at the same time adaptive solution for quality assurance in dynamic manufacturing processes - a crucial step towards robust, practical AI systems in the industrial environment.
articles.content: 现代制造高度依赖于熔融焊接工艺，包括气体金属电弧焊（GMAW）。尽管基于机器学习的质量预测方法取得了显著进展，但当前模型在面对动态制造环境中固有的分布变化时仍存在关键性限制。在本研究中，我们扩展了先前在焊接质量预测中表现出最先进性能的VQ-VAE Transformer架构，通过利用其自回归损失作为可靠的分布外（OOD）检测机制。与传统重建方法、基于嵌入误差的技术以及其他已建立的基线方法相比，我们的方法表现出更优越的性能。通过将OOD检测与持续学习策略相结合，我们优化了模型的适应能力，仅在必要时触发更新，从而最大限度地减少昂贵的标注需求。我们引入了一种新的定量指标，可以同时评估OOD检测能力并解释分布内性能。在现实焊接场景中的实验验证表明，我们的框架能够有效维持在显著分布变化下的稳健质量预测能力，解决了在动态制造环境中工艺参数频繁变化所面临的重大挑战。这项研究通过提供一种可解释且适应性强的解决方案，为动态制造过程中的质量保证做出了重要贡献，这是工业环境中实现稳健、实用人工智能系统的重要一步。

articles.title: Randomness and signal propagation in physics-informed neural networks (PINNs): A neural PDE perspective
articles.author: Jean-Michel Tucny, Abhisek Ganguly, Santosh Ansumali, Sauro Succi
articles.summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) often exhibit weight matrices that appear statistically random after training, yet their implications for signal propagation and stability remain unsatisfactorily understood, let alone the interpretability. In this work, we analyze the spectral and statistical properties of trained PINN weights using viscous and inviscid variants of the one-dimensional Burgers' equation, and show that the learned weights reside in a high-entropy regime consistent with predictions from random matrix theory. To investigate the dynamical consequences of such weight structures, we study the evolution of signal features inside a network through the lens of neural partial differential equations (neural PDEs). We show that random and structured weight matrices can be associated with specific discretizations of neural PDEs, and that the numerical stability of these discretizations governs the stability of signal propagation through the network. In particular, explicit unstable schemes lead to degraded signal evolution, whereas stable implicit and higher-order schemes yield well-behaved dynamics for the same underlying neural PDE. Our results offer an explicit example of how numerical stability and network architecture shape signal propagation in deep networks, in relation to random matrix and neural PDE descriptions in PINNs.
articles.content: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在训练后通常表现出统计上看似随机的权重矩阵，但其对信号传播和稳定性的影响仍未能得到充分理解，更不用说可解释性了。在本研究中，我们使用一维Burgers方程的粘性和无粘性变体，分析训练后的PINN权重的谱和统计特性，并表明学习到的权重处于与随机矩阵理论预测一致的高熵区域。为了研究这种权重结构的动态后果，我们通过神经偏微分方程（neural PDEs）的视角，研究网络内部信号特征的演化。我们表明，随机和结构化的权重矩阵可以与特定的神经PDE离散化方法相关联，并且这些离散化的数值稳定性决定了信号通过网络传播的稳定性。特别是，显式不稳定方案会导致信号演化的退化，而稳定隐式和高阶方案则为相同的底层神经PDE提供了良好行为的动力学。我们的研究结果提供了一个明确的例子，说明数值稳定性和网络架构如何影响深度网络中的信号传播，与PINNs中的随机矩阵和神经PDE描述相关。

articles.title: GenFacts-Generative Counterfactual Explanations for Multi-Variate Time Series
articles.author: Sarah Seifi, Anass Ibrahimi, Tobias Sukianto, Cecilia Carbonelli, Lorenzo Servadei, Robert Wille
articles.summary: Counterfactual explanations aim to enhance model transparency by showing how inputs can be minimally altered to change predictions. For multivariate time series, existing methods often generate counterfactuals that are invalid, implausible, or unintuitive. We introduce GenFacts, a generative framework based on a class-discriminative variational autoencoder. It integrates contrastive and classification-consistency objectives, prototype-based initialization, and realism-constrained optimization. We evaluate GenFacts on radar gesture data as an industrial use case and handwritten letter trajectories as an intuitive benchmark. Across both datasets, GenFacts outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in plausibility (+18.7%) and achieves the highest interpretability scores in a human study. These results highlight that plausibility and user-centered interpretability, rather than sparsity alone, are key to actionable counterfactuals in time series data.
articles.content: 反事实解释旨在通过展示如何对输入进行最小的修改以改变预测结果，从而提高模型的透明度。对于多变量时间序列，现有方法通常生成无效、不可信或不合逻辑的反事实。我们引入了GenFacts，这是一个基于类别判别变分自编码器的生成框架。它结合了对比目标、分类一致性目标、基于原型的初始化和现实约束优化。我们在雷达手势数据（作为工业应用案例）和手写字母轨迹（作为直观基准）上对GenFacts进行了评估。在两个数据集上，GenFacts在可信度方面优于最先进的基线方法（+18.7%），并在一项人类研究中取得了最高的可解释性评分。这些结果表明，可信度和以用户为中心的可解释性，而非稀疏性本身，是时间序列数据中可操作反事实的关键。

articles.title: Learning Admissible Heuristics for A*: Theory and Practice
articles.author: Ehsan Futuhi, Nathan R. Sturtevant
articles.summary: Heuristic functions are central to the performance of search algorithms such as A-star, where admissibility - the property of never overestimating the true shortest-path cost - guarantees solution optimality. Recent deep learning approaches often disregard admissibility and provide limited guarantees on generalization beyond the training data. This paper addresses both of these limitations. First, we pose heuristic learning as a constrained optimization problem and introduce Cross-Entropy Admissibility (CEA), a loss function that enforces admissibility during training. On the Rubik's Cube domain, this method yields near-admissible heuristics with significantly stronger guidance than compressed pattern database (PDB) heuristics. Theoretically, we study the sample complexity of learning heuristics. By leveraging PDB abstractions and the structural properties of graphs such as the Rubik's Cube, we tighten the bound on the number of training samples needed for A-star to generalize. Replacing a general hypothesis class with a ReLU neural network gives bounds that depend primarily on the network's width and depth, rather than on graph size. Using the same network, we also provide the first generalization guarantees for goal-dependent heuristics.
articles.content: 启发式函数对于A星等搜索算法的性能至关重要，其中可采纳性——即从不高估真实最短路径成本的特性——保证了求解的最优性。最近的深度学习方法通常忽视可采纳性，并且对超出训练数据的泛化能力提供有限的保证。本文解决了这两个限制。首先，我们将启发式学习表述为一个受约束的优化问题，并引入交叉熵可采纳性（CEA），这是一种在训练过程中强制执行可采纳性的损失函数。在魔方领域，该方法生成的启发式函数接近可采纳性，其指导作用显著强于压缩模式数据库（PDB）启发式函数。理论上，我们研究了学习启发式函数的样本复杂度。通过利用PDB抽象和图的结构特性（如魔方），我们收紧了A星算法泛化所需的训练样本数量的界限。将一般的假设类替换为ReLU神经网络后，界限主要取决于网络的宽度和深度，而不是图的大小。使用相同的网络，我们还首次为依赖目标的启发式函数提供了泛化保证。

articles.title: Flock: A Knowledge Graph Foundation Model via Learning on Random Walks
articles.author: Jinwoo Kim, Xingyue Huang, Krzysztof Olejniczak, Kyungbin Min, Michael Bronstein, Seunghoon Hong, İsmail İlkan Ceylan
articles.summary: We study the problem of zero-shot link prediction on knowledge graphs (KGs), which requires models to generalize to novel entities and novel relations. Knowledge graph foundation models (KGFMs) address this task by enforcing equivariance over both nodes and relations, which enables them to learn structural properties of nodes and relations that transfer to novel KGs with similar structure. However, the conventional notion of deterministic equivariance inherently limits the expressive power of KGFMs, as it prevents them from distinguishing relations that are structurally similar but semantically distinct. To overcome this limitation, we propose to leverage probabilistic node-relation equivariance, which preserves equivariance in distribution while using structured randomness to break symmetries at inference time. Building on this principle, we present Flock, a KGFM that iteratively samples random walks, encodes them into sequences, embeds them with a sequence model, and aggregates node and relation representations through learned pooling. Flock respects probabilistic node-relation equivariance and, crucially, is a universal approximator for isomorphism-invariant link-level functions over KGs. Empirically, Flock perfectly solves our new diagnostic dataset Petals on which current KGFMs fail, and achieves state-of-the-art performance on entity and relation prediction tasks across 54 KGs from diverse domains. Code is available at https://github.com/jw9730/flock.
articles.content: 我们研究知识图谱（KGs）上的零样本链接预测问题，该问题要求模型能够泛化到新的实体和新的关系。知识图谱基础模型（KGFMs）通过在节点和关系上强制实现等变性来解决这一任务，这使它们能够学习节点和关系的结构属性，并将其转移到具有相似结构的新知识图谱中。然而，传统的确定性等变性概念本质上限制了KGFMs的表达能力，因为它阻止它们区分结构相似但语义不同的关系。为了克服这一限制，我们提出利用概率节点-关系等变性，它在分布中保持等变性，同时使用结构化随机性在推理时打破对称性。基于这一原则，我们提出了Flock，这是一种KGFM，它通过迭代采样随机游走，将其编码为序列，使用序列模型进行嵌入，并通过学习的池化操作聚合节点和关系表示。Flock尊重概率节点-关系等变性，并且关键的是，它是知识图谱上同构不变链接级函数的通用逼近器。实证研究表明，Flock完美解决了我们新构建的诊断数据集Petals，而当前的KGFMs在该数据集上失败，并在来自不同领域的54个知识图谱的实体和关系预测任务中实现了最先进的性能。代码可在https://github.com/jw9730/flock获取。

articles.title: TabImpute: Universal Zero-Shot Imputation for Tabular Data
articles.author: Jacob Feitelberg, Dwaipayan Saha, Kyuseong Choi, Zaid Ahmad, Anish Agarwal, Raaz Dwivedi
articles.summary: Missing data is a widespread problem in tabular settings. Existing solutions range from simple averaging to complex generative adversarial networks, but due to each method's large variance in performance across real-world domains and time-consuming hyperparameter tuning, no universal imputation method exists. This performance variance is particularly pronounced in small datasets, where the models have the least amount of information. Building on TabPFN, a recent tabular foundation model for supervised learning, we propose TabImpute, a pre-trained transformer that delivers accurate and fast zero-shot imputations, requiring no fitting or hyperparameter tuning at inference time. To train and evaluate TabImpute, we introduce (i) an entry-wise featurization for tabular settings, enabling a 100x speedup over the previous TabPFN imputation method, (ii) a synthetic training data generation pipeline incorporating a diverse set of missingness patterns to enhance accuracy on real-world missing data problems, and (iii) MissBench, a comprehensive benchmark with 42 OpenML tables and 13 new missingness patterns. MissBench spans domains such as medicine, finance, and engineering, showcasing TabImpute's robust performance compared to numerous established imputation methods.
articles.content: 在表格数据中，缺失数据是一个普遍存在的问题。现有的解决方案从简单的平均方法到复杂的生成对抗网络不等，但由于每种方法在现实世界不同领域中的性能差异较大，且需要耗费大量时间进行超参数调整，因此不存在一种通用的填补方法。这种性能差异在小数据集中尤为明显，因为这些模型所拥有的信息最少。基于最近用于监督学习的表格基础模型TabPFN，我们提出了TabImpute，这是一种预训练的Transformer模型，能够实现准确且快速的零样本填补，无需在推理时进行拟合或超参数调整。为了训练和评估TabImpute，我们引入了以下内容：（i）一种针对表格数据的逐条特征化方法，使填补速度比之前的TabPFN方法提高了100倍；（ii）一个合成训练数据生成流程，包含多种缺失模式，以提高在现实世界缺失数据问题上的准确性；（iii）MissBench，一个包含42个OpenML表格和13种新缺失模式的综合性基准测试。MissBench涵盖了医学、金融和工程等多个领域，展示了TabImpute相比多种现有填补方法的稳健性能。

articles.title: General Exploratory Bonus for Optimistic Exploration in RLHF
articles.author: Wendi Li, Changdae Oh, Sharon Li
articles.summary: Optimistic exploration is central to improving sample efficiency in reinforcement learning with human feedback, yet existing exploratory bonus methods to incentivize exploration often fail to realize optimism. We provide a theoretical analysis showing that current formulations, under KL or $α$-divergence regularization, unintentionally bias exploration toward high-probability regions of the reference model, thereby reinforcing conservative behavior instead of promoting discovery of uncertain regions. To address this pitfall, we introduce the General Exploratory Bonus (GEB), a novel theoretical framework that provably satisfies the optimism principle. GEB counteracts divergence-induced bias via reference-dependent reward regulation and unifies prior heuristic bonuses as special cases, while extending naturally across the full $α$-divergence family. Empirically, GEB consistently outperforms baselines on alignment tasks across multiple divergence settings and large language model backbones. These results demonstrate that GEB offers both a principled and practical solution for optimistic exploration in RLHF.
articles.content: 在基于人类反馈的强化学习中，乐观探索对于提高样本效率至关重要，但现有的探索奖励方法往往无法实现乐观性。我们提供了一项理论分析，表明当前在KL散度或$α$-散度正则化下的方法，无意中将探索偏向于参考模型的高概率区域，从而强化了保守行为，而非促进对不确定区域的探索。为了解决这一缺陷，我们引入了通用探索奖励（GEB），这是一个新的理论框架，可以证明满足乐观原则。GEB通过基于参考的奖励调节来抵消散度引起的偏差，并将先前的启发式奖励作为特殊情况统一起来，同时自然地扩展到整个$α$-散度家族。实验证明，GEB在多种散度设置和大型语言模型主干的对齐任务中，始终优于基线方法。这些结果表明，GEB为基于人类反馈的强化学习中的乐观探索提供了既原理正确又实用的解决方案。

articles.title: Learning Pseudorandom Numbers with Transformers: Permuted Congruential Generators, Curricula, and Interpretability
articles.author: Tao Tao, Maissam Barkeshli
articles.summary: We study the ability of Transformer models to learn sequences generated by Permuted Congruential Generators (PCGs), a widely used family of pseudo-random number generators (PRNGs). PCGs introduce substantial additional difficulty over linear congruential generators (LCGs) by applying a series of bit-wise shifts, XORs, rotations and truncations to the hidden state. We show that Transformers can nevertheless successfully perform in-context prediction on unseen sequences from diverse PCG variants, in tasks that are beyond published classical attacks. In our experiments we scale moduli up to $2^{22}$ using up to $50$ million model parameters and datasets with up to $5$ billion tokens. Surprisingly, we find even when the output is truncated to a single bit, it can be reliably predicted by the model. When multiple distinct PRNGs are presented together during training, the model can jointly learn them, identifying structures from different permutations. We demonstrate a scaling law with modulus $m$: the number of in-context sequence elements required for near-perfect prediction grows as $\sqrt{m}$. For larger moduli, optimization enters extended stagnation phases; in our experiments, learning moduli $m \geq 2^{20}$ requires incorporating training data from smaller moduli, demonstrating a critical necessity for curriculum learning. Finally, we analyze embedding layers and uncover a novel clustering phenomenon: the top principal components spontaneously group the integer inputs into bitwise rotationally-invariant clusters, revealing how representations can transfer from smaller to larger moduli.
articles.content: 我们研究Transformer模型学习由置换同余生成器（PCG）生成序列的能力，PCG是一种广泛使用的伪随机数生成器（PRNG）家族。与线性同余生成器（LCG）相比，PCG通过对隐藏状态应用一系列位移、异或、旋转和截断操作，引入了显著的额外难度。我们证明，尽管存在这些挑战，Transformer模型仍然能够成功地对来自不同PCG变体的未见过序列进行上下文预测，其任务超越了已发表的经典攻击方法。在我们的实验中，我们将模数扩展到$2^{22}$，使用多达5000万模型参数和包含多达50亿个标记的数据集。令人惊讶的是，我们发现即使输出被截断为单个比特，模型仍然可以可靠地进行预测。当在训练过程中同时呈现多个不同的PRNG时，模型可以联合学习它们，识别来自不同排列的结构。我们展示了模数$m$的扩展规律：接近完美预测所需的上下文序列元素数量随着$\sqrt{m}$增长。对于更大的模数，优化过程会进入延长的停滞阶段；在我们的实验中，学习模数$m \geq 2^{20}$需要引入较小模数的训练数据，这表明课程学习是至关重要的。最后，我们分析了嵌入层，发现了一个新的聚类现象：主要成分自发地将整数输入聚类为位旋转不变的群集，揭示了表示如何从较小模数转移到较大模数。

articles.title: Is nasty noise actually harder than malicious noise?
articles.author: Guy Blanc, Yizhi Huang, Tal Malkin, Rocco A. Servedio
articles.summary: We consider the relative abilities and limitations of computationally efficient algorithms for learning in the presence of noise, under two well-studied and challenging adversarial noise models for learning Boolean functions: malicious noise, in which an adversary can arbitrarily corrupt a random subset of examples given to the learner; and nasty noise, in which an adversary can arbitrarily corrupt an adversarially chosen subset of examples given to the learner. We consider both the distribution-independent and fixed-distribution settings. Our main results highlight a dramatic difference between these two settings: For distribution-independent learning, we prove a strong equivalence between the two noise models: If a class ${\cal C}$ of functions is efficiently learnable in the presence of $η$-rate malicious noise, then it is also efficiently learnable in the presence of $η$-rate nasty noise. In sharp contrast, for the fixed-distribution setting we show an arbitrarily large separation: Under a standard cryptographic assumption, for any arbitrarily large value $r$ there exists a concept class for which there is a ratio of $r$ between the rate $η_{malicious}$ of malicious noise that polynomial-time learning algorithms can tolerate, versus the rate $η_{nasty}$ of nasty noise that such learning algorithms can tolerate. To offset the negative result for the fixed-distribution setting, we define a broad and natural class of algorithms, namely those that ignore contradictory examples (ICE). We show that for these algorithms, malicious noise and nasty noise are equivalent up to a factor of two in the noise rate: Any efficient ICE learner that succeeds with $η$-rate malicious noise can be converted to an efficient learner that succeeds with $η/2$-rate nasty noise. We further show that the above factor of two is necessary, again under a standard cryptographic assumption.
articles.content: 我们考虑在存在噪声的情况下，计算高效算法的学习能力与局限性，研究两种广泛研究且具有挑战性的对抗性噪声模型：恶意噪声，其中对手可以任意破坏提供给学习者的随机示例子集；以及恶劣噪声，其中对手可以任意破坏提供给学习者的对抗性选择的示例子集。我们考虑了分布无关和固定分布两种设置。我们的主要结果突显了这两种设置之间的显著差异：对于分布无关学习，我们证明了两种噪声模型之间存在强等价性：如果一个函数类${\cal C}$在存在$η$率恶意噪声的情况下可以被高效学习，那么它在存在$η$率恶劣噪声的情况下也可以被高效学习。与之形成鲜明对比的是，在固定分布设置中，我们展示了任意大的分离：在标准密码学假设下，对于任意大的值$r$，存在一个概念类，使得多项式时间学习算法能够容忍的恶意噪声率$η_{malicious}$与能够容忍的恶劣噪声率$η_{nasty}$之间的比率可以达到$r$。为了弥补固定分布设置中的负面结果，我们定义了一个广泛且自然的算法类，即忽略矛盾示例（ICE）的算法。我们证明，对于这些算法，恶意噪声和恶劣噪声在噪声率上最多相差两倍：任何在$η$率恶意噪声下成功的高效ICE学习者都可以转换为在$η/2$率恶劣噪声下成功的高效学习者。我们进一步证明，在标准密码学假设下，上述两倍的因子是必要的。

articles.title: Terminal Velocity Matching
articles.author: Linqi Zhou, Mathias Parger, Ayaan Haque, Jiaming Song
articles.summary: We propose Terminal Velocity Matching (TVM), a generalization of flow matching that enables high-fidelity one- and few-step generative modeling. TVM models the transition between any two diffusion timesteps and regularizes its behavior at its terminal time rather than at the initial time. We prove that TVM provides an upper bound on the $2$-Wasserstein distance between data and model distributions when the model is Lipschitz continuous. However, since Diffusion Transformers lack this property, we introduce minimal architectural changes that achieve stable, single-stage training. To make TVM efficient in practice, we develop a fused attention kernel that supports backward passes on Jacobian-Vector Products, which scale well with transformer architectures. On ImageNet-256x256, TVM achieves 3.29 FID with a single function evaluation (NFE) and 1.99 FID with 4 NFEs. It similarly achieves 4.32 1-NFE FID and 2.94 4-NFE FID on ImageNet-512x512, representing state-of-the-art performance for one/few-step models from scratch.
articles.content: 我们提出终端速度匹配（TVM），这是流匹配的一种推广，能够实现高保真的一步和少数步骤生成建模。TVM建模任意两个扩散时间步之间的转换，并在其终端时间而非初始时间对其行为进行正则化。我们证明，当模型是Lipschitz连续时，TVM提供了数据分布和模型分布之间$2$-Wasserstein距离的上界。然而，由于扩散变换器缺乏这一特性，我们引入了最小的架构更改，以实现稳定的一阶段训练。为了使TVM在实践中高效，我们开发了一个融合注意力内核，支持在雅可比向量积上的反向传递，这与变换器架构的扩展性良好。在ImageNet-256x256上，TVM在单次函数评估（NFE）下实现了3.29 FID，在4次NFE下实现了1.99 FID。在ImageNet-512x512上，它同样在1-NFE下实现了4.32 FID，在4-NFE下实现了2.94 FID，代表了从零开始的一步/少数步骤模型的最先进性能。

articles.title: BEP: A Binary Error Propagation Algorithm for Binary Neural Networks Training
articles.author: Luca Colombo, Fabrizio Pittorino, Daniele Zambon, Carlo Baldassi, Manuel Roveri, Cesare Alippi
articles.summary: Binary Neural Networks (BNNs), which constrain both weights and activations to binary values, offer substantial reductions in computational complexity, memory footprint, and energy consumption. These advantages make them particularly well suited for deployment on resource-constrained devices. However, training BNNs via gradient-based optimization remains challenging due to the discrete nature of their variables. The dominant approach, quantization-aware training, circumvents this issue by employing surrogate gradients. Yet, this method requires maintaining latent full-precision parameters and performing the backward pass with floating-point arithmetic, thereby forfeiting the efficiency of binary operations during training. While alternative approaches based on local learning rules exist, they are unsuitable for global credit assignment and for back-propagating errors in multi-layer architectures. This paper introduces Binary Error Propagation (BEP), the first learning algorithm to establish a principled, discrete analog of the backpropagation chain rule. This mechanism enables error signals, represented as binary vectors, to be propagated backward through multiple layers of a neural network. BEP operates entirely on binary variables, with all forward and backward computations performed using only bitwise operations. Crucially, this makes BEP the first solution to enable end-to-end binary training for recurrent neural network architectures. We validate the effectiveness of BEP on both multi-layer perceptrons and recurrent neural networks, demonstrating gains of up to +6.89% and +10.57% in test accuracy, respectively. The proposed algorithm is released as an open-source repository.
articles.content: 二值神经网络（BNNs）通过将权重和激活值限制为二进制值，能够显著降低计算复杂度、内存占用和能耗。这些优势使它们特别适合部署在资源受限的设备上。然而，由于变量的离散性，基于梯度优化训练BNNs仍然具有挑战性。主流方法量化感知训练通过使用替代梯度来规避这一问题。然而，这种方法需要维护潜在的高精度参数，并使用浮点运算进行反向传播，从而在训练过程中放弃了二进制运算的效率。虽然存在基于局部学习规则的替代方法，但它们不适合全局信用分配，也不适合在多层架构中反向传播误差。本文介绍了二值误差传播（BEP），这是首个建立反向传播链式法则原理性离散模拟的学习算法。该机制使得误差信号（以二进制向量表示）能够通过神经网络的多个层反向传播。BEP完全基于二进制变量，所有前向和反向计算仅使用位运算完成。关键的是，这使BEP成为首个能够实现循环神经网络架构端到端二进制训练的解决方案。我们在多层感知机和循环神经网络上验证了BEP的有效性，分别在测试准确率上实现了高达+6.89%和+10.57%的提升。所提出的算法作为开源仓库发布。

articles.title: Efficient Personalization of Generative Models via Optimal Experimental Design
articles.author: Guy Schacht, Ziyad Sheebaelhamd, Riccardo De Santi, Mojmír Mutný, Andreas Krause
articles.summary: Preference learning from human feedback has the ability to align generative models with the needs of end-users. Human feedback is costly and time-consuming to obtain, which creates demand for data-efficient query selection methods. This work presents a novel approach that leverages optimal experimental design to ask humans the most informative preference queries, from which we can elucidate the latent reward function modeling user preferences efficiently. We formulate the problem of preference query selection as the one that maximizes the information about the underlying latent preference model. We show that this problem has a convex optimization formulation, and introduce a statistically and computationally efficient algorithm ED-PBRL that is supported by theoretical guarantees and can efficiently construct structured queries such as images or text. We empirically present the proposed framework by personalizing a text-to-image generative model to user-specific styles, showing that it requires less preference queries compared to random query selection.
articles.content: 基于人类反馈的偏好学习能够使生成模型与终端用户的实际需求保持一致。获取人类反馈的成本高且耗时，这催生了对数据高效查询选择方法的需求。本研究提出了一种新颖的方法，利用最优实验设计来向人类提出最具信息量的偏好查询，从而高效地揭示用户偏好的潜在奖励函数。我们将偏好查询选择问题表述为最大化关于潜在偏好模型信息的问题。我们证明该问题具有凸优化的表述形式，并引入了一种在统计和计算上都高效的算法 ED-PBRL，该算法具有理论保证，能够高效构建结构化查询，如图像或文本。我们通过将文本到图像生成模型个性化为用户特定风格，实证展示了所提出的框架，结果表明与随机查询选择相比，该框架所需的偏好查询更少。

articles.title: Stratified Hazard Sampling: Minimal-Variance Event Scheduling for CTMC/DTMC Discrete Diffusion and Flow Models
articles.author: Seunghwan Jang, SooJean Han
articles.summary: Uniform-noise discrete diffusion and flow models (e.g., D3PM, SEDD, UDLM, DFM) generate sequences non-autoregressively by iteratively refining randomly initialized vocabulary tokens through multiple context-dependent replacements. These models are typically formulated as time-inhomogeneous CTMC/DTMC processes and sampled using independent Bernoulli change decisions at each discretization step. This induces Poisson-binomial variance in per-position jump counts that grows with the number of required edits, leading to the characteristic under-editing (residual noise) and over-editing (cascading substitutions) failure modes that degrade sample quality, especially under tight discretization budgets. In contrast, absorbing-state (mask-start) models avoid this instability by allowing each position to jump at most once. We propose Stratified Hazard Sampling (SHS), a training-free, drop-in, and hyperparameter-free inference principle for any sampler that admits a stay-vs.-replace decomposition. SHS models per-token edits as events driven by cumulative hazard (CTMC) or cumulative jump mass (DTMC) and places events by stratifying this cumulative quantity: with a single random phase per position, a token is updated whenever its accumulated hazard crosses unit-spaced thresholds. This preserves the expected number of jumps while achieving the minimum possible conditional variance among unbiased integer estimators (bounded by 1/4 for any fixed cumulative mass), without altering per-jump destination sampling and thus retaining multimodality. Experiments on uniform-noise discrete diffusion language models show that SHS consistently improves sample quality. We further show that SHS improves robustness under token-level blacklist filtering, with benefits increasing as lexical constraints grow more severe.
articles.content: 统一噪声离散扩散和流模型（例如D3PM、SEDD、UDLM、DFM）通过多次上下文依赖的替换，迭代地优化随机初始化的词汇标记，从而非自回归地生成序列。这些模型通常被表述为时间非齐次的连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）或离散时间马尔可夫链（DTMC）过程，并在每个离散化步骤中使用独立的伯努利变化决策进行采样。这导致了每个位置跳跃次数的泊松-二项式方差，随着所需编辑次数的增加而增长，从而导致了典型的编辑不足（残留噪声）和过度编辑（级联替换）失败模式，降低了样本质量，尤其是在离散化预算紧张的情况下。相比之下，吸收态（掩码起始）模型通过允许每个位置最多跳跃一次，避免了这种不稳定性。我们提出了分层风险采样（SHS），这是一种无需训练、即插即用且无需超参数的推理原则，适用于任何允许停留与替换分解的采样器。SHS将每个标记的编辑视为由累积风险（CTMC）或累积跳跃质量（DTMC）驱动的事件，并通过分层累积量来安排事件：每个位置仅需一个随机相位，当累积风险跨越单位间隔的阈值时，标记就会被更新。这在保持跳跃次数期望的同时，实现了无偏整数估计器中可能的最小条件方差（对于任何固定的累积质量，方差上限为1/4），同时不改变每次跳跃的目的地采样，从而保留了多模态性。在统一噪声离散扩散语言模型上的实验表明，SHS始终能提高样本质量。我们进一步表明，SHS在标记级别的黑名单过滤下提高了鲁棒性，随着词汇约束的加剧，其优势也愈加明显。

articles.title: PROMA: Projected Microbatch Accumulation for Reference-Free Proximal Policy Updates
articles.author: Nilin Abrahamsen
articles.summary: This note introduces Projected Microbatch Accumulation (PROMA), a reference-free proximal policy method that controls KL divergence by projecting away high-variance components of the policy gradient. Two variants are presented. In the accumulation-based variant, the running gradient is projected orthogonal to the sequence-wise log-probability gradients of each microbatch. In the intra-microbatch variant, a factored projection using dominant subspaces of activations and gradient outputs is applied independently within each microbatch, making it compatible with standard data-parallel training. Empirically, the accumulation variant achieves tighter per-step KL control than GRPO with PPO clipping, while the intra-microbatch variant achieves the best validation performance.
articles.content: 本笔记介绍了Projected Microbatch Accumulation（PROMA），这是一种无需参考的近端策略方法，通过将策略梯度的高方差成分投影出去来控制KL散度。文中提出了两种变体。在基于积累的变体中，运行中的梯度被投影到每个微批次的序列级对数概率梯度的正交方向。在微批次内部的变体中，使用激活和梯度输出的主导子空间进行分解投影，并在每个微批次内部独立应用，使其与标准的数据并行训练兼容。从经验上看，积累变体在每一步的KL控制上比使用PPO裁剪的GRPO更紧，而微批次内部的变体则实现了最佳的验证性能。

articles.title: Improving Policy Exploitation in Online Reinforcement Learning with Instant Retrospect Action
articles.author: Gong Gao, Weidong Zhao, Xianhui Liu, Ning Jia
articles.summary: Existing value-based online reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms suffer from slow policy exploitation due to ineffective exploration and delayed policy updates. To address these challenges, we propose an algorithm called Instant Retrospect Action (IRA). Specifically, we propose Q-Representation Discrepancy Evolution (RDE) to facilitate Q-network representation learning, enabling discriminative representations for neighboring state-action pairs. In addition, we adopt an explicit method to policy constraints by enabling Greedy Action Guidance (GAG). This is achieved through backtracking historical actions, which effectively enhances the policy update process. Our proposed method relies on providing the learning algorithm with accurate $k$-nearest-neighbor action value estimates and learning to design a fast-adaptable policy through policy constraints. We further propose the Instant Policy Update (IPU) mechanism, which enhances policy exploitation by systematically increasing the frequency of policy updates. We further discover that the early-stage training conservatism of the IRA method can alleviate the overestimation bias problem in value-based RL. Experimental results show that IRA can significantly improve the learning efficiency and final performance of online RL algorithms on eight MuJoCo continuous control tasks.The code is available at https://github.com/2706853499/IRA.
articles.content: 现有的基于价值的在线强化学习（RL）算法由于探索效率低下和策略更新延迟，导致策略利用速度缓慢。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种名为即时回顾动作（IRA）的算法。具体来说，我们提出了Q-表示差异演化（RDE）方法，以促进Q网络的表示学习，从而为相邻状态-动作对提供判别性表示。此外，我们采用显式方法对策略进行约束，通过启用贪婪动作引导（GAG）实现。这是通过回溯历史动作实现的，有效增强了策略更新过程。我们提出的方法依赖于为学习算法提供准确的$k$-最近邻动作值估计，并通过策略约束学习设计一个快速适应的策略。我们进一步提出了即时策略更新（IPU）机制，通过系统性地增加策略更新的频率来增强策略利用。我们还发现，IRA方法在早期训练阶段的保守性可以缓解基于价值的RL中的高估偏差问题。实验结果表明，IRA可以在八个MuJoCo连续控制任务上显著提高在线RL算法的学习效率和最终性能。代码可在https://github.com/2706853499/IRA获取。

articles.title: Green-NAS: A Global-Scale Multi-Objective Neural Architecture Search for Robust and Efficient Edge-Native Weather Forecasting
articles.author: Md Muhtasim Munif Fahim, Soyda Humyra Yesmin, Saiful Islam, Md. Palash Bin Faruque, Md. A. Salam, Md. Mahfuz Uddin, Samiul Islam, Tofayel Ahmed, Md. Binyamin, Md. Rezaul Karim
articles.summary: We introduce Green-NAS, a multi-objective NAS (neural architecture search) framework designed for low-resource environments using weather forecasting as a case study. By adhering to 'Green AI' principles, the framework explicitly minimizes computational energy costs and carbon footprints, prioritizing sustainable deployment over raw computational scale. The Green-NAS architecture search method is optimized for both model accuracy and efficiency to find lightweight models with high accuracy and very few model parameters; this is accomplished through an optimization process that simultaneously optimizes multiple objectives. Our best-performing model, Green-NAS-A, achieved an RMSE of 0.0988 (i.e., within 1.4% of our manually tuned baseline) using only 153k model parameters, which is 239 times fewer than other globally applied weather forecasting models, such as GraphCast. In addition, we also describe how the use of transfer learning will improve the weather forecasting accuracy by approximately 5.2%, in comparison to a naive approach of training a new model for each city, when there is limited historical weather data available for that city.
articles.content: 我们引入了Green-NAS，这是一个多目标的神经架构搜索（NAS）框架，旨在低资源环境下使用天气预报作为案例研究。通过遵循“绿色人工智能”原则，该框架明确地最小化计算能耗成本和碳足迹，优先考虑可持续部署，而非单纯的计算规模。Green-NAS的架构搜索方法在模型准确性和效率方面进行了优化，以找到具有高准确率和极少模型参数的轻量级模型；这是通过同时优化多个目标的优化过程实现的。我们表现最好的模型Green-NAS-A仅使用了153,000个模型参数，就达到了0.0988的RMSE（即比我们手动调整的基线模型低1.4%），这比其他全球应用的天气预报模型（如GraphCast）少239倍。此外，我们还描述了如何利用迁移学习，在城市的历史天气数据有限的情况下，相比为每个城市单独训练新模型的简单方法，可以将天气预报的准确性提高约5.2%。

articles.title: Achieving Optimal Static and Dynamic Regret Simultaneously in Bandits with Deterministic Losses
articles.author: Jian Qian, Chen-Yu Wei
articles.summary: In adversarial multi-armed bandits, two performance measures are commonly used: static regret, which compares the learner to the best fixed arm, and dynamic regret, which compares it to the best sequence of arms. While optimal algorithms are known for each measure individually, there is no known algorithm achieving optimal bounds for both simultaneously. Marinov and Zimmert [2021] first showed that such simultaneous optimality is impossible against an adaptive adversary. Our work takes a first step to demonstrate its possibility against an oblivious adversary when losses are deterministic. First, we extend the impossibility result of Marinov and Zimmert [2021] to the case of deterministic losses. Then, we present an algorithm achieving optimal static and dynamic regret simultaneously against an oblivious adversary. Together, they reveal a fundamental separation between adaptive and oblivious adversaries when multiple regret benchmarks are considered simultaneously. It also provides new insight into the long open problem of simultaneously achieving optimal regret against switching benchmarks of different numbers of switches. Our algorithm uses negative static regret to compensate for the exploration overhead incurred when controlling dynamic regret, and leverages Blackwell approachability to jointly control both regrets. This yields a new model selection procedure for bandits that may be of independent interest.
articles.content: 在对抗性多臂老虎机问题中，常用的两个性能衡量标准是静态遗憾，它将学习者与最佳固定臂进行比较，以及动态遗憾，它将学习者与最佳臂序列进行比较。虽然针对每个衡量标准都有已知的最优算法，但目前尚无已知算法能同时达到两个标准的最优界限。Marinov和Zimmert [2021] 首次证明，面对自适应对手时，这种同时最优性是不可能实现的。我们的工作首次展示了在损失确定的情况下，面对无记忆对手时实现这种同时最优性的可能性。首先，我们将Marinov和Zimmert [2021] 的不可能性结果扩展到确定性损失的情形。然后，我们提出了一种算法，该算法在面对无记忆对手时能够同时达到最优的静态和动态遗憾。这两部分结果揭示了在同时考虑多个遗憾基准时，自适应对手与无记忆对手之间存在根本性的区别。此外，它还为长期未解决的、同时实现针对不同切换次数的切换基准的最优遗憾这一问题提供了新的见解。我们的算法利用负的静态遗憾来补偿在控制动态遗憾时所付出的探索开销，并利用Blackwell可接近性来联合控制两种遗憾。这产生了一种新的老虎机模型选择方法，可能具有独立的研究价值。

articles.title: Reducing Estimation Uncertainty Using Normalizing Flows and Stratification
articles.author: Paweł Lorek, Rafał Nowak, Rafał Topolnicki, Tomasz Trzciński, Maciej Zięba, Aleksandra Krystecka
articles.summary: Estimating the expectation of a real-valued function of a random variable from sample data is a critical aspect of statistical analysis, with far-reaching implications in various applications. Current methodologies typically assume (semi-)parametric distributions such as Gaussian or mixed Gaussian, leading to significant estimation uncertainty if these assumptions do not hold. We propose a flow-based model, integrated with stratified sampling, that leverages a parametrized neural network to offer greater flexibility in modeling unknown data distributions, thereby mitigating this limitation. Our model shows a marked reduction in estimation uncertainty across multiple datasets, including high-dimensional (30 and 128) ones, outperforming crude Monte Carlo estimators and Gaussian mixture models. Reproducible code is available at https://github.com/rnoxy/flowstrat.
articles.content: 从样本数据中估计随机变量的实值函数的期望值是统计分析中的关键方面，在各种应用中具有深远的影响。当前的方法通常假设（半）参数分布，如高斯分布或混合高斯分布，如果这些假设不成立，会导致显著的估计不确定性。我们提出了一种基于流的模型，结合分层抽样，利用参数化的神经网络来提供更大的灵活性，以建模未知的数据分布，从而缓解这一限制。我们的模型在多个数据集上，包括高维（30和128维）数据集上，显著减少了估计不确定性，优于粗略的蒙特卡洛估计器和高斯混合模型。可重复的代码可在https://github.com/rnoxy/flowstrat获取。

articles.title: How Well Do Large-Scale Chemical Language Models Transfer to Downstream Tasks?
articles.author: Tatsuya Sagawa, Ryosuke Kojima
articles.summary: Chemical Language Models (CLMs) pre-trained on large scale molecular data are widely used for molecular property prediction. However, the common belief that increasing training resources such as model size, dataset size, and training compute improves both pretraining loss and downstream task performance has not been systematically validated in the chemical domain. In this work, we evaluate this assumption by pretraining CLMs while scaling training resources and measuring transfer performance across diverse molecular property prediction (MPP) tasks. We find that while pretraining loss consistently decreases with increased training resources, downstream task performance shows limited improvement. Moreover, alternative metrics based on the Hessian or loss landscape also fail to estimate downstream performance in CLMs. We further identify conditions under which downstream performance saturates or degrades despite continued improvements in pretraining metrics, and analyze the underlying task dependent failure modes through parameter space visualizations. These results expose a gap between pretraining based evaluation and downstream performance, and emphasize the need for model selection and evaluation strategies that explicitly account for downstream task characteristics.
articles.content: 化学语言模型（CLMs）在大规模分子数据上进行预训练，被广泛用于分子属性预测。然而，增加训练资源（如模型规模、数据集规模和训练计算量）能够同时提升预训练损失和下游任务性能的常见观点，在化学领域尚未得到系统验证。在本研究中，我们通过扩展训练资源并预训练CLMs，同时在多种分子属性预测（MPP）任务中评估迁移性能，来验证这一假设。我们发现，虽然预训练损失随着训练资源的增加而持续下降，但下游任务的性能提升却十分有限。此外，基于Hessian矩阵或损失景观的替代性指标在CLMs中也无法有效估计下游任务的性能。我们进一步识别了在预训练指标持续提升的情况下，下游性能出现饱和或退化的条件，并通过参数空间可视化分析了这些任务依赖的失败模式。这些结果揭示了预训练评估与下游性能之间的差距，并强调了需要明确考虑下游任务特性的模型选择和评估策略的重要性。

articles.title: Safe Reinforcement Learning via Recovery-based Shielding with Gaussian Process Dynamics Models
articles.author: Alexander W. Goodall, Francesco Belardinelli
articles.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful framework for optimal decision-making and control but often lacks provable guarantees for safety-critical applications. In this paper, we introduce a novel recovery-based shielding framework that enables safe RL with a provable safety lower bound for unknown and non-linear continuous dynamical systems. The proposed approach integrates a backup policy (shield) with the RL agent, leveraging Gaussian process (GP) based uncertainty quantification to predict potential violations of safety constraints, dynamically recovering to safe trajectories only when necessary. Experience gathered by the 'shielded' agent is used to construct the GP models, with policy optimization via internal model-based sampling - enabling unrestricted exploration and sample efficient learning, without compromising safety. Empirically our approach demonstrates strong performance and strict safety-compliance on a suite of continuous control environments.
articles.content: 强化学习（RL）是一种用于最优决策和控制的强大框架，但在安全关键型应用中往往缺乏可证明的保证。在本文中，我们引入了一种新颖的基于恢复的防护框架，使未知和非线性连续动态系统能够实现具有可证明安全下限的安全RL。所提出的方法将备份策略（防护）与RL智能体相结合，利用基于高斯过程（GP）的不确定性量化来预测安全约束的潜在违反情况，并仅在必要时动态恢复到安全轨迹。由“防护”智能体收集的经验用于构建GP模型，通过基于内部模型的采样进行策略优化，从而实现无限制的探索和样本高效的學習，同时不损害安全性。实证研究表明，我们的方法在一系列连续控制环境中表现出色，并严格遵守安全规范。

articles.title: Linear Bandits beyond Inner Product Spaces, the case of Bandit Optimal Transport
articles.author: Lorenzo Croissant
articles.summary: Linear bandits have long been a central topic in online learning, with applications ranging from recommendation systems to adaptive clinical trials. Their general learnability has been established when the objective is to minimise the inner product between a cost parameter and the decision variable. While this is highly general, this reliance on an inner product structure belies the name of \emph{linear} bandits, and fails to account for problems such as Optimal Transport. Using the Kantorovich formulation of Optimal Transport as an example, we show that an inner product structure is \emph{not} necessary to achieve efficient learning in linear bandits. We propose a refinement of the classical OFUL algorithm that operates by embedding the action set into a Hilbertian subspace, where confidence sets can be built via least-squares estimation. Actions are then constrained to this subspace by penalising optimism. The analysis is completed by leveraging convergence results from penalised (entropic) transport to the Kantorovich problem. Up to this approximation term, the resulting algorithm achieves the same trajectorial regret upper bounds as the OFUL algorithm, which we turn into worst-case regret using functional regression techniques. Its regret interpolates between $\tilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{T})$ and ${\mathcal O}(T)$, depending on the regularity of the cost function, and recovers the parametric rate $\tilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{dT})$ in finite-dimensional settings.
articles.content: 线性老虎机一直是在线学习中的核心主题，其应用范围从推荐系统到自适应临床试验。当目标是使成本参数与决策变量之间的内积最小化时，其通用可学习性已被建立。虽然这一目标高度通用，但这种对内积结构的依赖与“线性”老虎机的名称不符，并且无法解释诸如最优运输等问题。以最优运输的Kantorovich公式为例，我们表明，在线性老虎机中实现高效学习并不需要内积结构。我们提出了一种经典OFUL算法的改进方法，该方法通过将动作集嵌入到一个希尔伯特子空间中进行操作，在该子空间中可以通过最小二乘估计构建置信集。然后通过惩罚乐观性，将动作限制在该子空间中。通过利用惩罚（熵）运输到Kantorovich问题的收敛结果，我们完成了分析。在这一近似项下，所得到的算法实现了与OFUL算法相同的轨迹遗憾上界，我们利用函数回归技术将其转化为最坏情况下的遗憾。其遗憾在成本函数的正则性不同情况下，介于$\tilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{T})$和${\mathcal O}(T)$之间，并在有限维情况下恢复了参数速率$\tilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{dT})$。

articles.title: Curved representational Bregman divergences and their applications
articles.author: Frank Nielsen
articles.summary: By analogy to the terminology of curved exponential families in statistics, we define curved Bregman divergences as Bregman divergences restricted to non-affine parameter subspaces and sub-dimensional Bregman divergences when the restrictions are affine. A common example of curved Bregman divergence is the cosine dissimilarity between normalized vectors: a curved squared Euclidean divergence. We prove that the barycenter of a finite weighted set of parameters under a curved Bregman divergence amounts to the right Bregman projection onto the non-affine subspace of the barycenter with respect to the full Bregman divergence, and interpret a generalization of the weighted Bregman centroid of $n$ parameters as a $n$-fold sub-dimensional Bregman divergence. We demonstrate the significance of curved Bregman divergences with several examples: (1) symmetrized Bregman divergences, (2) pointwise symmetrized Bregman divergences, and (3) the Kullback-Leibler divergence between circular complex normal distributions. We explain how to reparameterize sub-dimensional Bregman divergences on simplicial sub-dimensional domains. We then consider monotonic embeddings to define representational curved Bregman divergences and show that the $α$-divergences are representational curved Bregman divergences with respect to $α$-embeddings of the probability simplex into the positive measure cone. As an application, we report an efficient method to calculate the intersection of a finite set of $α$-divergence spheres. As an application, we report an efficient method to calculate the intersection of a finite set of $α$-divergence spheres.
articles.content: 类比统计学中曲率指数族的术语，我们将曲率Bregman散度定义为限制在非仿射参数子空间上的Bregman散度，当限制为仿射时则称为子维Bregman散度。曲率Bregman散度的一个常见例子是归一化向量之间的余弦差异：一种曲率平方欧几里得散度。我们证明，在曲率Bregman散度下，有限加权参数集的重心等价于向重心的非仿射子空间在完整Bregman散度下的右Bregman投影，并将n个参数的加权Bregman重心的一般化解释为n重子维Bregman散度。我们通过几个例子说明曲率Bregman散度的重要性：（1）对称Bregman散度，（2）逐点对称Bregman散度，（3）环形复正态分布之间的Kullback-Leibler散度。我们解释了如何在单形子维域上对子维Bregman散度进行重新参数化。然后我们考虑单调嵌入以定义表示性曲率Bregman散度，并证明α-散度是相对于概率单形到正测度锥的α-嵌入而言的表示性曲率Bregman散度。作为应用，我们报告了一种高效计算有限个α-散度球体交集的方法。作为应用，我们报告了一种高效计算有限个α-散度球体交集的方法。

articles.title: Multimodal Integrated Knowledge Transfer to Large Language Models through Preference Optimization with Biomedical Applications
articles.author: Zhanliang Wang, Da Wu, Quan Nguyen, Zhuoran Xu, Kai Wang
articles.summary: The scarcity of high-quality multimodal biomedical data limits the ability to effectively fine-tune pretrained Large Language Models (LLMs) for specialized biomedical tasks. To address this challenge, we introduce MINT (Multimodal Integrated kNowledge Transfer), a framework that aligns unimodal large decoder models with domain-specific decision patterns from multimodal biomedical data through preference optimization. While MINT supports different optimization techniques, we primarily implement it with the Odds Ratio Preference Optimization (ORPO) framework as its backbone. This strategy enables the aligned LLMs to perform predictive tasks using text-only or image-only inputs while retaining knowledge learnt from multimodal data. MINT leverages an upstream multimodal machine learning (MML) model trained on high-quality multimodal data to transfer domain-specific insights to downstream text-only or image-only LLMs. We demonstrate its effectiveness through two key applications: (1) Rare genetic disease prediction from texts, where MINT uses a multimodal encoder model, trained on facial photos and clinical notes, to generate a preference dataset for aligning a lightweight Llama 3.2-3B-Instruct. Despite relying on text input only, the MINT-derived model outperforms models trained with SFT, RAG, or DPO, and even outperforms Llama 3.1-405B-Instruct. (2) Tissue type classification using cell nucleus images, where MINT uses a vision-language foundation model as the preference generator, containing knowledge learnt from both text and histopathological images to align downstream image-only models. The resulting MINT-derived model significantly improves the performance of Llama 3.2-Vision-11B-Instruct on tissue type classification. In summary, MINT provides an effective strategy to align unimodal LLMs with high-quality multimodal expertise through preference optimization.
articles.content: 高质量多模态生物医学数据的稀缺性限制了对预训练大型语言模型（LLMs）进行有效微调以执行专门生物医学任务的能力。为了解决这一挑战，我们引入了MINT（多模态集成知识迁移），一个通过偏好优化将单模态大型解码器模型与多模态生物医学数据中的领域特定决策模式对齐的框架。虽然MINT支持不同的优化技术，但我们主要使用奇数比偏好优化（ORPO）框架作为其核心。这一策略使对齐后的LLMs能够使用仅文本或仅图像的输入执行预测任务，同时保留从多模态数据中学到的知识。MINT利用一个在高质量多模态数据上训练的上游多模态机器学习（MML）模型，将领域特定的见解转移到下游仅文本或仅图像的LLMs上。我们通过两个关键应用展示了其有效性：（1）从文本预测罕见遗传疾病，其中MINT使用在面部照片和临床记录上训练的多模态编码器模型，生成一个偏好数据集，用于对齐轻量级Llama 3.2-3B-Instruct模型。尽管仅依赖文本输入，MINT衍生的模型在性能上优于使用SFT、RAG或DPO训练的模型，甚至优于Llama 3.1-405B-Instruct模型。（2）使用细胞核图像进行组织类型分类，其中MINT使用一个视觉-语言基础模型作为偏好生成器，该模型包含从文本和组织病理学图像中学到的知识，用于对齐下游仅图像模型。由此得到的MINT衍生模型显著提升了Llama 3.2-Vision-11B-Instruct在组织类型分类中的性能。总之，MINT通过偏好优化提供了一种有效对齐单模态LLMs与高质量多模态专业知识的策略。

articles.title: MMS-VPR: Multimodal Street-Level Visual Place Recognition Dataset and Benchmark
articles.author: Yiwei Ou, Xiaobin Ren, Ronggui Sun, Guansong Gao, Kaiqi Zhao, Manfredo Manfredini
articles.summary: Existing visual place recognition (VPR) datasets predominantly rely on vehicle-mounted imagery, offer limited multimodal diversity, and underrepresent dense pedestrian street scenes, particularly in non-Western urban contexts. We introduce MMS-VPR, a large-scale multimodal dataset for street-level place recognition in pedestrian-only environments. MMS-VPR comprises 110,529 images and 2,527 video clips across 208 locations in a ~70,800 $m^2$ open-air commercial district in Chengdu, China. Field data were collected in 2024, while social media data span seven years (2019-2025), providing both fine-grained temporal granularity and long-term temporal coverage. Each location features comprehensive day-night coverage, multiple viewing angles, and multimodal annotations including GPS coordinates, timestamps, and semantic textual metadata. We further release MMS-VPRlib, a unified benchmarking platform that consolidates commonly used VPR datasets and state-of-the-art methods under a standardized, reproducible pipeline. MMS-VPRlib provides modular components for data pre-processing, multimodal modeling (CNN/RNN/Transformer), signal enhancement, alignment, fusion, and performance evaluation. This platform moves beyond traditional image-only paradigms, enabling systematic exploitation of complementary visual, video, and textual modalities. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Yiwei-Ou/MMS-VPR and the benchmark at https://github.com/yiasun/MMS-VPRlib.
articles.content: 现有的视觉地点识别（VPR）数据集主要依赖于车载图像，多模态多样性有限，且在非西方城市环境中对密集的行人街道场景代表性不足。我们引入了MMS-VPR，这是一个用于行人专用环境街景级地点识别的大规模多模态数据集。MMS-VPR包含来自中国成都一个约70,800平方米的开放式商业区208个地点的110,529张图像和2,527个视频片段。实地数据于2024年采集，而社交媒体数据则跨越七年（2019-2025），提供了细粒度的时间粒度和长期的时间覆盖范围。每个地点都具有全面的昼夜覆盖、多种视角以及包括GPS坐标、时间戳和语义文本元数据在内的多模态标注。我们进一步发布了MMS-VPRlib，这是一个统一的基准平台，将常用的VPR数据集和最先进的方法整合到一个标准化、可复现的流程中。MMS-VPRlib提供了数据预处理、多模态建模（CNN/RNN/Transformer）、信号增强、对齐、融合和性能评估的模块化组件。该平台超越了传统的仅图像范式，使互补的视觉、视频和文本模态能够系统地被利用。该数据集可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/Yiwei-Ou/MMS-VPR获取，基准平台可在https://github.com/yiasun/MMS-VPRlib获取。

articles.title: TQml Simulator: optimized simulation of quantum machine learning
articles.author: Viacheslav Kuzmin, Basil Kyriacou, Tatjana Protasevich, Mateusz Papierz, Mo Kordzanganeh, Alexey Melnikov
articles.summary: Hardware-efficient circuits employed in Quantum Machine Learning are typically composed of alternating layers of uniformly applied gates. High-speed numerical simulators for such circuits are crucial for advancing research in this field. In this work, we numerically benchmark universal and gate-specific techniques for simulating the action of layers of gates on quantum state vectors, aiming to accelerate the overall simulation of Quantum Machine Learning algorithms. Our analysis shows that the optimal simulation method for a given layer of gates depends on the number of qubits involved, and that a tailored combination of techniques can yield substantial performance gains in the forward and backward passes for a given circuit. Building on these insights, we developed a numerical simulator, named TQml Simulator, that employs the most efficient simulation method for each layer in a given circuit. We evaluated TQml Simulator on circuits constructed from standard gate sets, such as rotations and CNOTs, as well as on native gates from IonQ and IBM quantum processing units. In most cases, our simulator outperforms equivalent Pennylane's default.qubit simulator by up to a factor of 10, depending on the circuit, the number of qubits, the batch size of the input data, and the hardware used.
articles.content: 量子机器学习中使用的硬件高效的电路通常由交替应用的统一门层组成。这种电路的高速数值模拟器对于推动该领域研究至关重要。在本研究中，我们对模拟门层对量子态矢量作用的通用技术和特定门技术进行了数值基准测试，旨在加速量子机器学习算法的整体模拟。我们的分析表明，对于给定的门层，最佳的模拟方法取决于所涉及的量子比特数量，并且针对特定电路的正向和反向传递过程，采用定制的技术组合可以显著提高性能。基于这些见解，我们开发了一个名为TQml Simulator的数值模拟器，该模拟器对给定电路中的每一层都采用最高效的模拟方法。我们对由标准门集（如旋转门和CNOT门）构建的电路，以及来自IonQ和IBM量子处理器的原生门进行了评估。在大多数情况下，我们的模拟器在电路、量子比特数量、输入数据的批量大小和所用硬件等因素的影响下，性能优于等效的Pennylane默认qubit模拟器，最高可达10倍。

articles.title: Prover Agent: An Agent-Based Framework for Formal Mathematical Proofs
articles.author: Kaito Baba, Chaoran Liu, Shuhei Kurita, Akiyoshi Sannai
articles.summary: We present Prover Agent, a novel AI agent for automated theorem proving that integrates large language models (LLMs) with a formal proof assistant, Lean. Prover Agent coordinates an informal reasoning LLM, a formal prover model, and feedback from Lean while also generating auxiliary lemmas. These auxiliary lemmas are not limited to subgoals in the formal proof but can also include special cases or potentially useful facts derived from the assumptions, which help in discovering a viable proof strategy. It achieves an 88.1% success rate on MiniF2F and solves 25 problems on the PutnamBench with a smaller sample budget than previous approaches, establishing a new state-of-the-art on both benchmarks among methods using small language models (SLMs). We also present theoretical analyses and case studies that illustrate how these generated lemmas contribute to solving challenging problems. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/kAIto47802/Prover-Agent.
articles.content: 我们提出了 Prover Agent，这是一种新型的 AI 代理，用于自动定理证明，它将大语言模型（LLMs）与形式化证明助手 Lean 相结合。Prover Agent 协调非正式推理的 LLM、形式化证明模型以及 Lean 的反馈，同时生成辅助引理。这些辅助引理不仅限于形式化证明中的子目标，还可以包括从假设中推导出的特殊情况或潜在有用的事实，有助于发现可行的证明策略。在 MiniF2F 上，它实现了 88.1% 的成功率，并且在 PutnamBench 上以比以往方法更小的样本预算解决了 25 个问题，在使用小型语言模型（SLMs）的方法中，它在两个基准测试中均建立了新的最先进水平。我们还提出了理论分析和案例研究，说明这些生成的引理如何有助于解决具有挑战性的问题。我们的代码已公开在 https://github.com/kAIto47802/Prover-Agent。

articles.title: A LoD of Gaussians: Unified Training and Rendering for Ultra-Large Scale Reconstruction with External Memory
articles.author: Felix Windisch, Thomas Köhler, Lukas Radl, Mattia D'Urso, Michael Steiner, Dieter Schmalstieg, Markus Steinberger
articles.summary: Gaussian Splatting has emerged as a high-performance technique for novel view synthesis, enabling real-time rendering and high-quality reconstruction of small scenes. However, scaling to larger environments has so far relied on partitioning the scene into chunks -- a strategy that introduces artifacts at chunk boundaries, complicates training across varying scales, and is poorly suited to unstructured scenarios such as city-scale flyovers combined with street-level views. Moreover, rendering remains fundamentally limited by GPU memory, as all visible chunks must reside in VRAM simultaneously. We introduce A LoD of Gaussians, a framework for training and rendering ultra-large-scale Gaussian scenes on a single consumer-grade GPU -- without partitioning. Our method stores the full scene out-of-core (e.g., in CPU memory) and trains a Level-of-Detail (LoD) representation directly, dynamically streaming only the relevant Gaussians. A hybrid data structure combining Gaussian hierarchies with Sequential Point Trees enables efficient, view-dependent LoD selection, while a lightweight caching and view scheduling system exploits temporal coherence to support real-time streaming and rendering. Together, these innovations enable seamless multi-scale reconstruction and interactive visualization of complex scenes -- from broad aerial views to fine-grained ground-level details.
articles.content: 高斯点扩散技术已成为一种高性能的新视角合成技术，能够实现实时渲染和小型场景的高质量重建。然而，扩展到更大环境时，目前的方法依赖于将场景划分为多个块——这种策略在块边界处引入了伪影，使在不同尺度上的训练变得复杂，并且不适用于城市级航拍与街道级视图等非结构化场景。此外，渲染仍然受到GPU内存的根本限制，因为所有可见的块必须同时驻留在VRAM中。我们引入了“高斯点的细节层次（LoD）”，一种无需划分即可在单个消费级GPU上训练和渲染超大规模高斯场景的框架。我们的方法将整个场景存储在外部核心（例如CPU内存中），并直接训练一个细节层次（LoD）表示，动态地仅流式传输相关的高斯点。结合高斯层次结构与顺序点树的混合数据结构，实现了高效的视点依赖的LoD选择，而轻量级的缓存和视点调度系统则利用时间一致性，支持实时流式传输和渲染。这些创新共同实现了复杂场景的无缝多尺度重建和交互式可视化——从广阔的空中视角到精细的地面细节。

articles.title: Counterfactual Survival Q-learning via Buckley-James Boosting, with Applications to ACTG 175 and CALGB 8923
articles.author: Jeongjin Lee, Jong-Min Kim
articles.summary: We propose a Buckley James (BJ) Boost Q learning framework for estimating optimal dynamic treatment regimes from right censored survival outcomes in longitudinal randomized clinical trials, motivated by the clinical need to support patient specific treatment decisions when follow up is incomplete and covariate effects may be nonlinear. The method combines accelerated failure time modeling with iterative boosting using flexible base learners, including componentwise least squares and regression trees, within a counterfactual Q learning framework. By modeling conditional survival time directly, BJ Boost Q learning avoids the proportional hazards assumption, yields clinically interpretable time scale contrasts, and enables estimation of stage specific Q functions and individualized decision rules under standard potential outcomes assumptions. In contrast to Cox based Q learning, which relies on hazard modeling and can be sensitive to nonproportional hazards and model misspecification, our approach provides a robust and flexible alternative for regime learning. Simulation studies and analyses of the ACTG175 HIV trial and the CALGB 8923 two stage leukemia trial show that BJ Boost Q learning improves treatment decision accuracy and produces more stable within participant counterfactual contrasts, particularly in multistage settings where estimation error and bias can compound across stages.
articles.content: 我们提出了一种Buckley James（BJ）Boost Q学习框架，用于从纵向随机临床试验中右删失生存结果中估计最优动态治疗方案，该方法受到临床需求的推动，即在随访不完整且协变量效应可能非线性的情况下，支持患者特定的治疗决策。该方法在反事实Q学习框架内，结合加速失效时间建模与使用灵活基础学习器（包括逐组件最小二乘和回归树）的迭代增强。通过直接建模条件生存时间，BJ Boost Q学习避免了比例风险假设，提供了临床可解释的时间尺度对比，并在标准潜在结果假设下，实现了阶段特定的Q函数和个体化决策规则的估计。与基于Cox的Q学习方法相比，后者依赖于风险建模，可能对非比例风险和模型误设敏感，我们的方法为制度学习提供了一种稳健且灵活的替代方案。模拟研究以及对ACTG175 HIV试验和CALGB 8923两阶段白血病试验的分析表明，BJ Boost Q学习提高了治疗决策的准确性，并产生了更稳定的参与者内部反事实对比，特别是在多阶段设置中，估计误差和偏差可能在各阶段累积的情况下。

articles.title: XAI-Driven Spectral Analysis of Cough Sounds for Respiratory Disease Characterization
articles.author: Patricia Amado-Caballero, Luis Miguel San-José-Revuelta, María Dolores Aguilar-García, José Ramón Garmendia-Leiza, Carlos Alberola-López, Pablo Casaseca-de-la-Higuera
articles.summary: This paper proposes an eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI)-driven methodology to enhance the understanding of cough sound analysis for respiratory disease management. We employ occlusion maps to highlight relevant spectral regions in cough spectrograms processed by a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Subsequently, spectral analysis of spectrograms weighted by these occlusion maps reveals significant differences between disease groups, particularly in patients with COPD, where cough patterns appear more variable in the identified spectral regions of interest. This contrasts with the lack of significant differences observed when analyzing raw spectrograms. The proposed approach extracts and analyzes several spectral features, demonstrating the potential of XAI techniques to uncover disease-specific acoustic signatures and improve the diagnostic capabilities of cough sound analysis by providing more interpretable results.
articles.content: 本文提出了一种基于可解释人工智能（XAI）的方法，以增强对咳嗽声音分析在呼吸系统疾病管理中的理解。我们采用遮挡图来突出卷积神经网络（CNN）处理的咳嗽频谱图中相关的频谱区域。随后，对这些遮挡图加权的频谱图进行频谱分析，揭示了疾病组之间的显著差异，特别是在慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者中，识别出的感兴趣频谱区域内的咳嗽模式显得更加多变。这与分析原始频谱图时观察到的显著差异缺失形成了对比。所提出的方法提取并分析了多个频谱特征，展示了XAI技术揭示疾病特异性声学特征的潜力，并通过提供更易解释的结果，提高了咳嗽声音分析的诊断能力。

articles.title: Agents of Discovery
articles.author: Sascha Diefenbacher, Anna Hallin, Gregor Kasieczka, Michael Krämer, Anne Lauscher, Tim Lukas
articles.summary: The substantial data volumes encountered in modern particle physics and other domains of fundamental physics research allow (and require) the use of increasingly complex data analysis tools and workflows. While the use of machine learning (ML) tools for data analysis has recently proliferated, these tools are typically special-purpose algorithms that rely, for example, on encoded physics knowledge to reach optimal performance. In this work, we investigate a new and orthogonal direction: Using recent progress in large language models (LLMs) to create a team of agents -- instances of LLMs with specific subtasks -- that jointly solve data analysis-based research problems in a way similar to how a human researcher might: by creating code to operate standard tools and libraries (including ML systems) and by building on results of previous iterations. If successful, such agent-based systems could be deployed to automate routine analysis components to counteract the increasing complexity of modern tool chains. To investigate the capabilities of current-generation commercial LLMs, we consider the task of anomaly detection via the publicly available and highly-studied LHC Olympics dataset. Several current models by OpenAI (GPT-4o, o4-mini, GPT-4.1, and GPT-5) are investigated and their stability tested. Overall, we observe the capacity of the agent-based system to solve this data analysis problem. The best agent-created solutions mirror the performance of human state-of-the-art results.
articles.content: 现代粒子物理以及其他基本物理研究领域所面临的大量数据，使得（并要求）使用日益复杂的分析工具和工作流程成为可能。尽管近年来机器学习（ML）工具在数据分析中的使用迅速增加，但这些工具通常是专门用途的算法，例如依赖于编码的物理知识以达到最佳性能。在本研究中，我们探讨了一种新的、与现有方法正交的方向：利用大型语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展，创建一个由多个代理（即具有特定子任务的LLM实例）组成的团队，以类似人类研究人员的方式共同解决基于数据分析的研究问题：通过编写代码来操作标准工具和库（包括机器学习系统），并基于之前迭代的结果进行构建。如果成功，这种基于代理的系统可以被部署用于自动化常规分析组件，以应对现代工具链日益增加的复杂性。为了研究当前一代商业LLMs的能力，我们考虑了使用公开可用且高度研究的LHC奥运会数据集进行异常检测的任务。我们研究了OpenAI的几个当前模型（GPT-4o、o4-mini、GPT-4.1和GPT-5），并测试了它们的稳定性。总体而言，我们观察到基于代理的系统解决这一数据分析问题的能力。最佳的代理创建的解决方案与人类最先进的结果相匹配。

articles.title: Improving User Interface Generation Models from Designer Feedback
articles.author: Jason Wu, Amanda Swearngin, Arun Krishna Vajjala, Alan Leung, Jeffrey Nichols, Titus Barik
articles.summary: Despite being trained on vast amounts of data, most LLMs are unable to reliably generate well-designed UIs. Designer feedback is essential to improving performance on UI generation; however, we find that existing RLHF methods based on ratings or rankings are not well-aligned with with designers' workflows and ignore the rich rationale used to critique and improve UI designs. In this paper, we investigate several approaches for designers to give feedback to UI generation models, using familiar interactions such as commenting, sketching and direct manipulation. We first perform an evaluation with 21 designers where they gave feedback using these interactions, which resulted in 1500 design annotations. We then use this data to finetune a series of LLMs to generate higher quality UIs. Finally, we evaluate these models with human judges, and we find that our designer-aligned approaches outperform models trained with traditional ranking feedback and all tested baselines, including GPT-5.
articles.content: 尽管接受了大量数据的训练，大多数大型语言模型（LLMs）仍无法可靠地生成设计良好的用户界面（UI）。设计师的反馈对于提升UI生成性能至关重要；然而，我们发现现有的基于评分或排名的强化学习与人类反馈（RLHF）方法与设计师的工作流程不一致，并忽略了设计师在批评和改进UI设计时所使用的丰富理由。在本文中，我们探讨了设计师如何通过熟悉的交互方式（如评论、草图绘制和直接操作）向UI生成模型提供反馈。我们首先对21位设计师进行了评估，他们使用这些交互方式提供了反馈，共产生了1500条设计注释。随后，我们利用这些数据对一系列大型语言模型进行微调，以生成质量更高的UI。最后，我们通过人类评委对这些模型进行了评估，发现我们的与设计师对齐的方法在性能上优于使用传统排名反馈训练的模型以及所有测试的基线模型，包括GPT-5。

articles.title: FlowDrive: moderated flow matching with data balancing for trajectory planning
articles.author: Lingguang Wang, Ömer Şahin Taş, Marlon Steiner, Christoph Stiller
articles.summary: Learning-based planners are sensitive to the long-tailed distribution of driving data. Common maneuvers dominate datasets, while dangerous or rare scenarios are sparse. This imbalance can bias models toward the frequent cases and degrade performance on critical scenarios. To tackle this problem, we compare balancing strategies for sampling training data and find reweighting by trajectory pattern an effective approach. We then present FlowDrive, a flow-matching trajectory planner that learns a conditional rectified flow to map noise directly to trajectory distributions with few flow-matching steps. We further introduce moderated, in-the-loop guidance that injects small perturbation between flow steps to systematically increase trajectory diversity while remaining scene-consistent. On nuPlan and the interaction-focused interPlan benchmarks, FlowDrive achieves state-of-the-art results among learning-based planners and approaches methods with rule-based refinements. After adding moderated guidance and light post-processing (FlowDrive*), it achieves overall state-of-the-art performance across nearly all benchmark splits. Our code is available at https://github.com/einsteinguang/flow_drive_planner.
articles.content: 基于学习的规划器对驾驶数据的长尾分布较为敏感。常见的驾驶操作在数据集中占主导地位，而危险或罕见的场景则较为稀少。这种不平衡会使模型偏向于频繁出现的情况，从而在关键场景中的性能下降。为了解决这个问题，我们比较了用于采样训练数据的平衡策略，并发现通过轨迹模式进行重新加权是一种有效的方法。接着，我们提出了FlowDrive，这是一种基于流匹配的轨迹规划器，它学习一个条件修正流，以在很少的流匹配步骤中直接将噪声映射到轨迹分布。我们进一步引入了适度的闭环指导，在流步骤之间注入小的扰动，以系统性地增加轨迹多样性，同时保持场景一致性。在nuPlan和以交互为重点的interPlan基准测试中，FlowDrive在基于学习的规划器中取得了最先进的结果，并接近具有基于规则的优化方法的性能。在添加了适度的指导和轻量级后处理（FlowDrive*）后，它在几乎所有基准测试的分割中都达到了总体最先进的性能。我们的代码可在https://github.com/einsteinguang/flow_drive_planner上获取。

articles.title: Toward Safer Diffusion Language Models: Discovery and Mitigation of Priming Vulnerability
articles.author: Shojiro Yamabe, Jun Sakuma
articles.summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) generate tokens in parallel through iterative denoising, which can reduce latency and enable bidirectional conditioning. However, the safety risks posed by jailbreak attacks that exploit this inference mechanism are not well understood. In this paper, we reveal that DLMs have a critical vulnerability stemming from their iterative denoising process and propose a countermeasure. Specifically, our investigation shows that if an affirmative token for a harmful query appears at an intermediate step, subsequent denoising can be steered toward a harmful response even in aligned models. As a result, simply injecting such affirmative tokens can readily bypass the safety guardrails. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the vulnerability allows existing optimization-based jailbreak attacks to succeed on DLMs. Building on this analysis, we propose a novel safety alignment method tailored to DLMs that trains models to generate safe responses from contaminated intermediate states that contain affirmative tokens. Our experiments indicate that the proposed method significantly mitigates the vulnerability with minimal impact on task performance. Furthermore, our method improves robustness against conventional jailbreak attacks. Our work underscores the need for DLM-specific safety research. Our code is available at https://github.com/mdl-lab/dlm-priming-vulnerability.
articles.content: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）通过迭代去噪并行生成标记，这可以减少延迟并实现双向条件控制。然而，利用这种推理机制进行越狱攻击所引发的安全风险尚未被充分理解。在本文中，我们揭示了DLMs存在一个关键漏洞，该漏洞源于其迭代去噪过程，并提出了一种应对措施。具体而言，我们的研究表明，如果在中间步骤中出现有害查询的肯定标记，即使在对齐模型中，后续的去噪过程也可能被引导至有害响应。因此，简单地注入这样的肯定标记即可轻易绕过安全防护。此外，我们证明了这种漏洞使得现有的基于优化的越狱攻击能够成功应用于DLMs。基于这一分析，我们提出了一种针对DLMs的新型安全对齐方法，该方法训练模型从包含肯定标记的受污染中间状态生成安全响应。我们的实验表明，所提出的方法在对任务性能影响最小的情况下显著缓解了该漏洞。此外，我们的方法还提高了对传统越狱攻击的鲁棒性。我们的工作强调了针对DLMs的安全研究的必要性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/mdl-lab/dlm-priming-vulnerability获取。

articles.title: Generalized Parallel Scaling with Interdependent Generations
articles.author: Harry Dong, David Brandfonbrener, Eryk Helenowski, Yun He, Mrinal Kumar, Han Fang, Yuejie Chi, Karthik Abinav Sankararaman
articles.summary: Parallel LLM inference scaling involves sampling a set of $N>1$ responses for a single input prompt. However, these $N$ parallel responses tend to be generated independently from each other, partitioning compute resources and leaving potentially useful information in one generation untapped by others. This is in contrast to response length scaling where past computation is used in all future steps. For higher quality responses and response sets, we propose Bridge to generate interdependent responses in parallel by rethinking batched LLM hidden states as holistic tensors rather than independent slices. With only a small amount (2.8%-5.1%) of new parameters, Bridge improves the relative mean accuracy gains from reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards by up to 39% and boosts consistency of correct responses. Trained once, Bridge scales to any generation width, all with greater performance than independent generations, unlocking a more general mode of parallel scaling that effectively leverages information between sequences, compatible with any post-generation aggregation technique.
articles.content: 并行LLM推理扩展涉及为单个输入提示生成一组N>1的响应。然而，这些N个并行响应往往彼此独立生成，分割计算资源，并且可能在其中一个生成过程中产生的有用信息未被其他生成过程利用。这与响应长度扩展形成对比，在响应长度扩展中，过去的计算会在所有未来的步骤中被使用。为了获得更高质量和响应集的质量，我们提出Bridge，通过重新思考批量LLM隐藏状态作为整体张量而非独立切片，从而并行生成相互依赖的响应。仅需少量新增参数（2.8%-5.1%），Bridge将可验证奖励强化学习的相对平均准确率提升最高达39%，并提高正确响应的一致性。经过一次训练，Bridge可以扩展到任何生成宽度，其性能均优于独立生成，解锁了一种更通用的并行扩展模式，能有效利用序列之间的信息，兼容任何后生成聚合技术。

articles.title: Perfect Clustering for Sparse Directed Stochastic Block Models
articles.author: Behzad Aalipur, Yichen Qin
articles.summary: Exact recovery in stochastic block models (SBMs) is well understood in undirected settings, but remains considerably less developed for directed and sparse networks, particularly when the number of communities diverges. Spectral methods for directed SBMs often lack stability in asymmetric, low-degree regimes, and existing non-spectral approaches focus primarily on undirected or dense settings. We propose a fully non-spectral, two-stage procedure for community detection in sparse directed SBMs with potentially growing numbers of communities. The method first estimates the directed probability matrix using a neighborhood-smoothing scheme tailored to the asymmetric setting, and then applies $K$-means clustering to the estimated rows, thereby avoiding the limitations of eigen- or singular value decompositions in sparse, asymmetric networks. Our main theoretical contribution is a uniform row-wise concentration bound for the smoothed estimator, obtained through new arguments that control asymmetric neighborhoods and separate in- and out-degree effects. These results imply the exact recovery of all community labels with probability tending to one, under mild sparsity and separation conditions that allow both $γ_n \to 0$ and $K_n \to \infty$. Simulation studies, including highly directed, sparse, and non-symmetric block structures, demonstrate that the proposed procedure performs reliably in regimes where directed spectral and score-based methods deteriorate. To the best of our knowledge, this provides the first exact recovery guarantee for this class of non-spectral, neighborhood-smoothing methods in the sparse, directed setting.
articles.content: 在无向设置中，随机块模型（SBMs）中的精确恢复已被充分理解，但在有向和稀疏网络中，尤其是在社区数量趋于无穷时，仍远未成熟。有向SBMs的谱方法在不对称、低度数的设置中通常缺乏稳定性，而现有的非谱方法主要集中在无向或密集设置上。我们提出了一种完全非谱的两阶段方法，用于在社区数量可能增长的稀疏有向SBMs中进行社区检测。该方法首先使用一种针对不对称设置的邻域平滑方案来估计有向概率矩阵，然后对估计的行应用K-均值聚类，从而避免了在稀疏、不对称网络中特征值或奇异值分解的局限性。我们的主要理论贡献是通过控制不对称邻域并分离入度和出度效应的新论证，得到了平滑估计器的统一行集中界。这些结果表明，在温和的稀疏性和分离性条件下，即使γ_n趋于0且K_n趋于无穷，所有社区标签也能以概率趋于1被精确恢复。模拟研究，包括高度有向、稀疏和非对称的块结构，表明所提出的方法在有向谱方法和基于评分的方法退化的情况下仍能可靠运行。据我们所知，这是首次为这一类非谱、邻域平滑方法在稀疏有向设置中提供精确恢复的保证。

articles.title: FlowSteer: Interactive Agentic Workflow Orchestration via End-to-End Reinforcement Learning
articles.author: Mingda Zhang, Haoran Luo, Tiesunlong Shen, Qika Lin, Xiaoying Tang, Rui Mao, Erik Cambria
articles.summary: In recent years, a variety of powerful agentic workflows have been applied to solve a wide range of human problems. However, existing workflow orchestration still faces key challenges, including high manual cost, reliance on specific operators/large language models (LLMs), and sparse reward signals. To address these challenges, we propose FlowSteer, an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework that takes a lightweight policy model as the agent and an executable canvas environment, automating workflow orchestration through multi-turn interaction. In this process, the policy model analyzes execution states and selects editing actions, while the canvas executes operators and returns feedback for iterative refinement. Moreover, FlowSteer provides a plug-and-play framework that supports diverse operator libraries and interchangeable LLM backends. To effectively train this interaction paradigm, we propose Canvas Workflow Relative Policy Optimization (CWRPO), which introduces diversity-constrained rewards with conditional release to stabilize learning and suppress shortcut behaviors. Experimental results on twelve datasets show that FlowSteer significantly outperforms baselines across various tasks.
articles.content: 近年来，各种强大的智能代理工作流程已被应用于解决广泛的人类问题。然而，现有的工作流程编排仍然面临关键挑战，包括高昂的人工成本、对特定操作符/大语言模型（LLMs）的依赖，以及稀疏的奖励信号。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了FlowSteer，一个端到端的强化学习框架，该框架以轻量级策略模型作为代理，结合可执行画布环境，通过多轮交互实现工作流程的自动化编排。在此过程中，策略模型分析执行状态并选择编辑操作，而画布环境则执行操作符并返回反馈以进行迭代优化。此外，FlowSteer提供了一个即插即用的框架，支持多样化的操作符库和可互换的大语言模型后端。为了有效训练这种交互范式，我们提出了画布工作流程相对策略优化（CWRPO），该方法引入了具有条件释放的多样性约束奖励，以稳定学习过程并抑制捷径行为。在十二个数据集上的实验结果表明，FlowSteer在各种任务中显著优于基线方法。

articles.title: Grappa: Gradient-Only Communication for Scalable Graph Neural Network Training
articles.author: Chongyang Xu, Christoph Siebenbrunner, Laurent Bindschaedler
articles.summary: Cross-partition edges dominate the cost of distributed GNN training: fetching remote features and activations per iteration overwhelms the network as graphs deepen and partition counts grow. Grappa is a distributed GNN training framework that enforces gradient-only communication: during each iteration, partitions train in isolation and exchange only gradients for the global update. To recover accuracy lost to isolation, Grappa (i) periodically repartitions to expose new neighborhoods and (ii) applies a lightweight coverage-corrected gradient aggregation inspired by importance sampling. We present an asymptotically unbiased estimator for gradient correction, which we use to develop a minimum-distance batch-level variant that is compatible with common deep-learning packages. We also introduce a shrinkage version that improves stability in practice. Empirical results on real and synthetic graphs show that Grappa trains GNNs 4x faster on average (up to 13x) than state-of-the-art systems, achieves better accuracy especially for deeper models, and sustains training at the trillion-edge scale on commodity hardware. Grappa is model-agnostic, supports full-graph and mini-batch training, and does not rely on high-bandwidth interconnects or caching.
articles.content: 跨分区边主导了分布式GNN训练的成本：随着图的深度增加和分区数量的增多，每次迭代中获取远程特征和激活值会压垮网络。Grappa是一个分布式GNN训练框架，强制仅进行梯度通信：在每次迭代中，各分区独立训练，仅交换用于全局更新的梯度。为了恢复因隔离而损失的精度，Grappa（i）定期重新分区以暴露新的邻域，并（ii）应用一种受重要性抽样启发的轻量级覆盖校正梯度聚合方法。我们提出了一种渐近无偏的梯度校正估计器，并利用它开发了一种与常见深度学习包兼容的最小距离批次级变体。我们还引入了一种收缩版本，以提高实际中的稳定性。在真实和合成图上的实证结果表明，Grappa平均比最先进的系统快4倍（最高达13倍），尤其在更深层模型上精度更好，并且能够在普通硬件上以万亿级边规模持续训练。Grappa与模型无关，支持全图和小批量训练，且不依赖于高带宽互连或缓存。

articles.title: Amortised and provably-robust simulation-based inference
articles.author: Ayush Bharti, Charita Dellaporta, Yuga Hikida, François-Xavier Briol
articles.summary: Complex simulator-based models are now routinely used to perform inference across the sciences and engineering, but existing inference methods are often unable to account for outliers and other extreme values in data which occur due to faulty measurement instruments or human error. In this paper, we introduce a novel approach to simulation-based inference grounded in generalised Bayesian inference and a neural approximation of a weighted score-matching loss. This leads to a method that is both amortised and provably robust to outliers, a combination not achieved by existing approaches. Furthermore, through a carefully chosen conditional density model, we demonstrate that inference can be further simplified and performed without the need for Markov chain Monte Carlo sampling, thereby offering significant computational advantages, with complexity that is only a small fraction of that of current state-of-the-art approaches.
articles.content: 如今，复杂的基于模拟的模型在科学和工程领域中被广泛用于进行推理，但现有的推理方法往往无法处理由于测量仪器故障或人为错误导致的数据中的异常值和其他极端值。在本文中，我们引入了一种基于广义贝叶斯推理和加权得分匹配损失的神经网络近似的新型基于模拟的推理方法。这种方法既具有摊销特性，又在理论上对异常值具有鲁棒性，这是现有方法所无法实现的组合。此外，通过精心选择的条件密度模型，我们证明推理过程可以进一步简化，无需进行马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛采样，从而带来显著的计算优势，其复杂度仅为当前最先进方法的一小部分。

articles.title: Adjoint-based shape optimization of a ship hull using a Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) assisted propulsion surrogate model
articles.author: Moloud Arian Maram, Georgios Bletsos, Thanh Tung Nguyen, Ahmed Hassan, Michael Palm, Thomas Rung
articles.summary: Adjoint-based shape optimization of ship hulls is a powerful tool for addressing high-dimensional design problems in naval architecture, particularly in minimizing the ship resistance. However, its application to vessels that employ complex propulsion systems introduces significant challenges. They arise from the need for transient simulations extending over long periods of time with small time steps and from the reverse temporal propagation of the primal and adjoint solutions. These challenges place considerable demands on the required storage and computing power, which significantly hamper the use of adjoint methods in the industry. To address this issue, we propose a machine learning-assisted optimization framework that employs a Conditional Variational Autoencoder-based surrogate model of the propulsion system. The surrogate model replicates the time-averaged flow field induced by a Voith Schneider Propeller and replaces the geometrically and time-resolved propeller with a data-driven approximation. Primal flow verification examples demonstrate that the surrogate model achieves significant computational savings while maintaining the necessary accuracy of the resolved propeller. Optimization studies show that ignoring the propulsion system can yield designs that perform worse than the initial shape. In contrast, the proposed method produces shapes that achieve more than an 8\% reduction in resistance.
articles.content: 基于伴随方程的船体形状优化是解决船舶设计中高维问题的有力工具，特别是在减少船舶阻力方面。然而，将其应用于采用复杂推进系统的船舶时，会带来显著的挑战。这些挑战源于需要进行长时间、小时间步长的瞬态模拟，以及原问题和伴随问题解的反向时间传播。这些挑战对所需的存储和计算能力提出了巨大要求，这在很大程度上阻碍了伴随方法在工业中的应用。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种结合机器学习的优化框架，该框架采用基于条件变分自编码器的推进系统代理模型。该代理模型复制了Voith Schneider Propeller引起的时均流场，并用数据驱动的近似方法替代了几何和时间解析的推进器。原问题流场验证示例表明，代理模型在保持解析推进器必要精度的同时，实现了显著的计算节省。优化研究表明，忽略推进系统可能会导致性能比初始形状更差的设计。相比之下，所提出的方法生成的形状实现了超过8%的阻力降低。

articles.title: Ensemble-size-dependence of deep-learning post-processing methods that minimize an (un)fair score: motivating examples and a proof-of-concept solution
articles.author: Christopher David Roberts
articles.summary: Fair scores reward ensemble forecast members that behave like samples from the same distribution as the verifying observations.
