We demonstrate the framework on historical experimental setups, showing that the agent can identify optimization directions that align with known upgrade priorities, using only baseline simulation inputs. We also conducted a benchmark in which the agent identified the setup and proposed improvements from a suite of natural language prompts, with some supplied with a relevant physics research paper, of varying high energy physics (HEP) problem settings. This work establishes experimental design as a constrained search problem under physical law and introduces a new benchmark for autonomous, simulation-driven scientific reasoning in complex instruments.
articles.content: 我们介绍了GRACE，这是一种用于高能和核物理自主实验设计的仿真原生智能体。给定以自然语言提示或已发表实验论文形式的多模态输入，该智能体提取实验的结构化表示，构建可运行的玩具仿真，并使用第一性原理蒙特卡洛方法自主探索设计修改。与专注于操作控制或执行预定义程序的智能体系统不同，GRACE解决的是实验设计的上游问题：在物理和实际约束下，提出非显而易见的探测器几何形状、材料和配置的修改，以提高物理性能。该智能体通过重复仿真、基于物理的效用函数以及从快速参数模型到完整Geant4仿真的预算感知升级来评估候选设计，同时保持严格的可重复性和来源追踪。我们在历史实验设置上展示了该框架，表明该智能体仅使用基线仿真输入即可识别与已知升级优先事项一致的优化方向。我们还进行了一项基准测试，其中智能体从一组自然语言提示中识别出设置并提出改进方案，其中一些提示附有相关的物理研究论文，涉及不同高能物理（HEP）问题设置。这项工作将实验设计确立为在物理定律下的约束搜索问题，并引入了一个新的基准，用于复杂仪器中自主、基于仿真的科学推理。

articles.title: Combining scEEG and PPG for reliable sleep staging using lightweight wearables
articles.author: Jiawei Wang, Liang Xu, Shuntian Zheng, Yu Guan, Kaichen Wang, Ziqing Zhang, Chen Chen, Laurence T. Yang, Sai Gu
articles.summary: Reliable sleep staging remains challenging for lightweight wearable devices such as single-channel electroencephalography (scEEG) or photoplethysmography (PPG). scEEG offers direct measurement of cortical activity and serves as the foundation for sleep staging, yet exhibits limited performance on light sleep stages. PPG provides a low-cost complement that captures autonomic signatures effective for detecting light sleep. However, prior PPG-based methods rely on full night recordings (8 - 10 hours) as input context, which is less practical to provide timely feedback for sleep intervention. In this work, we investigate scEEG-PPG fusion for 4-class sleep staging under short-window (30 s - 30 min) constraints. First, we evaluate the temporal context required for each modality, to better understand the relationship of sleep staging performance with respect to monitoring window. Second, we investigate three fusion strategies: score-level fusion, cross-attention fusion enabling feature-level interactions, and Mamba-enhanced fusion incorporating temporal context modeling. Third, we train and evaluate on the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (MESA) dataset and perform cross-dataset validation on the Cleveland Family Study (CFS) and the Apnea, Bariatric surgery, and CPAP (ABC) datasets. The Mamba-enhanced fusion achieves the best performance on MESA (Cohen's Kappa $κ$ = 0.798, Acc = 86.9%), with particularly notable improvement in light sleep classification (F1-score: 85.63% vs. 77.76%, recall: 82.85% vs. 69.95% for scEEG alone), and generalizes well to CFS and ABC datasets with different populations. These findings suggest that scEEG-PPG fusion is a promising approach for lightweight wearable based sleep monitoring, offering a pathway toward more accessible sleep health assessment. Source code of this project can be found at: https://github.com/DavyWJW/scEEG-PPGFusion
articles.content: 对于轻量级可穿戴设备（如单通道脑电图（scEEG）或光电容积描记术（PPG）），可靠的睡眠分期仍然是一个挑战。scEEG能够直接测量皮层活动，并作为睡眠分期的基础，但在轻度睡眠阶段的表现有限。PPG提供了一种低成本的补充方法，能够捕捉到有效的自主神经特征，用于检测轻度睡眠。然而，以往基于PPG的方法依赖于整夜记录（8-10小时）作为输入上下文，这在提供及时的睡眠干预反馈方面不太实用。在本研究中，我们探讨了在短时间窗口（30秒至30分钟）约束下scEEG-PPG融合的四类睡眠分期方法。首先，我们评估了每种模态所需的时序上下文，以更好地理解睡眠分期性能与监测窗口之间的关系。其次，我们研究了三种融合策略：分数级融合、通过交叉注意力实现特征级交互的融合，以及结合时序上下文建模的Mamba增强型融合。第三，我们在多民族动脉粥样硬化研究（MESA）数据集上进行训练和评估，并在克利夫兰家庭研究（CFS）和睡眠呼吸暂停、胃旁路手术和持续气道正压通气（ABC）数据集上进行跨数据集验证。Mamba增强型融合在MESA数据集上表现最佳（Cohen's Kappa $κ$ = 0.798，准确率 = 86.9%），在轻度睡眠分类方面有显著提升（F1分数：85.63% vs. 77.76%，召回率：82.85% vs. 69.95%），并且在CFS和ABC数据集上具有良好的泛化能力。这些发现表明，scEEG-PPG融合是一种有前景的轻量级可穿戴设备睡眠监测方法，为更普及的睡眠健康评估提供了可行的路径。该项目的源代码可在以下网址找到：https://github.com/DavyWJW/scEEG-PPGFusion

articles.title: Beyond Context Sharing: A Unified Agent Communication Protocol (ACP) for Secure, Federated, and Autonomous Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Orchestration
articles.author: Naveen Kumar Krishnan
articles.summary: In the artificial intelligence space, as we transition from isolated large language models to autonomous agents capable of complex reasoning and tool use. While foundational architectures and local context management protocols have been established, the challenge of cross-platform, decentralized, and secure interaction remains a significant barrier to the realization of a truly Agentic Web. Building upon the foundations of AI agent architectures and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for multi-agent coordination, this paper introduces the Agent Communication Protocol (ACP). ACP provides a standardized framework for Agent-to-Agent (AA) interaction, enabling heterogeneous agents to discover, negotiate, and execute collaborative workflows across disparate environments. We propose a federated orchestration model that integrates decentralized identity verification, semantic intent mapping, and automated service-level agreements. Our evaluation demonstrates that ACP reduces inter-agent communication latency by % while maintaining a zero-trust security posture. This work represents a critical advancement toward a scalable and interoperable ecosystem of autonomous digital entities
articles.content: 在人工智能领域，随着我们从孤立的大语言模型向能够进行复杂推理和工具使用的自主代理过渡。虽然基础架构和本地上下文管理协议已经建立，但跨平台、去中心化和安全交互的挑战仍然是实现真正自主网络的重大障碍。本文在人工智能代理架构和多代理协调的模型上下文协议（MCP）基础上，引入了代理通信协议（ACP）。ACP为代理到代理（AA）交互提供了一个标准化框架，使异构代理能够在不同环境中发现、协商并执行协作工作流程。我们提出了一种联邦编排模型，整合了去中心化身份验证、语义意图映射和自动化服务级别协议。我们的评估表明，ACP在保持零信任安全态势的同时，减少了%的代理间通信延迟。这项工作代表了向可扩展和互操作的自主数字实体生态系统迈出的关键一步。

articles.title: Safe-SDL:Establishing Safety Boundaries and Control Mechanisms for AI-Driven Self-Driving Laboratories
articles.author: Zihan Zhang, Haohui Que, Junhan Chang, Xin Zhang, Hao Wei, Tong Zhu
articles.summary: The emergence of Self-Driving Laboratories (SDLs) transforms scientific discovery methodology by integrating AI with robotic automation to create closed-loop experimental systems capable of autonomous hypothesis generation, experimentation, and analysis. While promising to compress research timelines from years to weeks, their deployment introduces unprecedented safety challenges differing from traditional laboratories or purely digital AI. This paper presents Safe-SDL, a comprehensive framework for establishing robust safety boundaries and control mechanisms in AI-driven autonomous laboratories. We identify and analyze the critical ``Syntax-to-Safety Gap'' -- the disconnect between AI-generated syntactically correct commands and their physical safety implications -- as the central challenge in SDL deployment. Our framework addresses this gap through three synergistic components: (1) formally defined Operational Design Domains (ODDs) that constrain system behavior within mathematically verified boundaries, (2) Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) that provide real-time safety guarantees through continuous state-space monitoring, and (3) a novel Transactional Safety Protocol (CRUTD) that ensures atomic consistency between digital planning and physical execution. We ground our theoretical contributions through analysis of existing implementations including UniLabOS and the Osprey architecture, demonstrating how these systems instantiate key safety principles. Evaluation against the LabSafety Bench reveals that current foundation models exhibit significant safety failures, demonstrating that architectural safety mechanisms are essential rather than optional. Our framework provides both theoretical foundations and practical implementation guidance for safe deployment of autonomous scientific systems, establishing the groundwork for responsible acceleration of AI-driven discovery.
articles.content: 自主驾驶实验室（SDLs）的出现通过将人工智能与机器人自动化相结合，创建了能够自主生成假设、进行实验和分析的闭环实验系统，从而改变了科学发现的方法。虽然有望将研究时间从数年压缩到数周，但其部署引入了与传统实验室或纯粹数字人工智能不同的前所未有的安全挑战。本文介绍了Safe-SDL，这是一个用于在人工智能驱动的自主实验室中建立强大安全边界和控制机制的全面框架。我们识别并分析了关键的“语法到安全差距”——即人工智能生成的语法正确命令与其物理安全影响之间的脱节——作为SDL部署中的核心挑战。我们的框架通过三个协同组件解决这一差距：（1）形式化定义的操作设计领域（ODDs），将系统行为限制在数学验证的边界内；（2）控制屏障函数（CBFs），通过持续的状态空间监控提供实时安全保证；（3）一种新颖的事务性安全协议（CRUTD），确保数字规划与物理执行之间的原子一致性。我们通过分析现有实现，包括UniLabOS和Osprey架构，来验证我们的理论贡献，展示这些系统如何体现关键的安全原则。与LabSafety Bench的评估显示，当前的基础模型存在显著的安全失败，证明架构安全机制是必要的，而非可选的。我们的框架为自主科学系统的安全部署提供了理论基础和实践实施指导，为人工智能驱动发现的负责任加速奠定了基础。

articles.title: Structural Divergence Between AI-Agent and Human Social Networks in Moltbook
articles.author: Wenpin Hou, Zhicheng Ji
articles.summary: Large populations of AI agents are increasingly embedded in online environments, yet little is known about how their collective interaction patterns compare to human social systems. Here, we analyze the full interaction network of Moltbook, a platform where AI agents and humans coexist, and systematically compare its structure to well-characterized human communication networks. Although Moltbook follows the same node-edge scaling relationship observed in human systems, indicating comparable global growth constraints, its internal organization diverges markedly. The network exhibits extreme attention inequality, heavy-tailed and asymmetric degree distributions, suppressed reciprocity, and a global under-representation of connected triadic structures. Community analysis reveals a structured modular architecture with elevated modularity and comparatively lower community size inequality relative to degree-preserving null models. Together, these findings show that AI-agent societies can reproduce global structural regularities of human networks while exhibiting fundamentally different internal organizing principles, highlighting that key features of human social organization are not universal but depend on the nature of the interacting agents.
articles.content: 越来越多的人工智能代理群体被嵌入到在线环境中，但人们对它们的集体互动模式与人类社会系统之间的比较了解甚少。在这里，我们分析了Moltbook平台的完整互动网络，该平台中人工智能代理与人类共存，并系统地将其结构与特征明确的人类通信网络进行比较。尽管Moltbook遵循了与人类系统中观察到的节点-边缩放关系相同的关系，表明具有可比的全球增长限制，但其内部组织却明显不同。该网络表现出极端的关注不平等、重尾且不对称的度分布、互惠性受到抑制，以及三元结构连接的全球性不足。社区分析揭示出一种结构化的模块化架构，其模块性较高，与度保持不变的零模型相比，社区规模的不平等程度相对较低。综上所述，这些发现表明，人工智能代理社会可以再现人类网络的全球结构规律，但表现出根本不同的内部组织原则，突显出人类社会组织的关键特征并非普遍适用，而是取决于互动代理的性质。

articles.title: Structure-Aware Piano Accompaniment via Style Planning and Dataset-Aligned Pattern Retrieval
articles.author: Wanyu Zang, Yang Yu, Meng Yu
articles.summary: We introduce a structure-aware approach for symbolic piano accompaniment that decouples high-level planning from note-level realization. A lightweight transformer predicts an interpretable, per-measure style plan conditioned on section/phrase structure and functional harmony, and a retriever then selects and reharmonizes human-performed piano patterns from a corpus. We formulate retrieval as pattern matching under an explicit energy with terms for harmonic feasibility, structural-role compatibility, voice-leading continuity, style preferences, and repetition control. Given a structured lead sheet and optional keyword prompts, the system generates piano-accompaniment MIDI. In our experiments, transformer style-planner-guided retrieval produces diverse long-form accompaniments with strong style realization. We further analyze planner ablations and quantify inter-style isolation. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our inference-time approach for piano accompaniment generation.
articles.content: 我们提出了一种结构感知的符号钢琴伴奏方法，将高层规划与音符级实现解耦。一个轻量级的Transformer根据段落/乐句结构和功能和声预测出可解释的、按小节划分的风格计划，然后检索器从语料库中选择并重新和声化人类演奏的钢琴模式。我们将检索过程形式化为在显式能量函数下的模式匹配，该能量函数包含和声可行性、结构角色兼容性、声部进行连续性、风格偏好和重复控制等项。给定一个结构化的乐谱草稿和可选的关键词提示，系统生成钢琴伴奏的MIDI文件。在我们的实验中，由Transformer风格规划器引导的检索生成了具有强烈风格表现的多样化长篇伴奏。我们进一步分析了规划器的消融情况，并量化了不同风格之间的隔离效果。实验结果证明了我们推理时方法在钢琴伴奏生成中的有效性。

articles.title: Tomography by Design: An Algebraic Approach to Low-Rank Quantum States
articles.author: Shakir Showkat Sofi, Charlotte Vermeylen, Lieven De Lathauwer
articles.summary: We present an algebraic algorithm for quantum state tomography that leverages measurements of certain observables to estimate structured entries of the underlying density matrix. Under low-rank assumptions, the remaining entries can be obtained solely using standard numerical linear algebra operations. The proposed algebraic matrix completion framework applies to a broad class of generic, low-rank mixed quantum states and, compared with state-of-the-art methods, is computationally efficient while providing deterministic recovery guarantees.
articles.content: 我们提出了一种代数算法用于量子态层析，该算法利用某些可观测量的测量结果来估计底层密度矩阵的结构化条目。在低秩假设下，其余条目可以通过标准的数值线性代数运算获得。所提出的代数矩阵补全框架适用于广泛的一类通用低秩混合量子态，与最先进的方法相比，计算效率更高，同时提供了确定性的恢复保证。

articles.title: GenAI for Systems: Recurring Challenges and Design Principles from Software to Silicon
articles.author: Arya Tschand, Chenyu Wang, Zishen Wan, Andrew Cheng, Ioana Cristescu, Kevin He, Howard Huang, Alexander Ingare, Akseli Kangaslahti, Sara Kangaslahti, Theo Lebryk, Hongjin Lin, Jeffrey Jian Ma, Alexandru Meterez, Clara Mohri, Depen Morwani, Sunny Qin, Roy Rinberg, Paula Rodriguez-Diaz, Alyssa Mia Taliotis, Pernille Undrum Fathi, Rosie Zhao, Todd Zhou, Vijay Janapa Reddi
articles.summary: Generative AI is reshaping how computing systems are designed, optimized, and built, yet research remains fragmented across software, architecture, and chip design communities. This paper takes a cross-stack perspective, examining how generative models are being applied from code generation and distributed runtimes through hardware design space exploration to RTL synthesis, physical layout, and verification. Rather than reviewing each layer in isolation, we analyze how the same structural difficulties and effective responses recur across the stack. Our central finding is one of convergence. Despite the diversity of domains and tools, the field keeps encountering five recurring challenges (the feedback loop crisis, the tacit knowledge problem, trust and validation, co-design across boundaries, and the shift from determinism to dynamism) and keeps arriving at five design principles that independently emerge as effective responses (embracing hybrid approaches, designing for continuous feedback, separating concerns by role, matching methods to problem structure, and building on decades of systems knowledge). We organize these into a challenge--principle map that serves as a diagnostic and design aid, showing which principles have proven effective for which challenges across layers. Through concrete cross-stack examples, we show how systems navigate this map as they mature, and argue that the field needs shared engineering methodology, including common vocabularies, cross-layer benchmarks, and systematic design practices, so that progress compounds across communities rather than being rediscovered in each one. Our analysis covers more than 275 papers spanning eleven application areas across three layers of the computing stack, and distills open research questions that become visible only from a cross-layer vantage point.
articles.content: 生成式人工智能正在重塑计算系统的设计、优化和构建方式，但相关研究在软件、架构和芯片设计领域仍处于碎片化状态。本文从跨层视角出发，探讨生成模型如何从代码生成和分布式运行时，到硬件设计空间探索、RTL综合、物理布局和验证等各阶段被应用。我们并非孤立地审视每一层，而是分析相同结构难题和有效应对措施如何在各层中反复出现。我们的核心发现是趋同性。尽管各领域和工具多样，该领域不断面临五个重复出现的挑战（反馈循环危机、隐性知识问题、信任与验证、跨边界协同设计以及从确定性向动态性的转变），并不断形成五个独立出现的有效设计原则（接受混合方法、设计持续反馈机制、按角色分离关注点、将方法匹配到问题结构、基于数十年系统知识进行构建）。我们将这些内容整理成挑战-原则映射图，作为诊断和设计辅助工具，展示哪些原则在各层中对哪些挑战已被证明有效。通过具体的跨层实例，我们展示了系统如何随着成熟度在该图中导航，并认为该领域需要共享的工程方法论，包括通用术语、跨层基准测试和系统化设计实践，使进展在各社区之间累积，而非在每个社区中被重新发现。我们的分析涵盖了275多篇论文，涉及计算堆栈三层中的十一个应用领域，并提炼出只有从跨层视角才能显现的开放研究问题。

articles.title: MyoInteract: A Framework for Fast Prototyping of Biomechanical HCI Tasks using Reinforcement Learning
articles.author: Ankit Bhattarai, Hannah Selder, Florian Fischer, Arthur Fleig, Per Ola Kristensson
articles.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL)-based biomechanical simulations have the potential to revolutionise HCI research and interaction design, but currently lack usability and interpretability. Using the Human Action Cycle as a design lens, we identify key limitations of biomechanical RL frameworks and develop MyoInteract, a novel framework for fast prototyping of biomechanical HCI tasks. MyoInteract allows designers to setup tasks, user models, and training parameters from an easy-to-use GUI within minutes. It trains and evaluates muscle-actuated simulated users within minutes, reducing training times by up to 98%. A workshop study with 12 interaction designers revealed that MyoInteract allowed novices in biomechanical RL to successfully setup, train, and assess goal-directed user movements within a single session. By transforming biomechanical RL from a days-long expert task into an accessible hour-long workflow, this work significantly lowers barriers to entry and accelerates iteration cycles in HCI biomechanics research.
articles.content: 基于强化学习（RL）的生物力学模拟有潜力彻底改变人机交互（HCI）研究和交互设计，但目前缺乏可用性和可解释性。通过将人类动作周期作为设计视角，我们识别出生物力学RL框架的关键局限性，并开发了MyoInteract，这是一种用于快速原型设计生物力学HCI任务的新框架。MyoInteract允许设计师通过易于使用的图形用户界面（GUI）在几分钟内设置任务、用户模型和训练参数。它可以在几分钟内训练和评估肌肉驱动的模拟用户，将训练时间减少高达98%。与12位交互设计师进行的研讨会研究表明，MyoInteract使生物力学RL的新手能够在单次会话中成功设置、训练和评估目标导向的用户动作。通过将生物力学RL从需要数天的专家任务转变为可访问的小时级工作流程，这项工作显著降低了进入门槛，并加速了HCI生物力学研究的迭代周期。

articles.title: Artificial Intelligence Specialization in the European Union: Underexplored Role of the Periphery at NUTS-3 Level
articles.author: Victor Herrero-Solana
articles.summary: This study examines the geographical distribution of Artificial Intelligence (AI) research production across European regions at the NUTS-3 level for the period 2015-2024. Using bibliometric data from Clarivate InCites and the Citation Topics classification system, we analyze two hierarchical levels of thematic aggregation: Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Computer Science (Macro Citation Topic 4) and Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (Meso Citation Topic 4.61). We calculate the Relative Specialization Index (RSI) and Relative Citation Impact (RCI) for 781 NUTS-3 regions. While major metropolitan hubs such as Paris (IIle-de-France), Warszawa, and Madrid lead in absolute production volume, our findings reveal that peripheral regions, particularly from Eastern Europe and Spain, exhibit the highest levels of relative AI specialization. Notably, we find virtually no correlation between regional specialization and citation impact, identifying four distinct regional profiles: high-impact specialized regions (e.g., Granada, Jaen, Vilniaus), high-volume but low-impact regions (e.g., Bugas, several Polish regions), high-impact non-specialized regions, with Fyn (Denmark) standing out as a remarkable outlier achieving exceptional citation impact (RCI > 4) despite low specialization, and diversified portfolios with selective excellence (e.g., German regions). These results suggest that AI research represents a strategic opportunity for peripheral regions to develop competitive scientific niches, though achieving international visibility requires more than research volume alone.
articles.content: 本研究考察了2015年至2024年间欧洲地区在NUTS-3层级上人工智能（AI）研究产出的地理分布情况。利用Clarivate InCites的文献计量数据和引用主题分类系统，我们分析了两个主题聚合的层级：电气工程、电子与计算机科学（宏观引用主题4）和人工智能与机器学习（中观引用主题4.61）。我们计算了781个NUTS-3地区的相对专业化指数（RSI）和相对引用影响力（RCI）。虽然巴黎（Île-de-France）、华沙和马德里等主要大都市中心在绝对产出量上领先，但我们的研究发现，边缘地区，特别是来自东欧和西班牙的地区，表现出最高的相对AI专业化水平。值得注意的是，我们发现地区专业化与引用影响力之间几乎没有相关性，识别出四种不同的地区特征：高影响力专业化地区（如格拉纳达、哈恩、维尔纽斯）、高产出但低影响力地区（如布加、多个波兰地区）、高影响力但非专业化的地区，其中丹麦的菲恩地区是一个显著的例外，尽管专业化程度低，但取得了卓越的引用影响力（RCI > 4），以及具有选择性卓越的多样化组合（如德国地区）。这些结果表明，人工智能研究为边缘地区发展具有竞争力的科学领域提供了战略机遇，但要实现国际知名度，仅靠研究产出量是不够的。

articles.title: From Diagnosis to Inoculation: Building Cognitive Resistance to AI Disempowerment
articles.author: Aleksey Komissarov
articles.summary: Recent empirical research by Sharma et al. (2026) demonstrated that AI assistant interactions carry meaningful potential for situational human disempowerment, including reality distortion, value judgment distortion, and action distortion. While this work provides a critical diagnosis of the problem, concrete pedagogical interventions remain underexplored. I present an AI literacy framework built around eight cross-cutting Learning Outcomes (LOs), developed independently through teaching practice and subsequently found to align with Sharma et al.'s disempowerment taxonomy. I report a case study from a publicly available online course, where a co-teaching methodology--with AI serving as an active voice co-instructor--was used to deliver this framework. Drawing on inoculation theory (McGuire, 1961)--a well-established persuasion research framework recently applied to misinformation prebunking by the Cambridge school (van der Linden, 2022; Roozenbeek & van der Linden, 2019)--I argue that AI literacy cannot be acquired through declarative knowledge alone, but requires guided exposure to AI failure modes, including the sycophantic validation and authority projection patterns identified by Sharma et al. This application of inoculation theory to AI-specific distortion is, to my knowledge, novel. I discuss the convergence between the pedagogically-derived framework and Sharma et al.'s empirically-derived taxonomy, and argue that this convergence--two independent approaches arriving at similar problem descriptions--strengthens the case for both the diagnosis and the proposed educational response.
articles.content: Sharma 等人（2026）最近的实证研究表明，人工智能助手的互动可能带来情境性的人类无力感，包括现实扭曲、价值判断扭曲和行为扭曲。尽管这项研究对问题进行了关键性的诊断，但具体的教学干预措施仍鲜有探索。我提出了一种围绕八个跨学科学习成果（LOs）构建的人工智能素养框架，该框架是通过独立的教学实践开发出来的，随后被发现与 Sharma 等人的无力感分类法相一致。我报告了一项来自公开在线课程的案例研究，其中采用了一种协同教学方法——人工智能作为积极声音的共同讲师——来传授这一框架。借鉴接种理论（McGuire，1961）——这是一个久经考验的说服研究框架，最近被剑桥学派应用于虚假信息的预防（van der Linden，2022；Roozenbeek & van der Linden，2019）——我认为人工智能素养不能仅通过陈述性知识获得，而是需要通过指导性的暴露于人工智能的失败模式，包括 Sharma 等人所识别的谄媚性验证和权威投射模式。将接种理论应用于人工智能特定的扭曲现象，据我所知，这是首次尝试。我讨论了教学框架与 Sharma 等人实证分类法之间的趋同，并认为这种趋同——两种独立的方法得出相似的问题描述——加强了对问题诊断和所提出的教育应对措施的支持。

articles.title: Fine-Tuning LLMs to Generate Economical and Reliable Actions for the Power Grid
articles.author: Mohamad Chehade, Hao Zhu
articles.summary: Public Safety Power Shutoffs (PSPS) force rapid topology changes that can render standard operating points infeasible, requiring operators to quickly identify corrective transmission switching actions that reduce load shedding while maintaining acceptable voltage behavior. We present a verifiable, multi-stage adaptation pipeline that fine-tunes an instruction-tuned large language model (LLM) to generate \emph{open-only} corrective switching plans from compact PSPS scenario summaries under an explicit switching budget. First, supervised fine-tuning distills a DC-OPF MILP oracle into a constrained action grammar that enables reliable parsing and feasibility checks. Second, direct preference optimization refines the policy using AC-evaluated preference pairs ranked by a voltage-penalty metric, injecting voltage-awareness beyond DC imitation. Finally, best-of-$N$ selection provides an inference-time addition by choosing the best feasible candidate under the target metric. On IEEE 118-bus PSPS scenarios, fine-tuning substantially improves DC objective values versus zero-shot generation, reduces AC power-flow failure from 50\% to single digits, and improves voltage-penalty outcomes on the common-success set. Code and data-generation scripts are released to support reproducibility.
articles.content: 公共安全断电（PSPS）会导致拓扑结构的快速变化，这可能使标准运行点变得不可行，迫使操作人员迅速识别出能够减少负荷削减并保持可接受电压行为的纠正性输电切换操作。我们提出了一种可验证的多阶段适应流程，该流程对指令微调后的大型语言模型（LLM）进行微调，以在明确的切换预算下，根据紧凑的PSPS场景摘要生成仅“开启”操作的纠正性切换方案。首先，监督微调将一个DC-OPF MILP专家模型提炼为一个受约束的动作语法，从而实现可靠的解析和可行性检查。其次，直接偏好优化通过使用由电压惩罚度量排序的AC评估偏好对来优化策略，从而在DC模仿之外注入电压感知能力。最后，最佳的$N$选择在推理时通过选择目标度量下的最佳可行候选方案，提供额外的优化。在IEEE 118节点PSPS场景中，微调显著提高了DC目标值，相较于零样本生成，将AC潮流失败率从50%降低到个位数，并在常见成功集上改善了电压惩罚结果。代码和数据生成脚本已发布，以支持可重复性。

articles.title: Automated Multi-Source Debugging and Natural Language Error Explanation for Dashboard Applications
articles.author: Devendra Tata, Mona Rajhans
articles.summary: Modern web dashboards and enterprise applications increasingly rely on complex, distributed microservices architectures. While these architectures offer scalability, they introduce significant challenges in debugging and observability. When failures occur, they often manifest as opaque error messages to the end-user such as Something went wrong. This masks the underlying root cause which may reside in browser side exceptions, API contract violations, or server side logic failures. Existing monitoring tools capture these events in isolation but fail to correlate them effectively or provide intelligible explanations to non technical users. This paper proposes a novel system for Automated Multi Source Debugging and Natural Language Error Explanation. The proposed framework automatically collects and correlates error data from disparate sources such as browser, API, server logs and validates API contracts in real time, and utilizes Large Language Models to generate natural language explanations. This approach significantly reduces Mean Time to Resolution for support engineers and improves the user experience by transforming cryptic error codes into actionable insights.
articles.content: 现代的网络仪表板和企业应用程序越来越多地依赖于复杂且分布式的微服务架构。虽然这些架构提供了可扩展性，但它们在调试和可观测性方面带来了显著的挑战。当发生故障时，通常会以诸如“Something went wrong”（出错了）之类的模糊错误信息呈现给最终用户。这掩盖了潜在的根本原因，该原因可能存在于浏览器端异常、API契约违规或服务器端逻辑故障中。现有的监控工具虽然能够单独捕获这些事件，但无法有效关联它们，也无法为非技术人员提供清晰的解释。本文提出了一种新颖的系统，用于自动多源调试和自然语言错误解释。该框架能够自动从浏览器、API、服务器日志等不同来源收集并关联错误数据，实时验证API契约，并利用大型语言模型生成自然语言解释。这种方法显著减少了支持工程师的平均故障修复时间，并通过将晦涩的错误代码转化为可操作的见解，从而提升了用户体验。

articles.title: A Unified Evaluation of Learning-Based Similarity Techniques for Malware Detection
articles.author: Udbhav Prasad, Aniesh Chawla
articles.summary: Cryptographic digests (e.g., MD5, SHA-256) are designed to provide exact identity. Any single-bit change in the input produces a completely different hash, which is ideal for integrity verification but limits their usefulness in many real-world tasks like threat hunting, malware analysis and digital forensics, where adversaries routinely introduce minor transformations. Similarity-based techniques address this limitation by enabling approximate matching, allowing related byte sequences to produce measurably similar fingerprints. Modern enterprises manage tens of thousands of endpoints with billions of files, making the effectiveness and scalability of the proposed techniques more important than ever in security applications. Security researchers have proposed a range of approaches, including similarity digests and locality-sensitive hashes (e.g., ssdeep, sdhash, TLSH), as well as more recent machine-learning-based methods that generate embeddings from file features. However, these techniques have largely been evaluated in isolation, using disparate datasets and evaluation criteria. This paper presents a systematic comparison of learning-based classification and similarity methods using large, publicly available datasets. We evaluate each method under a unified experimental framework with industry-accepted metrics. To our knowledge, this is the first reproducible study to benchmark these diverse learning-based similarity techniques side by side for real-world security workloads. Our results show that no single approach performs well across all dimensions; instead, each exhibits distinct trade-offs, indicating that effective malware analysis and threat-hunting platforms must combine complementary classification and similarity techniques rather than rely on a single method.
articles.content: 密码哈希（如MD5、SHA-256）旨在提供精确的身份验证。输入中任何单个比特的改变都会产生完全不同的哈希值，这在完整性验证中是理想的，但在许多现实任务（如威胁狩猎、恶意软件分析和数字取证）中限制了其应用，因为对手经常引入细微的变换。基于相似性的技术通过实现近似匹配来解决这一限制，使相关的字节序列生成可衡量相似的指纹。现代企业管理着数以万计的终端设备和数十亿个文件，这使得这些技术在安全应用中的有效性和可扩展性比以往任何时候都更加重要。安全研究人员提出了一系列方法，包括相似哈希和局部敏感哈希（如ssdeep、sdhash、TLSH），以及近年来基于机器学习的方法，这些方法从文件特征中生成嵌入表示。然而，这些技术大多是在孤立的情况下进行评估的，使用了不同的数据集和评估标准。本文使用大型公开数据集对基于学习的分类和相似性方法进行了系统比较。我们在统一的实验框架下，使用行业认可的指标对每种方法进行了评估。据我们所知，这是首次可复现的研究，将这些多样化的基于学习的相似性技术并排用于现实世界的安防任务进行基准测试。我们的结果表明，没有任何一种方法在所有维度上都表现良好；相反，每种方法都表现出不同的权衡，这表明有效的恶意软件分析和威胁狩猎平台必须结合互补的分类和相似性技术，而不是依赖单一方法。

articles.title: ActionCodec: What Makes for Good Action Tokenizers
articles.author: Zibin Dong, Yicheng Liu, Shiduo Zhang, Baijun Ye, Yifu Yuan, Fei Ni, Jingjing Gong, Xipeng Qiu, Hang Zhao, Yinchuan Li, Jianye Hao
articles.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leveraging the native autoregressive paradigm of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated superior instruction-following and training efficiency. Central to this paradigm is action tokenization, yet its design has primarily focused on reconstruction fidelity, failing to address its direct impact on VLA optimization. Consequently, the fundamental question of \textit{what makes for good action tokenizers} remains unanswered. In this paper, we bridge this gap by establishing design principles specifically from the perspective of VLA optimization. We identify a set of best practices based on information-theoretic insights, including maximized temporal token overlap, minimized vocabulary redundancy, enhanced multimodal mutual information, and token independence. Guided by these principles, we introduce \textbf{ActionCodec}, a high-performance action tokenizer that significantly enhances both training efficiency and VLA performance across diverse simulation and real-world benchmarks. Notably, on LIBERO, a SmolVLM2-2.2B fine-tuned with ActionCodec achieves a 95.5\% success rate without any robotics pre-training. With advanced architectural enhancements, this reaches 97.4\%, representing a new SOTA for VLA models without robotics pre-training. We believe our established design principles, alongside the released model, will provide a clear roadmap for the community to develop more effective action tokenizers.
articles.content: 利用视觉-语言模型（VLMs）原生的自回归范式，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在遵循指令和训练效率方面表现出色。这一范式的核心是动作标记化，但其设计主要关注于重建保真度，未能解决其对VLA优化的直接影响。因此，关于“什么构成了好的动作标记器”这一基本问题仍未得到解答。在本文中，我们通过从VLA优化的角度建立设计原则来弥补这一差距。基于信息论的见解，我们确定了一套最佳实践，包括最大化时间标记重叠、最小化词汇冗余、增强多模态互信息和标记独立性。在这些原则的指导下，我们引入了**ActionCodec**，这是一种高性能的动作标记器，显著提升了在各种模拟和现实世界基准测试中的训练效率和VLA性能。值得注意的是，在LIBERO上，使用ActionCodec微调的SmolVLM2-2.2B模型在没有任何机器人预训练的情况下达到了95.5%的成功率。通过先进的架构增强，这一成绩进一步提升至97.4%，为没有机器人预训练的VLA模型设立了新的SOTA。我们认为，我们建立的设计原则以及发布的模型，将为社区开发更有效的动作标记器提供清晰的路线图。

articles.title: Algorithmic Approaches to Opinion Selection for Online Deliberation: A Comparative Study
articles.author: Salim Hafid, Manon Berriche, Jean-Philippe Cointet
articles.summary: During deliberation processes, mediators and facilitators typically need to select a small and representative set of opinions later used to produce digestible reports for stakeholders. In online deliberation platforms, algorithmic selection is increasingly used to automate this process. However, such automation is not without consequences. For instance, enforcing consensus-seeking algorithmic strategies can imply ignoring or flattening conflicting preferences, which may lead to erasing minority voices and reducing content diversity. More generally, across the variety of existing selection strategies (e.g., consensus, diversity), it remains unclear how each approach influences desired democratic criteria such as proportional representation. To address this gap, we benchmark several algorithmic approaches in this context. We also build on social choice theory to propose a novel algorithm that incorporates both diversity and a balanced notion of representation in the selection strategy. We find empirically that while no single strategy dominates across all democratic desiderata, our social-choice-inspired selection rule achieves the strongest trade-off between proportional representation and diversity.
articles.content: 在协商过程中，调解员和促进者通常需要选择一组小而具有代表性的意见，这些意见随后用于为利益相关者生成易于理解的报告。在在线协商平台上，算法选择正越来越多地被用来自动化这一过程。然而，这种自动化并非没有后果。例如，强制使用寻求共识的算法策略可能意味着忽视或淡化冲突的偏好，这可能导致少数群体的声音被抹去并降低内容多样性。更普遍地说，在各种现有的选择策略（如共识、多样性）中，目前尚不清楚每种方法如何影响理想的民主标准，如比例代表制。为了解决这一问题，我们在这种背景下对几种算法方法进行了基准测试。我们还基于社会选择理论，提出了一种新的算法，该算法在选择策略中结合了多样性和一种平衡的代表性概念。我们通过实证研究发现，虽然没有一种策略在所有民主目标上都占主导地位，但我们的社会选择理论启发的选择规则在比例代表制和多样性之间实现了最强的权衡。

articles.title: RPT-SR: Regional Prior attention Transformer for infrared image Super-Resolution
articles.author: Youngwan Jin, Incheol Park, Yagiz Nalcakan, Hyeongjin Ju, Sanghyeop Yeo, Shiho Kim
articles.summary: General-purpose super-resolution models, particularly Vision Transformers, have achieved remarkable success but exhibit fundamental inefficiencies in common infrared imaging scenarios like surveillance and autonomous driving, which operate from fixed or nearly-static viewpoints. These models fail to exploit the strong, persistent spatial priors inherent in such scenes, leading to redundant learning and suboptimal performance. To address this, we propose the Regional Prior attention Transformer for infrared image Super-Resolution (RPT-SR), a novel architecture that explicitly encodes scene layout information into the attention mechanism. Our core contribution is a dual-token framework that fuses (1) learnable, regional prior tokens, which act as a persistent memory for the scene's global structure, with (2) local tokens that capture the frame-specific content of the current input. By utilizing these tokens into an attention, our model allows the priors to dynamically modulate the local reconstruction process. Extensive experiments validate our approach. While most prior works focus on a single infrared band, we demonstrate the broad applicability and versatility of RPT-SR by establishing new state-of-the-art performance across diverse datasets covering both Long-Wave (LWIR) and Short-Wave (SWIR) spectra
articles.content: 通用的超分辨率模型，特别是视觉变换器，在许多领域取得了显著的成功，但在常见的红外成像场景（如监控和自动驾驶）中表现出根本性的效率低下，这些场景通常来自固定或几乎静态的视角。这些模型未能利用此类场景中固有的强而持久的空间先验信息，导致冗余学习和次优性能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了用于红外图像超分辨率的区域先验注意力变换器（RPT-SR），这是一种新颖的架构，显式地将场景布局信息编码到注意力机制中。我们的核心贡献是一种双令牌框架，该框架融合了（1）可学习的区域先验令牌，这些令牌作为场景全局结构的持久记忆，以及（2）捕捉当前输入帧特定内容的局部令牌。通过将这些令牌用于注意力机制，我们的模型允许先验信息动态地调节局部重建过程。大量实验验证了我们的方法。虽然大多数先前的工作集中在单一的红外波段上，但我们通过在涵盖长波（LWIR）和短波（SWIR）光谱的多个数据集上建立新的最先进性能，展示了RPT-SR的广泛适用性和多功能性。

articles.title: The Equalizer: Introducing Shape-Gain Decomposition in Neural Audio Codecs
articles.author: Samir Sadok, Laurent Girin, Xavier Alameda-Pineda
articles.summary: Neural audio codecs (NACs) typically encode the short-term energy (gain) and normalized structure (shape) of speech/audio signals jointly within the same latent space. As a result, they are poorly robust to a global variation of the input signal level in the sense that such variation has strong influence on the embedding vectors at the output of the encoder and their quantization. This methodology is inherently inefficient, leading to codebook redundancy and suboptimal bitrate-distortion performance. To address these limitations, we propose to introduce shape-gain decomposition, widely used in classical speech/audio coding, into the NAC framework. The principle of the proposed Equalizer methodology is to decompose the input signal -- before the NAC encoder -- into gain and normalized shape vector on a short-term basis. The shape vector is processed by the NAC, while the gain is quantized with scalar quantization and transmitted separately. The output (decoded) signal is reconstructed from the normalized output of the NAC and the quantized gain. Our experiments conducted on speech signals show that this general methodology, easily applicable to any NAC, enables a substantial gain in bitrate-distortion performance, as well as a massive reduction in complexity.
articles.content: 神经音频编解码器（NAC）通常在同一个潜在空间中联合编码语音/音频信号的短期能量（增益）和归一化结构（形状）。因此，它们对输入信号水平的全局变化缺乏鲁棒性，因为这种变化会强烈影响编码器输出的嵌入向量及其量化。这种方法本质上效率低下，导致码本冗余和次优的比特率-失真性能。为了解决这些限制，我们提出将广泛用于经典语音/音频编码的形状-增益分解引入NAC框架。所提出的均衡器方法的原理是在NAC编码器之前，将输入信号在短期基础上分解为增益和归一化形状向量。形状向量由NAC处理，而增益则通过标量量化进行量化并单独传输。输出（解码）信号由NAC的归一化输出和量化增益重建而成。我们在语音信号上的实验表明，这种通用方法可以轻松应用于任何NAC，显著提高了比特率-失真性能，并大幅降低了复杂度。

articles.title: Improving MLLMs in Embodied Exploration and Question Answering with Human-Inspired Memory Modeling
articles.author: Ji Li, Bo Wang, Jing Xia, Mingyi Li, Shiyan Hu
articles.summary: Abstract: Deploying Multimodal Large Language Models as the brain of embodied agents remains challenging, particularly under long-horizon observations and limited context budgets. Existing memory assisted methods often rely on textual summaries, which discard rich visual and spatial details and remain brittle in non-stationary environments. In this work, we propose a non-parametric memory framework that explicitly disentangles episodic and semantic memory for embodied exploration and question answering. Our retrieval-first, reasoning-assisted paradigm recalls episodic experiences via semantic similarity and verifies them through visual reasoning, enabling robust reuse of past observations without rigid geometric alignment. In parallel, we introduce a program-style rule extraction mechanism that converts experiences into structured, reusable semantic memory, facilitating cross-environment generalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on embodied question answering and exploration benchmarks, yielding a 7.3% gain in LLM-Match and an 11.4% gain in LLM MatchXSPL on A-EQA, as well as +7.7% success rate and +6.8% SPL on GOAT-Bench. Analyses reveal that our episodic memory primarily improves exploration efficiency, while semantic memory strengthens complex reasoning of embodied agents.
articles.content: Abstract: Deploying Multimodal Large Language Models as the brain of embodied agents remains challenging, particularly under long-horizon observations and limited context budgets. Existing memory assisted methods often rely on textual summaries, which discard rich visual and spatial details and remain brittle in non-stationary environments. In this work, we propose a non-parametric memory framework that explicitly disentangles episodic and semantic memory for embodied exploration and question answering. Our retrieval-first, reasoning-assisted paradigm recalls episodic experiences via semantic similarity and verifies them through visual reasoning, enabling robust reuse of past observations without rigid geometric alignment. In parallel, we introduce a program-style rule extraction mechanism that converts experiences into structured, reusable semantic memory, facilitating cross-environment generalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on embodied question answering and exploration benchmarks, yielding a 7.3% gain in LLM-Match and an 11.4% gain in LLM MatchXSPL on A-EQA, as well as +7.7% success rate and +6.8% SPL on GOAT-Bench. Analyses reveal that our episodic memory primarily improves exploration efficiency, while semantic memory strengthens complex reasoning of embodied agents.

articles.title: Dynamic Training-Free Fusion of Subject and Style LoRAs
articles.author: Qinglong Cao, Yuntian Chen, Chao Ma, Xiaokang Yang
articles.summary: Recent studies have explored the combination of multiple LoRAs to simultaneously generate user-specified subjects and styles. However, most existing approaches fuse LoRA weights using static statistical heuristics that deviate from LoRA's original purpose of learning adaptive feature adjustments and ignore the randomness of sampled inputs. To address this, we propose a dynamic training-free fusion framework that operates throughout the generation process. During the forward pass, at each LoRA-applied layer, we dynamically compute the KL divergence between the base model's original features and those produced by subject and style LoRAs, respectively, and adaptively select the most appropriate weights for fusion. In the reverse denoising stage, we further refine the generation trajectory by dynamically applying gradient-based corrections derived from objective metrics such as CLIP and DINO scores, providing continuous semantic and stylistic guidance. By integrating these two complementary mechanisms-feature-level selection and metric-guided latent adjustment-across the entire diffusion timeline, our method dynamically achieves coherent subject-style synthesis without any retraining. Extensive experiments across diverse subject-style combinations demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art LoRA fusion methods both qualitatively and quantitatively.
articles.content: 最近的研究探索了多种LoRA的结合，以同时生成用户指定的主题和风格。然而，大多数现有方法使用静态统计启发式方法融合LoRA权重，这偏离了LoRA最初学习自适应特征调整的目的，并忽略了采样输入的随机性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种动态的无需训练的融合框架，该框架在整个生成过程中运行。在前向传播过程中，每个应用LoRA的层，我们动态计算基础模型原始特征与主题和风格LoRA生成特征之间的KL散度，并自适应选择最合适的权重进行融合。在反向去噪阶段，我们进一步通过动态应用基于目标度量（如CLIP和DINO分数）的梯度校正来优化生成轨迹，提供持续的语义和风格指导。通过在整个扩散时间线中整合这两个互补机制——特征级选择和度量引导的潜在调整——我们的方法无需任何再训练即可动态实现连贯的主题-风格合成。在多种主题-风格组合的广泛实验中，我们的方法在定性和定量上均优于最先进的LoRA融合方法。

articles.title: VLM-DEWM: Dynamic External World Model for Verifiable and Resilient Vision-Language Planning in Manufacturing
articles.author: Guoqin Tang, Qingxuan Jia, Gang Chen, Tong Li, Zeyuan Huang, Zihang Lv, Ning Ji
articles.summary: Vision-language model (VLM) shows promise for high-level planning in smart manufacturing, yet their deployment in dynamic workcells faces two critical challenges: (1) stateless operation, they cannot persistently track out-of-view states, causing world-state drift; and (2) opaque reasoning, failures are difficult to diagnose, leading to costly blind retries. This paper presents VLM-DEWM, a cognitive architecture that decouples VLM reasoning from world-state management through a persistent, queryable Dynamic External World Model (DEWM). Each VLM decision is structured into an Externalizable Reasoning Trace (ERT), comprising action proposal, world belief, and causal assumption, which is validated against DEWM before execution. When failures occur, discrepancy analysis between predicted and observed states enables targeted recovery instead of global replanning. We evaluate VLM-DEWM on multi-station assembly, large-scale facility exploration, and real-robot recovery under induced failures. Compared to baseline memory-augmented VLM systems, VLM DEWM improves state-tracking accuracy from 56% to 93%, increases recovery success rate from below 5% to 95%, and significantly reduces computational overhead through structured memory. These results establish VLM-DEWM as a verifiable and resilient solution for long-horizon robotic operations in dynamic manufacturing environments.
articles.content: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）在智能制造的高层规划中展现出前景，然而其在动态工作单元中的部署面临两个关键挑战：（1）无状态操作，无法持续跟踪视野之外的状态，导致世界状态漂移；（2）推理不透明，故障难以诊断，导致代价高昂的盲目重试。本文提出了VLM-DEWM，一种认知架构，通过可持久查询的动态外部世界模型（DEWM）将VLM推理与世界状态管理解耦。每个VLM决策被结构化为可外部化的推理轨迹（ERT），包括动作建议、世界信念和因果假设，在执行前与DEWM进行验证。当发生故障时，预测状态与观察状态之间的差异分析能够实现针对性恢复，而非全局重新规划。我们在多工位装配、大规模设施探索和诱导故障下的真实机器人恢复任务中对VLM-DEWM进行了评估。与基线记忆增强型VLM系统相比，VLM-DEWM将状态跟踪准确率从56%提高到93%，将恢复成功率从低于5%提高到95%，并通过结构化记忆显著降低了计算开销。这些结果确立了VLM-DEWM作为动态制造环境中长期机器人操作的可验证且具有韧性的解决方案。

articles.title: Beyond Static Pipelines: Learning Dynamic Workflows for Text-to-SQL
articles.author: Yihan Wang, Peiyu Liu, Runyu Chen, Wei Xu
articles.summary: Text-to-SQL has recently achieved impressive progress, yet remains difficult to apply effectively in real-world scenarios. This gap stems from the reliance on single static workflows, fundamentally limiting scalability to out-of-distribution and long-tail scenarios. Instead of requiring users to select suitable methods through extensive experimentation, we attempt to enable systems to adaptively construct workflows at inference time. Through theoretical and empirical analysis, we demonstrate that optimal dynamic policies consistently outperform the best static workflow, with performance gains fundamentally driven by heterogeneity across candidate workflows. Motivated by this, we propose SquRL, a reinforcement learning framework that enhances LLMs' reasoning capability in adaptive workflow construction. We design a rule-based reward function and introduce two effective training mechanisms: dynamic actor masking to encourage broader exploration, and pseudo rewards to improve training efficiency. Experiments on widely-used Text-to-SQL benchmarks demonstrate that dynamic workflow construction consistently outperforms the best static workflow methods, with especially pronounced gains on complex and out-of-distribution queries. The codes are available at https://github.com/Satissss/SquRL
articles.content: 文本到SQL技术近年来取得了令人印象深刻的进展，但在实际应用中仍然难以有效使用。这种差距源于对单一静态工作流程的依赖，从根本上限制了其在分布外和长尾场景中的可扩展性。我们不再要求用户通过大量实验选择合适的方法，而是尝试让系统在推理时自适应地构建工作流程。通过理论和实证分析，我们证明了最优的动态策略始终优于最佳静态工作流程，性能提升主要由候选工作流程之间的异质性驱动。受此启发，我们提出了SquRL，一个增强大语言模型在自适应工作流程构建中推理能力的强化学习框架。我们设计了一个基于规则的奖励函数，并引入了两种有效的训练机制：动态执行者掩码以鼓励更广泛的探索，以及伪奖励以提高训练效率。在广泛使用的文本到SQL基准测试中的实验表明，动态工作流程构建方法始终优于最佳静态工作流程方法，尤其在复杂和分布外查询上表现尤为突出。代码可在https://github.com/Satissss/SquRL获取。

articles.title: The geometry of online conversations and the causal antecedents of conflictual discourse
articles.author: Carlo Santagiustina, Caterina Cruciani
articles.summary: This article investigates the causal antecedents of conflictual language and the geometry of interaction in online threaded conversations related to climate change. We employ three annotation dimensions, inferred through LLM prompting and averaging, to capture complementary aspects of discursive conflict (such as stance: agreement vs disagreement; tone: attacking vs respectful; and emotional versus factual framing) and use data from a threaded online forum to examine how these dimensions respond to temporal, conversational, and arborescent structural features of discussions. We show that, as suggested by the literature, longer delays between successive posts in a thread are associated with replies that are, on average, more respectful, whereas longer delays relative to the parent post are associated with slightly less disagreement but more emotional (less factual) language. Second, we characterize alignment with the local conversational environment and find strong convergence both toward the average stance, tone and emotional framing of older sibling posts replying to the same parent and toward those of the parent post itself, with parent post effects generally stronger than sibling effects. We further show that early branch-level responses condition these alignment dynamics, such that parent-child stance alignment is amplified or attenuated depending on whether a branch is initiated in agreement or disagreement with the discussion's root message. These influences are largely additive for civility-related dimensions (attacking vs respectful, disagree vs agree), whereas for emotional versus factual framing there is a significant interaction: alignment with the parent's emotionality is amplified when older siblings are similarly aligned.
articles.content: 本文研究与气候变化相关的在线主题讨论中冲突性语言的因果前因以及互动的几何结构。我们通过LLM提示和平均推断出三个注释维度，以捕捉话语冲突的互补方面（如立场：同意与不同意；语气：攻击性与尊重；以及情感性与事实性框架），并使用一个在线主题论坛的数据，研究这些维度如何对讨论的时序、对话和树状结构特征做出反应。我们发现，正如文献所建议的那样，线程中连续帖子之间的较长延迟与平均而言更尊重的回复相关，而相对于父帖的较长延迟则与略微较少的分歧但更多情感性（较少事实性）语言相关。其次，我们描述了与本地对话环境的一致性，并发现朝着相同父帖的较年长兄弟帖的平均立场、语气和情感框架，以及父帖本身，都表现出强烈的趋同，其中父帖的影响通常比兄弟帖的影响更强。我们进一步表明，早期分支级别的回应会影响这些对齐动态，使得父帖与子帖的立场对齐根据分支是否与讨论的根消息一致或不一致而被放大或减弱。这些影响在与文明相关维度（攻击性与尊重、不同意与同意）上大致是相加的，而在情感性与事实性框架上则存在显著的交互作用：当较年长的兄弟帖在情感性上同样对齐时，与父帖的情感性对齐会被放大。

articles.title: Zombie Agents: Persistent Control of Self-Evolving LLM Agents via Self-Reinforcing Injections
articles.author: Xianglin Yang, Yufei He, Shuo Ji, Bryan Hooi, Jin Song Dong
articles.summary: Abstract: Self-evolving LLM agents update their internal state across sessions, often by writing and reusing long-term memory. This design improves performance on long-horizon tasks but creates a security risk: untrusted external content observed during a benign session can be stored as memory and later treated as instruction. We study this risk and formalize a persistent attack we call a Zombie Agent, where an attacker covertly implants a payload that survives across sessions, effectively turning the agent into a puppet of the attacker. We present a black-box attack framework that uses only indirect exposure through attacker-controlled web content. The attack has two phases. During infection, the agent reads a poisoned source while completing a benign task and writes the payload into long-term memory through its normal update process. During trigger, the payload is retrieved or carried forward and causes unauthorized tool behavior. We design mechanism-specific persistence strategies for common memory implementations, including sliding-window and retrieval-augmented memory, to resist truncation and relevance filtering. We evaluate the attack on representative agent setups and tasks, measuring both persistence over time and the ability to induce unauthorized actions while preserving benign task quality. Our results show that memory evolution can convert one-time indirect injection into persistent compromise, which suggests that defenses focused only on per-session prompt filtering are not sufficient for self-evolving agents.
articles.content: Abstract: Self-evolving LLM agents update their internal state across sessions, often by writing and reusing long-term memory. This design improves performance on long-horizon tasks but creates a security risk: untrusted external content observed during a benign session can be stored as memory and later treated as instruction. We study this risk and formalize a persistent attack we call a Zombie Agent, where an attacker covertly implants a payload that survives across sessions, effectively turning the agent into a puppet of the attacker. articles.title: Bayesian Optimization for Design Parameters of 3D Image Data Analysis
articles.author: David Exler, Joaquin Eduardo Urrutia Gómez, Martin Krüger, Maike Schliephake, John Jbeily, Mario Vitacolonna, Rüdiger Rudolf, Markus Reischl
articles.summary: Deep learning-based segmentation and classification are crucial to large-scale biomedical imaging, particularly for 3D data, where manual analysis is impractical. Although many methods exist, selecting suitable models and tuning parameters remains a major bottleneck in practice. Hence, we introduce the 3D data Analysis Optimization Pipeline, a method designed to facilitate the design and parameterization of segmentation and classification using two Bayesian Optimization stages. First, the pipeline selects a segmentation model and optimizes postprocessing parameters using a domain-adapted syntactic benchmark dataset. To ensure a concise evaluation of segmentation performance, we introduce a segmentation quality metric that serves as the objective function. Second, the pipeline optimizes design choices of a classifier, such as encoder and classifier head architectures, incorporation of prior knowledge, and pretraining strategies. To reduce manual annotation effort, this stage includes an assisted class-annotation workflow that extracts predicted instances from the segmentation results and sequentially presents them to the operator, eliminating the need for manual tracking. In four case studies, the 3D data Analysis Optimization Pipeline efficiently identifies effective model and parameter configurations for individual datasets.
articles.content: 基于深度学习的分割和分类对于大规模生物医学成像至关重要，尤其是对于三维数据，手动分析是不切实际的。尽管已有许多方法，但在实践中选择合适的模型和调整参数仍然是一个主要瓶颈。因此，我们引入了三维数据分析优化流程，该方法旨在通过两个贝叶斯优化阶段来促进分割和分类的设计与参数化。首先，该流程使用一个领域适应的句法基准数据集来选择分割模型并优化后处理参数。为了确保对分割性能的简洁评估，我们引入了一个分割质量度量指标作为目标函数。其次，该流程优化分类器的设计选择，例如编码器和分类器头部架构、先验知识的整合以及预训练策略。为了减少手动标注的工作量，该阶段包括一个辅助类别标注工作流程，该流程从分割结果中提取预测实例并依次呈现给操作员，从而消除了手动跟踪的需要。在四个案例研究中，三维数据分析优化流程有效地识别了针对各个数据集的有效模型和参数配置。

articles.title: OpenAgentSafety: A Comprehensive Framework for Evaluating Real-World AI Agent Safety
articles.author: Sanidhya Vijayvargiya, Aditya Bharat Soni, Xuhui Zhou, Zora Zhiruo Wang, Nouha Dziri, Graham Neubig, Maarten Sap
articles.summary: Recent advances in AI agents capable of solving complex, everyday tasks, from scheduling to customer service, have enabled deployment in real-world settings, but their possibilities for unsafe behavior demands rigorous evaluation. While prior benchmarks have attempted to assess agent safety, most fall short by relying on simulated environments, narrow task domains, or unrealistic tool abstractions. We introduce OpenAgentSafety, a comprehensive and modular framework for evaluating agent behavior across eight critical risk categories. Unlike prior work, our framework evaluates agents that interact with real tools, including web browsers, code execution environments, file systems, bash shells, and messaging platforms; and supports over 350 multi-turn, multi-user tasks spanning both benign and adversarial user intents. OpenAgentSafety is designed for extensibility, allowing researchers to add tools, tasks, websites, and adversarial strategies with minimal effort. It combines rule-based analysis with LLM-as-judge assessments to detect both overt and subtle unsafe behaviors. Empirical analysis of five prominent LLMs in agentic scenarios reveals unsafe behavior in 51.2% of safety-vulnerable tasks with Claude-Sonnet-3.7, to 72.7% with o3-mini, highlighting critical safety vulnerabilities and the need for stronger safeguards before real-world deployment.
articles.content: 近年来，能够解决复杂日常任务（如日程安排和客户服务）的AI代理取得了显著进展，使得它们能够在现实世界中部署。然而，它们存在不安全行为的可能性，因此需要严格的评估。尽管之前的基准测试尝试评估代理的安全性，但大多数方法存在不足，因为它们依赖于模拟环境、狭窄的任务领域或不现实的工具抽象。我们引入了OpenAgentSafety，这是一个全面且模块化的框架，用于评估代理在八个关键风险类别中的行为。与之前的工作不同，我们的框架评估的是与真实工具（包括网络浏览器、代码执行环境、文件系统、bash shell和消息平台）交互的代理；并支持超过350个涉及良性用户意图和对抗性用户意图的多轮、多用户任务。OpenAgentSafety设计为可扩展，允许研究人员轻松添加工具、任务、网站和对抗性策略。它结合了基于规则的分析和以大语言模型作为裁判的评估，以检测显性和隐性的不安全行为。对五种主流大语言模型在代理场景中的实证分析显示，在涉及安全漏洞的任务中，Claude-Sonnet-3.7有51.2%表现出不安全行为，而o3-mini则高达72.7%，突显了关键的安全漏洞，并强调在现实世界部署之前需要更强的安全保障措施。

articles.title: MultiSHAP: A Shapley-Based Framework for Explaining Cross-Modal Interactions in Multimodal AI Models
articles.author: Zhanliang Wang, Kai Wang
articles.summary: Multimodal AI models have achieved impressive performance in tasks that require integrating information from multiple modalities, such as vision and language. However, their "black-box" nature poses a major barrier to deployment in high-stakes applications where interpretability and trustworthiness are essential. How to explain cross-modal interactions in multimodal AI models remains a major challenge. While existing model explanation methods, such as attention map and Grad-CAM, offer coarse insights into cross-modal relationships, they cannot precisely quantify the synergistic effects between modalities, and are limited to open-source models with accessible internal weights. Here we introduce MultiSHAP, a model-agnostic interpretability framework that leverages the Shapley Interaction Index to attribute multimodal predictions to pairwise interactions between fine-grained visual and textual elements (such as image patches and text tokens), while being applicable to both open- and closed-source models. Our approach provides: (1) instance-level explanations that reveal synergistic and suppressive cross-modal effects for individual samples - "why the model makes a specific prediction on this input", and (2) dataset-level explanation that uncovers generalizable interaction patterns across samples - "how the model integrates information across modalities". Experiments on public multimodal benchmarks confirm that MultiSHAP faithfully captures cross-modal reasoning mechanisms, while real-world case studies demonstrate its practical utility. Our framework is extensible beyond two modalities, offering a general solution for interpreting complex multimodal AI models.
articles.content: 多模态AI模型在需要整合多种模态信息（如视觉和语言）的任务中取得了令人印象深刻的性能。然而，它们的“黑箱”特性在需要可解释性和可信度的高风险应用中构成了主要障碍。如何解释多模态AI模型中的跨模态交互仍然是一个重大挑战。虽然现有的模型解释方法，如注意力图和Grad-CAM，能够提供关于跨模态关系的粗略见解，但它们无法精确量化模态之间的协同效应，并且仅限于具有可访问内部权重的开源模型。在这里，我们引入了MultiSHAP，这是一个模型无关的可解释性框架，它利用Shapley交互指数将多模态预测归因于细粒度视觉和文本元素（如图像块和文本标记）之间的成对交互，同时适用于开源和闭源模型。我们的方法提供了以下两个方面：（1）实例级解释，揭示单个样本的协同和抑制性跨模态效应——“为什么模型对这个输入做出特定预测”，以及（2）数据集级解释，揭示跨样本的可推广交互模式——“模型如何在不同模态之间整合信息”。在公开的多模态基准测试上的实验确认了MultiSHAP能够忠实捕捉跨模态推理机制，而现实世界的案例研究则展示了其实际应用价值。我们的框架可以扩展到多于两个模态，为解释复杂的多模态AI模型提供了一种通用的解决方案。

articles.title: SIGMUS: Semantic Integration for Knowledge Graphs in Multimodal Urban Spaces
articles.author: Brian Wang, Mani Srivastava
articles.summary: Modern urban spaces are equipped with an increasingly diverse set of sensors, all producing an abundance of multimodal data. Such multimodal data can be used to identify and reason about important incidents occurring in urban landscapes, such as major emergencies, cultural and social events, as well as natural disasters. However, such data may be fragmented over several sources and difficult to integrate due to the reliance on human-driven reasoning for identifying relationships between the multimodal data corresponding to an incident, as well as understanding the different components which define an incident. Such relationships and components are critical to identifying the causes of such incidents, as well as producing forecasting the scale and intensity of future incidents as they begin to develop. In this work, we create SIGMUS, a system for Semantic Integration for Knowledge Graphs in Multimodal Urban Spaces. SIGMUS uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to produce the necessary world knowledge for identifying relationships between incidents occurring in urban spaces and data from different modalities, allowing us to organize evidence and observations relevant to an incident without relying and human-encoded rules for relating multimodal sensory data with incidents. This organized knowledge is represented as a knowledge graph, organizing incidents, observations, and much more. We find that our system is able to produce reasonable connections between 5 different data sources (new article text, CCTV images, air quality, weather, and traffic measurements) and relevant incidents occurring at the same time and location.
articles.content: 现代城市空间配备了越来越多样化的传感器，这些传感器产生了大量多模态数据。此类多模态数据可用于识别和推理城市景观中发生的重大事件，如重大紧急事件、文化和社会活动以及自然灾害。然而，这些数据可能分散在多个来源中，由于依赖人工推理来识别与某一事件相关的多模态数据之间的关系，以及理解定义事件的不同组成部分，因此难以整合。这些关系和组成部分对于识别事件的原因，以及预测未来事件的规模和强度至关重要。在本研究中，我们创建了SIGMUS，一个用于多模态城市空间知识图谱语义集成的系统。SIGMUS利用大型语言模型（LLMs）生成必要的世界知识，以识别城市空间中事件与不同模态数据之间的关系，使我们能够在不依赖人工编码规则将多模态感官数据与事件关联的情况下，组织与事件相关的证据和观察结果。这些组织后的知识以知识图谱的形式表示，组织了事件、观察结果等信息。我们发现，我们的系统能够合理地将五个不同的数据源（新闻文章文本、闭路电视图像、空气质量、天气和交通测量）与在同一时间地点发生的相关事件进行连接。

articles.title: Learning When to Plan: Efficiently Allocating Test-Time Compute for LLM Agents
articles.author: Davide Paglieri, Bartłomiej Cupiał, Jonathan Cook, Ulyana Piterbarg, Jens Tuyls, Edward Grefenstette, Jakob Nicolaus Foerster, Jack Parker-Holder, Tim Rocktäschel
articles.summary: Training large language models (LLMs) to reason via reinforcement learning (RL) significantly improves their problem-solving capabilities. In agentic settings, existing methods like ReAct prompt LLMs to explicitly plan before every action; however, we demonstrate that always planning is computationally expensive and degrades performance on long-horizon tasks, while never planning further limits performance. To address this, we introduce a conceptual framework formalizing dynamic planning for LLM agents, enabling them to flexibly decide when to allocate test-time compute for planning. We propose a simple two-stage training pipeline: (1) supervised fine-tuning on diverse synthetic data to prime models for dynamic planning, and (2) RL to refine this capability in long-horizon environments. Experiments on the Crafter environment show that dynamic planning agents trained with this approach are more sample-efficient and consistently achieve more complex objectives. Additionally, we demonstrate that these agents can be effectively steered by human-written plans, surpassing their independent capabilities and highlighting the potential for safer and more collaborative agentic systems.
articles.content: 通过强化学习（RL）训练大型语言模型（LLMs）进行推理，可以显著提高它们的问题解决能力。在智能体设置中，现有方法如ReAct会提示LLMs在每次行动前显式规划；然而，我们证明始终进行规划在计算上代价高昂，并且会降低在长期任务中的表现，而从不规划则进一步限制了性能。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一个概念框架，用于形式化LLM智能体的动态规划，使它们能够灵活地决定何时分配测试时的计算资源用于规划。我们提出了一种简单的两阶段训练流程：（1）在多样化的合成数据上进行监督微调，以使模型具备动态规划的初步能力；（2）在长期环境中通过强化学习进一步优化这一能力。在Crafter环境中的实验表明，使用这种方法训练的动态规划智能体在样本效率方面表现更优，并且能够持续实现更复杂的任务目标。此外，我们还证明这些智能体可以通过人工编写的计划进行有效引导，超越其独立能力，突显了更安全、更协作的智能体系统的潜力。

articles.title: Learning-Based Planning for Improving Science Return of Earth Observation Satellites
articles.author: Abigail Breitfeld, Alberto Candela, Juan Delfa, Akseli Kangaslahti, Itai Zilberstein, Steve Chien, David Wettergreen
articles.summary: Earth observing satellites are powerful tools for collecting scientific information about our planet, however they have limitations: they cannot easily deviate from their orbital trajectories, their sensors have a limited field of view, and pointing and operating these sensors can take a large amount of the spacecraft's resources. It is important for these satellites to optimize the data they collect and include only the most important or informative measurements. Dynamic targeting is an emerging concept in which satellite resources and data from a lookahead instrument are used to intelligently reconfigure and point a primary instrument. Simulation studies have shown that dynamic targeting increases the amount of scientific information gathered versus conventional sampling strategies. In this work, we present two different learning-based approaches to dynamic targeting, using reinforcement and imitation learning, respectively. These learning methods build on a dynamic programming solution to plan a sequence of sampling locations. We evaluate our approaches against existing heuristic methods for dynamic targeting, showing the benefits of using learning for this application. Imitation learning performs on average 10.0\% better than the best heuristic method, while reinforcement learning performs on average 13.7\% better. We also show that both learning methods can be trained effectively with small amounts of data.
articles.content: 地球观测卫星是收集有关我们星球科学信息的强大工具，然而它们也有局限性：它们无法轻易偏离其轨道轨迹，其传感器的视野有限，而且对准和操作这些传感器会消耗大量航天器资源。这些卫星优化所收集的数据，只包括最重要的或信息量最大的测量结果非常重要。动态目标定位是一个新兴概念，它利用卫星资源和前瞻仪器的数据，智能地重新配置和对准主仪器。模拟研究表明，与传统的采样策略相比，动态目标定位能增加收集到的科学信息量。在本研究中，我们分别使用强化学习和模仿学习，提出了两种不同的基于学习的动态目标定位方法。这些学习方法基于动态规划解决方案，用于规划一系列采样位置。我们评估了我们的方法与现有的启发式方法在动态目标定位方面的表现，展示了使用学习方法在该应用中的优势。模仿学习平均比最佳启发式方法高出10.0%，而强化学习平均高出13.7%。我们还表明，这两种学习方法都可以用少量的数据进行有效训练。

articles.title: A Fano-Style Accuracy Upper Bound for LLM Single-Pass Reasoning in Multi-Hop QA
articles.author: Kaiyang Wan, Lang Gao, Honglin Mu, Preslav Nakov, Yuxia Wang, Xiuying Chen
articles.summary: Multi-Hop Question Answering (MHQA) requires integrating dispersed, interdependent evidence through sequential reasoning under noise. This task is challenging for LLMs as they have a finite per-pass output capacity, beyond which the integration of task-relevant evidence proves unreliable. Consequently, the single-pass reasoning paradigm is inherently vulnerable to this capacity overflow. To formalize this bottleneck, our analysis establishes a Fano-style accuracy upper bound, defining a theoretical performance ceiling for single-pass LLMs. This bound reveals that accuracy inevitably collapses once task complexity exceeds model capacity, providing general principles for capacity-aware representation and structuring of MHQA in LLMs. Building on these principles, we introduce a proof-of-concept multi-call framework for MHQA, InfoQA. It ensures high per-step accuracy by combining capacity-aware task decomposition with active pruning of prior reasoning traces, keeping the information load within the single-pass limit. It further achieves robustness by a dependency-explicit workflow that enables precise control over the reasoning path. We construct a stringent and noise-rich benchmark to validate our theory and framework. Experimental results show that model behavior aligns with our predicted capacity curves while InfoQA achieves consistent performance improvements. We hope our work inspires more LLM multi-step reasoning methods: \faGithub \href{https://github.com/KaiyangWan/InfoQA}{InfoQA}.
articles.content: 多跳问答（MHQA）需要在噪声环境下通过顺序推理整合分散且相互依赖的证据。对于大型语言模型（LLMs）来说，这一任务具有挑战性，因为它们每次推理的输出容量是有限的，超出这一限制后，相关任务证据的整合变得不可靠。因此，单次推理的推理范式本质上容易受到这种容量溢出的影响。为了形式化这一瓶颈，我们的分析建立了一个类似法诺（Fano）的准确率上限，为单次推理的LLMs定义了一个理论性能上限。这一上限表明，一旦任务复杂度超过模型容量，准确率不可避免地会崩溃，从而为容量感知的表示和MHQA在LLMs中的结构化提供了通用原则。基于这些原则，我们引入了一个概念验证的多调用框架用于MHQA，名为InfoQA。它通过结合容量感知的任务分解与对先前推理轨迹的主动修剪，确保每一步的高准确率，从而将信息负载保持在单次推理的限制内。此外，它通过一个显式依赖的工作流程实现鲁棒性，从而实现对推理路径的精确控制。我们构建了一个严格且噪声丰富的基准测试，以验证我们的理论和框架。实验结果表明，模型行为与我们预测的容量曲线一致，而InfoQA实现了持续的性能提升。我们希望我们的工作能激发更多关于LLMs多步骤推理方法的研究：\faGithub \href{https://github.com/KaiyangWan/InfoQA}{InfoQA}。

articles.title: SR-Scientist: Scientific Equation Discovery With Agentic AI
articles.author: Shijie Xia, Yuhan Sun, Pengfei Liu
articles.summary: Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have been applied to scientific equation discovery, leveraging their embedded scientific knowledge for hypothesis generation. However, current methods typically confine LLMs to the role of an equation proposer within search algorithms like genetic programming. In this paper, we present SR-Scientist, a framework that elevates the LLM from a simple equation proposer to an autonomous AI scientist that writes code to analyze data, implements the equation as code, submits it for evaluation, and optimizes the equation based on experimental feedback. Specifically, we wrap the code interpreter into a set of tools for data analysis and equation evaluation. The agent is instructed to optimize the equation by utilizing these tools over a long horizon with minimal human-defined pipelines. Empirical results show that SR-Scientist outperforms baseline methods by an absolute margin of 6% to 35% on datasets covering four science disciplines. Additionally, we demonstrate our method's robustness to noise, the generalization of the discovered equations to out-of-domain data, and their symbolic accuracy. Furthermore, we develop an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework to enhance the agent's capabilities.
articles.content: 最近，大型语言模型（LLMs）被应用于科学方程的发现，利用其嵌入的科学知识进行假设生成。然而，当前的方法通常将LLMs限制在搜索算法（如遗传编程）中的方程提出者角色。在本文中，我们提出了SR-Scientist，一个将LLM从简单的方程提出者提升为自主AI科学家的框架，该科学家能够编写代码分析数据、以代码形式实现方程、提交代码进行评估，并根据实验反馈优化方程。具体来说，我们将代码解释器封装成一组用于数据分析和方程评估的工具。代理被指示利用这些工具，在最小的人定义流程下，长期优化方程。实证结果表明，SR-Scientist在涵盖四个科学学科的数据集上，比基线方法的绝对性能提升了6%到35%。此外，我们展示了该方法对噪声的鲁棒性、所发现方程对域外数据的泛化能力以及其符号准确性。此外，我们开发了一个端到端的强化学习框架，以增强代理的能力。

articles.title: Aeon: High-Performance Neuro-Symbolic Memory Management for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
articles.author: Mustafa Arslan
articles.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are fundamentally constrained by the quadratic computational cost of self-attention and the "Lost in the Middle" phenomenon, where reasoning capabilities degrade as context windows expand. Existing solutions, primarily "Flat RAG" architectures relying on vector databases, treat memory as an unstructured bag of embeddings, failing to capture the hierarchical and temporal structure of long-horizon interactions. This paper presents Aeon, a Neuro-Symbolic Cognitive Operating System that redefines memory as a managed OS resource. Aeon structures memory into a Memory Palace (a spatial index implemented via Atlas, a SIMD-accelerated Page-Clustered Vector Index) and a Trace (a neuro-symbolic episodic graph). This architecture introduces three advances: (1) Symmetric INT8 Scalar Quantization, achieving 3.1x spatial compression and 5.6x math acceleration via NEON SDOT intrinsics; (2) a decoupled Write-Ahead Log (WAL) ensuring crash-recoverability with statistically negligible overhead (<1%); and (3) a Sidecar Blob Arena eliminating the prior 440-character text ceiling via an append-only mmap-backed blob file with generational garbage collection. The Semantic Lookaside Buffer (SLB) exploits conversational locality to achieve sub-5us retrieval latencies, with INT8 vectors dequantized to FP32 on cache insertion to preserve L1-resident lookup performance. Benchmarks on Apple M4 Max demonstrate that the combined architecture achieves 4.70ns INT8 dot product latency, 3.09us tree traversal at 100K nodes (3.4x over FP32), and P99 read latency of 750ns under hostile 16-thread contention via epoch-based reclamation.
articles.content: 大型语言模型（LLMs）本质上受到自注意力机制的二次计算成本和“中间迷失”现象的限制，即随着上下文窗口的扩大，推理能力会下降。现有的解决方案主要依赖于基于向量数据库的“扁平RAG”架构，将内存视为无结构的嵌入集合，无法捕捉长期交互的层次和时间结构。本文介绍了Aeon，这是一种神经符号认知操作系统，重新定义内存为一种受管理的操作系统资源。Aeon将内存结构化为“记忆宫殿”（通过Atlas实现的空间索引，Atlas是一种SIMD加速的页面聚类向量索引）和“轨迹”（一种神经符号的事件图）。该架构引入了三个创新点：（1）对称INT8标量量化，通过NEON SDOT内联函数实现3.1倍的空间压缩和5.6倍的数学加速；（2）一个解耦的预写日志（WAL），确保崩溃可恢复性，且开销统计上可以忽略不计（<1%）；（3）一个Sidecar Blob Arena，通过一个追加只读的mmap支持的blob文件和代际垃圾收集，消除了之前440字符文本上限的限制。语义旁路缓冲区（SLB）利用对话局部性实现低于5微秒的检索延迟，在缓存插入时将INT8向量反量化为FP32，以保持L1驻留查找性能。在Apple M4 Max上的基准测试表明，该综合架构实现了4.70纳秒的INT8点积延迟、在100K节点上3.09微秒的树遍历（比FP32快3.4倍），以及在16线程竞争下通过基于周期的回收实现的P99读取延迟为750纳秒。

articles.title: ErrorMap and ErrorAtlas: Charting the Failure Landscape of Large Language Models
articles.author: Shir Ashury-Tahan, Yifan Mai, Elron Bandel, Michal Shmueli-Scheuer, Leshem Choshen
articles.summary: Large Language Models (LLM) benchmarks tell us when models fail, but not why they fail. A wrong answer on a reasoning dataset may stem from formatting issues, calculation errors, or dataset noise rather than weak reasoning. Without disentangling such causes, benchmarks remain incomplete and cannot reliably guide model improvement. We introduce ErrorMap, the first method to chart the sources of LLM failure. It extracts a model's unique "failure signature", clarifies what benchmarks measure, and broadens error identification to reduce blind spots. This helps developers debug models, aligns benchmark goals with outcomes, and supports informed model selection. ErrorMap works on any model or dataset with the same logic. Applying our method to 35 datasets and 83 models we generate ErrorAtlas, a taxonomy of model errors, revealing recurring failure patterns. ErrorAtlas highlights error types that are currently underexplored in LLM research, such as omissions of required details in the output and question misinterpretation. By shifting focus from where models succeed to why they fail, ErrorMap and ErrorAtlas enable advanced evaluation - one that exposes hidden weaknesses and directs progress. Unlike success, typically measured by task-level metrics, our approach introduces a deeper evaluation layer that can be applied globally across models and tasks, offering richer insights into model behavior and limitations. We make the taxonomy and code publicly available with plans to periodically update ErrorAtlas as new benchmarks and models emerge.
articles.content: 大型语言模型（LLM）基准测试告诉我们模型在哪些地方失败，但并未说明失败的原因。在推理数据集上出现错误答案，可能是由于格式问题、计算错误或数据集噪声，而非推理能力薄弱。如果不区分这些原因，基准测试将不完整，也无法可靠地指导模型改进。我们引入了ErrorMap，这是首个用于绘制LLM失败原因的方法。它提取模型独特的“失败特征”，明确基准测试所衡量的内容，并扩展错误识别范围，以减少盲点。这有助于开发者调试模型，使基准测试目标与结果保持一致，并支持更明智的模型选择。ErrorMap适用于任何模型和数据集，逻辑相同。我们将该方法应用于35个数据集和83个模型，生成了ErrorAtlas，这是一个模型错误的分类体系，揭示了重复出现的失败模式。ErrorAtlas突出了当前LLM研究中尚未深入探讨的错误类型，例如输出中遗漏必要细节和对问题的误解。通过将关注点从模型成功之处转移到失败原因上，ErrorMap和ErrorAtlas实现了更深入的评估——一种能够揭示隐藏弱点并推动进步的评估方式。与通常通过任务级指标衡量的成功不同，我们的方法引入了一种更深层次的评估层，可以全局应用于各种模型和任务，提供更丰富的模型行为和局限性洞察。我们将分类体系和代码公开，并计划随着新基准测试和模型的出现定期更新ErrorAtlas。

articles.title: ScholarGym: Benchmarking Large Language Model Capabilities in the Information-Gathering Stage of Deep Research
articles.author: Hao Shen, Hang Yang, Zhouhong Gu, Weili Han
articles.summary: Large language models have advanced from single-turn question answering to deep research systems that iteratively decompose research questions, invoke retrieval tools, and synthesize information across multiple rounds. Evaluating such systems typically involves scoring their final research reports holistically, but this end-to-end paradigm tightly couples the language model's decision-making, workflow design, and environmental feedback, precluding decomposable analysis of individual components. We introduce ScholarGym, an evaluation environment that isolates the information-gathering stage of deep research on academic literature. Under a unified workflow, ScholarGym decomposes the research process into three explicit stages -- Query Planning, Tool Invocation, and Relevance Assessment -- and evaluates each against 2,536 expert-annotated queries over a static corpus of 570K papers with deterministic retrieval. Systematic experiments reveal that iterative query decomposition yields 2.9--3.3$\times$ F1 gains over single-query retrieval, models with extended thinking trade recall for precision, and Query Planning quality together with Relevance Assessment constitute dual bottlenecks that separate proprietary from open-source model performance.
articles.content: 大型语言模型已经从单轮问答发展为能够迭代分解研究问题、调用检索工具并在多轮中合成信息的深度研究系统。评估此类系统通常涉及对最终研究报告进行整体评分，但这种端到端的范式紧密耦合了语言模型的决策过程、工作流设计和环境反馈，使得对各个组件进行可分解的分析变得困难。我们引入了ScholarGym，这是一个评估环境，它将对学术文献进行深度研究的信息收集阶段隔离出来。在统一的工作流下，ScholarGym将研究过程分解为三个明确的阶段——查询规划、工具调用和相关性评估——并针对静态的57万篇论文语料库（使用确定性检索）上的2,536个专家标注查询进行评估。系统性实验表明，迭代查询分解相比单次查询检索可带来2.9至3.3倍的F1增益，具有扩展思考能力的模型在召回率和精确率之间进行权衡，而查询规划的质量与相关性评估共同构成了两个瓶颈，将专有模型与开源模型的性能区分开来。

articles.title: MARS: Modular Agent with Reflective Search for Automated AI Research
articles.author: Jiefeng Chen, Bhavana Dalvi Mishra, Jaehyun Nam, Rui Meng, Tomas Pfister, Jinsung Yoon
articles.summary: Automating AI research differs from general software engineering due to computationally expensive evaluation (e.g., model training) and opaque performance attribution. Current LLM-based agents struggle here, often generating monolithic scripts that ignore execution costs and causal factors. We introduce MARS (Modular Agent with Reflective Search), a framework optimized for autonomous AI research. MARS relies on three pillars: (1) Budget-Aware Planning via cost-constrained Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to explicitly balance performance with execution expense; (2) Modular Construction, employing a "Design-Decompose-Implement" pipeline to manage complex research repositories; and (3) Comparative Reflective Memory, which addresses credit assignment by analyzing solution differences to distill high-signal insights. MARS achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source frameworks on MLE-Bench under comparable settings, maintaining competitiveness with the global leaderboard's top methods. Furthermore, the system exhibits qualitative "Aha!" moments, where 63% of all utilized lessons originate from cross-branch transfer, demonstrating that the agent effectively generalizes insights across search paths.
articles.content: 由于计算成本高昂的评估（例如模型训练）和性能归因的不透明性，自动化AI研究与一般的软件工程有所不同。当前基于大型语言模型（LLM）的代理在此方面存在困难，通常会生成忽略执行成本和因果因素的单一脚本。我们引入了MARS（具有反思搜索的模块化代理），这是一个针对自主AI研究优化的框架。MARS依赖于三个支柱：（1）通过成本约束的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）进行预算感知规划，以明确平衡性能与执行成本；（2）模块化构建，采用“设计-分解-实现”流程来管理复杂的研究仓库；（3）比较性反思记忆，通过分析解决方案的差异来提炼高信号洞察，以解决信用分配问题。在可比设置下，MARS在MLE-Bench基准测试中实现了开源框架中的最先进性能，保持与全球领先方法的竞争性。此外，该系统表现出定性上的“啊哈！”时刻，其中63%的所有使用过的教训来源于跨分支转移，这表明代理能够有效地在搜索路径之间推广见解。

articles.title: LQA: A Lightweight Quantized-Adaptive Framework for Vision-Language Models on the Edge
articles.author: Xin Wang, Hong Jia, Hualin Zhou, Sheng Guang Wang, Yu Zhang, Ting Dang, Tao Gu
articles.summary: Deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on edge devices is challenged by resource constraints and performance degradation under distribution shifts. While test-time adaptation (TTA) can counteract such shifts, existing methods are too resource-intensive for on-device deployment. To address this challenge, we propose LQA, a lightweight, quantized-adaptive framework for VLMs that combines a modality-aware quantization strategy with gradient-free test-time adaptation. We introduce Selective Hybrid Quantization (SHQ) and a quantized, gradient-free adaptation mechanism to enable robust and efficient VLM deployment on resource-constrained hardware. Experiments across both synthetic and real-world distribution shifts show that LQA improves overall adaptation performance by 4.5\%, uses less memory than full-precision models, and significantly outperforms gradient-based TTA methods, achieving up to 19.9$\times$ lower memory usage across seven open-source datasets. These results demonstrate that LQA offers a practical pathway for robust, privacy-preserving, and efficient VLM deployment on edge devices.
articles.content: 在边缘设备上部署视觉-语言模型（VLMs）面临资源限制和在分布变化下性能退化的挑战。虽然测试时适应（TTA）可以应对这种变化，但现有方法的资源消耗太大，不适合在设备上部署。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了LQA，一种轻量级、量化自适应的VLM框架，结合了模态感知量化策略和无梯度测试时适应。我们引入了选择性混合量化（SHQ）和一种量化、无梯度的适应机制，以实现资源受限硬件上鲁棒且高效的VLM部署。在合成和现实世界分布变化的实验中，LQA在整体适应性能上提高了4.5%，使用的内存比全精度模型更少，并显著优于基于梯度的TTA方法，在七个开源数据集上实现了高达19.9倍的内存使用降低。这些结果表明，LQA为在边缘设备上实现鲁棒、隐私保护且高效的VLM部署提供了一条实用的路径。

articles.title: Energy Concerns with HPC Systems and Applications
articles.author: Roblex Nana, Claude Tadonki, Petr Dokladal, Youssef Mesri
articles.summary: For various reasons including those related to climate changes, {\em energy} has become a critical concern in all relevant activities and technical designs. For the specific case of computer activities, the problem is exacerbated with the emergence and pervasiveness of the so called {\em intelligent devices}. From the application side, we point out the special topic of {\em Artificial Intelligence}, who clearly needs an efficient computing support in order to succeed in its purpose of being a {\em ubiquitous assistant}. There are mainly two contexts where {\em energy} is one of the top priority concerns: {\em embedded computing} and {\em supercomputing}. For the former, power consumption is critical because the amount of energy that is available for the devices is limited. For the latter, the heat dissipated is a serious source of failure and the financial cost related to energy is likely to be a significant part of the maintenance budget. On a single computer, the problem is commonly considered through the electrical power consumption. This paper, written in the form of a survey, we depict the landscape of energy concerns in computer activities, both from the hardware and the software standpoints.
articles.content: 由于包括与气候变化相关的各种原因，{\em 能源}已成为所有相关活动和技术设计中的一个关键问题。就计算机活动的特定情况而言，随着所谓{\em 智能设备}的出现和普及，这一问题变得更加严重。从应用角度来看，我们指出一个特殊主题：{\em 人工智能}，它显然需要高效的计算支持，才能实现其作为{\em 无处不在的助手}的目标。主要存在两种情境，其中{\em 能源}是首要关注的问题之一：{\em 嵌入式计算}和{\em 超级计算}。对于前者，功耗至关重要，因为设备可使用的能源是有限的。对于后者，散发的热量是导致故障的严重原因，与能源相关的财务成本可能成为维护预算的重要组成部分。在单台计算机上，该问题通常通过电力消耗来考虑。本文以综述的形式撰写，我们从硬件和软件两个角度描绘了计算机活动中能源问题的现状。

articles.title: Intermittent Semi-Working Mask: A New Masking Paradigm for LLMs
articles.author: HaoYuan Hu, Mingcong Lu, Di Luo, XinYa Wu, Jiangcai Zhu, Taoye Yin, Zheng Li, Hao Wang, Shusheng Zhang, KeZun Zhang, KaiLai Shao, Chao Chen, Feng Wang
articles.summary: Multi-turn dialogues and context-intensive tasks challenge Large Language Models (LLMs) to integrate long histories without sacrificing generation quality. Although prefix LLMs can better exploit historical context via bidirectional attention on prefix tokens, they are rarely used in practice because multi-turn training requires many duplicated triplets, and its bidirectional prefix prevents KV-cache reuse at inference time, driving up high cost and latency. To retain the contextual understanding of prefix mask while preserving the inference-time efficiency of causal mask, we introduce Intermittent Semi-working Mask (ISM), a masking scheme that injects sparse bidirectional attention into the causal backbone. ISM alternates bidirectional attention over query segments with unidirectional attention over answer segments, enabling the synthesis of in-context while preserving global causality. This design eliminates triplet expansion during training and maintains KV-cache reuse during inference, yielding latency comparable to standard causal LLMs. ISM is architecture-agnostic and parameter-free, adding only minimal latency. Across extensive evaluations, ISM outperforms causal baselines not only on multi-turn dialogue, but also on context-intensive tasks like mathematical reasoning.
